author: Joshua Fields
review_text: An excellent operation with a chill vibe and a creative menu, taking amazing meals up a notch in unique ways. The Tartare Crostini is well formed and very flavorful, the salad’s cream and seasonings took some mixing up to get used to but that was good. Brown butter Crab with bread was great, and my two favorite starters the Grilled Octopus and the Seafood Rice. The octopus had perfect char and a sweet delicious taste paired great with the egg. The Seafood Rice was a great blend of fish stocked rice and cold fish as a topping. Then the Pork Collar, I loved this it’s a perfect preparation. Great portion with a beautiful seasoned top layer and a wonderful fatty center. We didn’t care much for the side, which for a dish this pricey you’d like solid side as a base but this gets a pass. Lastly to finish off the Panna Cotta was straight up great, safest dessert option.

author: Justin Godbout
review_text:
Bravo. I’ve determined that this would officially be my last meal. Everything was perfect. The restaurant itself is super cosy. The service was excellent, relaxed. The food was interesting and flavourful. We tried a number of fun wines that paired well our food.

My only complaint is how hard it was to get a reservation 😆

author: Nomadicus
review_text:
Four Horsemen feels like stumbling into a very well kept secret that somehow never tries to impress you… and still does.

I decided to try getting in without a reservation and luckily they thoughtfully keep bar and window seats available for walk-ins. The best approach is to line up right when the kitchen opens, or wait until the initial 5pm dinner rush tapers off and secure a seat at the bar.

The dining room is quietly romantic but a bit snug nonetheless creating a relaxed, understated atmosphere. Service is genuinely warm and technically precise without a hint of theatrics, striking an ideal balance of professionalism and ease.

The menu consists of tapas-style plates that are intentionally restrained. With minimal ingredients and thoughtful execution, each dish allows the quality of the product to shine rather than relying on excess or embellishment. The result is food that feels confident, focused, and deeply satisfying.

Four Horsemen is refined without feeling formal, and thoughtful without being precious, making it a place worth the effort, even on short notice.

author: Meredith Oliver
review_text:
I enjoyed Four Horsemen, but it didn't blow my mind for the price. If I went again, I'd stick to the small plates so I could try more things. The chicken was good, but not great and it was huge. Their menu changes on a regular basis, so you can't be sure what you're going to get. Nothing I had was bad. Wagyu crostini and harimasa (not pictured) were my favorites.

I arrived at 10:45am, and waited for them to open at 11. A line formed quickly, and it's a slow process for them to seat everyone in their tiny space. If you can't get a reservation, show up as early as you can.

author: brandi brady
review_text:
I really enjoyed every bite and the service was great! the server had lots of great suggestions on food & pairings. we were a party of 4, walk in. for me, it makes it extra special when you stand in line for a seat & secure it in the first seatings. the hiramasa & green tomatoes are my fav, the glazed beetroot & mushroom toast were great. the mackerel was good, it didn’t knock my socks off the way everything else did.
looking forward to when I can get over there for lunch!

author: Mohamed Izlanshah
review_text: exceptional. dare i say one of the best meals ive had in my life. from start to finish every bite and every sip is so well thought out, so stunning and so so delicious. complicated flavours served in a non pretentious setting, laid back sunday lunch in the best restaurant in brooklyn. life changing stuff.

author: Patrick K
review_text: Michelin star wine bar? Yes pls! But people come here for the food. Impossible to snag a resy but worth waiting for a walk in spot at lunch or before dinner service. Vibe cozy and cute. Food was amazing! Small menu but basically every dish was a hit. Also the wine selection was well curated.  Verdict: recommend and will return!!

author: Lili McFarlane
review_text: Not a single miss. Everything was standout, flavors are thought provoking. For 2 people we shared the mushroom toast, fennel salad, bread, hiramasa, pork collar, and halibut. Toffee pudding for dessert. Portions are smaller but with this order we left full. Service was excellent especially for recommending wine.

author: Sally Nguyen
review_text: This restaurant is overrated, and I honestly don’t understand how it has held a Michelin star for several years. It’s definitely not worth the price. The portions are tiny, the flavors were either far too salty or overly acidic. Despite spending over $200 for just five dishes for 3 people , none of us left feeling satisfied. On top of that, getting a reservation here is unnecessarily difficult. For the same price, we had a much better experience at Theodora, which doesn’t even have a Michelin star but served food that was both delicious and filling. Save your time and money—skip this place and go somewhere else.

author: Delphica Sibyl
review_text:
The Four Horsemen - finally  😊
My husband and I have been devoted LCD Soundsystem fans for years, so the fact that James Murphy co-founded this place has always made it feel like a small dream waiting to happen. We’d been postponing it for weeks, as life has a way of reshuffling plans, but this time my husband said, 'This is your birthday and that’s it. We’re going.' I agreed ;)
The restaurant itself is small, understated, and effortlessly elegant. The interior has that kind of simple chic that feels authentic: warm wood, soft light, no pretense. We didn’t have a reservation but decided to take a chance, and after waiting about thirty minutes, we got a table right after 5:20 pm
The menu is tiny, almost minimalist, but every dish feels deeply considered. We weren’t too hungry, so we ordered a few small plates and a bottle of wine, saving room for dessert and hoping for a candle later.
And the food… oh, the food. I’m not sure words can do it justice. Every bite was a perfect balance of acid, sweetness, and texture. I’m from wine and vinegar country, so I truly appreciate the taste of acidity and here, I finally found a place in New York that speaks to my palate. Their flavors don’t fade the moment you swallow; they linger, evolve, and make you think.
I couldn’t help but notice almost everyone around us was ordering their famous warm bread, it looked absolutely divine. But since I bake my own bread at home and had already had a fresh loaf that morning, we decided to skip it this time. Still, it clearly seemed to be the must of the evening, and I’ll definitely try it on our next visit.
The wine list is impressive. We chose a French white that was absolutely balanced, bright, and beautifully alive (and no headache after!). And the desserts… I’m still dreaming about the passionfruit cake, so light, tangy, and joyful. I was especially happy that nobody from the staff sang 'Happy Birthday.' ❤️
As for the staff, 'perfect' doesn’t even begin to describe their service. They have that rare ability to make you feel both taken care of and completely at ease.
The atmosphere, the music, the people, the vibe: 10 out of 10, or maybe 100 out of 100.

To Be Continued
:))

author: Marvin Fuentes
review_text: The four horsemen has to be one of the best dining experiences I’ve been to this year. Everything was exquisite from the presentation to the music. But all the credit has to go to our Bartender Will; his knowledge of wine and bitters and amaro is renowned with some of the best in the game. Sit at the bar and thank me later

author: AC Slater
review_text:
Can't wait to return. Everything was incredible, especially the oeuf mayonnaise- which is forever engrained in my memory as one of my favorite bites anywhere.

Queued up 30 minutes before opening and the line filled up FAST

author: Noe Amighini
review_text:
The experience was bad from the start, when they seated us at a bar facing the street next to the entrance door, which opened every two minutes and froze us. There were four empty seats at the other bar, and we asked to change, but they said no, that they were busy, even though no one was sitting there. On the other hand, the food is scarce and not very tasty for what they charge, especially for a restaurant that is supposedly recommended by Michelin. We ordered rice with seafood, and it was almost impossible to find. For starters, we had mayonnaise eggs that were cold!!! They didn't warn us, they were tiny, not incredible and the price was extremely high. In conclusion, if you want to eat ordinary food, meager portions, nothing particularly sophisticated in terms of flavor, and pay a fortune... this is the place!
Oh, the bread was very good!

author: Jack Bekos
review_text: One of my favorite meals in NYC this year. Every dish was a dream. We ordered the oeuf, green tomatoes, fennel salad, tartare, mushroom toast and rainbow trout. Latter two were our favorites. The passion fruit tart dessert was magical. The best part? The wildly inventive wine list that paired perfectly with every bite. Service was great and homey, intimate setting was wonderful. Expensive but worth it for a special occasion.

author: Maria
review_text:
Tiny spot known for his extensive wine list and ever-changing (short) menu.
We started with the bread and clams which pairs perfectly together - thanks to the suggestion of our waitress.
Next we had the green tomatoes dish which was our favorite by far as it was packed with so much flavor and seasoned to perfection.
We finished with the Golden Rice topped with Uni which was delicious as well.
Highly recommend this Michelin star spot for a date night!
*Resys are a must unless you get there right at 5pm and get a bar or window seat

author: Khoi Pham
review_text: Interestingly enough, my personal favorites were the smaller dishes rather than the larger ones. Notably, the oeuf mayonnaise and the warm house bread (the butter especially) were great. Otherwise, everything else was fine although nothing too particularly memorable. The staff is very attentive and helpful. The vibes are lively but also serene, which I like.

author: Audreanna
review_text: Some dishes were fantastic while others weren’t. The summer squash was drowning in Beurre Blanc and rather gross. The fried crab was soggy. The pork shoulder was delicious. The service was overall good but slow. Their wine selection is one of my favorite things about the experiences. Overall I found the four horsemen to be mid for this type of restaurant and expectation.

author: Yulia Shekeladze
review_text: everything was delicious (although deep fried mackerel wasn’t out favourite, it had a very fishy taste) and this place absolutely deserves the hype. also we went without reservation, i got in line at 4:45 (saturday night) to put my name down for a group of 3 and we were seated at 7:30, so it is definitely possible.

author: Jennifer Lee
review_text:
Finally getting around to writing this, but The Four Horsemen really lived up to the hype. The place is super cozy and welcoming.

Our server was awesome and gave us great wine recs that perfectly complemented the food. Everything we ate was seriously delicious—you can tell they put a lot of thought into every dish.

author: Julie Geng
review_text:
This was my third visit to The Four Horsemen since June 2024, and sadly, it was a sharp departure from the consistently excellent experiences I’ve had in the past.

The quality of the food has noticeably declined. They no longer serve the signature seared yellowfin tuna. The skewer was aggressively spicy, overwhelming rather than enhancing the flavor. The Gen clam dish came across as bland. The swordfish was dry and overcooked. Even the egg appetizer that people rave about felt uninspired.

Equally disappointing was the service behind the bar. The bartenders were visibly drinking while serving us, and one even spat into the sink right in front of us while we were eating. That kind of disregard for basic professionalism and hygiene.

It’s disheartening to see such a reputable place slip so far in both culinary quality and hospitality. I hope this was an off night, but given the steep drop in standards, I’m hesitant to return anytime

author: Komal Rathi
review_text:
Such a disappointment. Glad I went on a Tuesday morning at 9 AM when there were maybe a handful people inside and all the tables were available.

Salmon Foccacia was cold and hard. Had to literally chew the hell out of it. Earl grey morning bun was cold as well. Brown butter cornbread - again cold, dry and way too sweet. Only thing decent was the black forest croissant which was honestly just ok but better than the rest.

People who say that the smoked salmon focaccia is out of this world or the brown butter cornbread is the best thing to touch their mouth are probably living in a bubble. To say this is one of the best bakery in a city like NYC full of amazing bakeries is an abomination.

I honestly don't understand if you open at 7:30 AM and I am there at 9 AM how is everything so cold l, dry and hard? $60 down the drain. Well, at least I didn't stand in line for two hours.

author: Nam Nguyen
review_text:
On weekends, this establishment experiences a queue extending from the interior to the exterior, with an estimated wait time of 30 minutes for entry. The line typically progresses at a swift pace. Outdoor seating is available, and a Citi Bike station is conveniently located directly in front of the premises.

They offer a selection of delectable sandwiches and baked goods, all prepared fresh in-house. The staff is knowledgeable and readily available to address any inquiries. The croissant was particularly enjoyable. We highly recommend sampling the cornbread; it is, in my experience, an exceptionally delightful rendition of the item. Pricing is competitive with current market rates within the industry.

author: Joon Lim
review_text:
Oh my goodness.. Best focaccias I've ever tried.
All their pastries, especially the focaccia, were so soft and chewy on the inside and crunchy on the outside,
I had quite a few of them..

Smoked Salmon with cream cheese, dill, and picked onion.. damn well balanced.
Shakshuka Focaccia was so delicant it was unbelievable, and with an actual full-on egg inside.
Everythign Space with Scallion Cream Cheese was also amazing. The scallions were fresh and it gave a very fun texture and interesting taste that I loved.
Scallion Seasame Twist was another great one. My sister's favorite.
Lastly the Early Grey Bun. I'm not a big fan of earl grey but still picked it up.
I don't regret the choice!

Beautifully balanced taste on all their selections.

author: Minh Nguyen
review_text:
It's not bad but a bit overhyped. The foccacia and sesame twist are delicious but the rest of the pastries are just average:
- Croissant: no flavour whatsoever, the butter is completely missing
- Corn cake: rich but a bit too sweet. The inside is a bit gluey.
- Morning bun: can taste the early grey but also sweet, texture a bit dry
- Cinnamon rolls: also sweet and dry

Overall recommended to try if you are in the area but not worth travel the length of NY for...

author: Debisree Ray
review_text:
I’d heard great things about this Brooklyn bakery, so I finally stopped by on a Saturday around 1 p.m. As soon as I arrived, I saw a long line outside — and it continued inside as well. The shop itself is very small, with no indoor seating and just a few sidewalk tables, which fill up quickly. So my first tip: go early if you want the full selection and a shorter wait. The line does move fairly quickly, though, thanks to their fast service — and the crowd alone tells you how popular the place is.

Even though it was already late in the day and many items had sold out, I still managed to get a ham sandwich. It was fairly large  in size. I ate it in two portions ( however, I was not super hungry, tbh) and made with high-quality ham, a flavorful spread, and a sesame-crusted toasted baguette. The bread was a bit firm, but it seemed intentional. It wasn’t served hot, but it was fresh and made with high quality ingredients.

I also grabbed a slice of their brown corn butter cake, which was incredible — unlike anything I’ve had before. It reminded me of cornbread but with the richness and texture of a butter cake. A really delicious fusion.

To go with it, I ordered an iced mocha, and it was excellent. I’m usually picky about mochas, but this one had great balance: high-quality espresso and chocolate, thick texture, and just the right sweetness (leaning on the less-sweet side, which I loved).

Overall, this bakery is absolutely worth the visit — especially if you enjoy unique baked goods and great coffee. Just be prepared for a line, and try to arrive early for the best selection. I’m already planning to return and try more of their menu.

author: Rylan Gordon
review_text:
The pastries here are fantastic. Expect a line on a Saturday morning, but it moves quickly. We got the corn pecorino focaccia and were completely blown away — such a unique combination that totally works. I’m still thinking about it. We also got the brown butter cornbread, which was excellent, and topped it off with the cheddar pretzel bear claw. If you’re into pretzels, that one will be perfect for you.

They have so many pastries that you’ll want to come back a few times to try more. The service was very friendly, and everything looked amazing. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re looking for a great pastry spot in Brooklyn.

author: Ainishah Hemraj
review_text: pretty long line but i genuinely think the brown butter cornbread is worth it! the corn bread is balanced so well the crispy edges and soft inside and the brown butter adds the perfect flavour. the morning bun is also really good! i really liked the turkey focaccia but wish i had gotten one of the other focaccia sandwiches instead as they looked better

author: malhar kulkarni
review_text:
The hype about is true and 100% deserved!
Delicious fresh Sandos, Croissants and other bakery items. No matter what time you get here, you’ll find yourself in a queue (moves quickly). Some of the limited items drop at 7:30 am and get sold out quickly, some at 10:30 am. We tried Spicy Tofu, crispy cauliflower focaccia and they both were phenomenal. Pistachio Croissant is one of the best in NYC (competes with L’apartmente 4f) and is a must try. We’ll be back here to try our luck with the limited items!
Seating is outside only and very limited!

author: Ticha Ungboriboonpisal
review_text:
Radio Bakery is my no. 1 bakery in nyc. every time i go, i have to wait in line (~10-30 mins depending on which day and time).  what keeps me going back is their unique sandwiches and pastry 🥐 they always have rotating seasonal pastry and scrumptious collabs.

what i have tried—
✨apple brown butter croissant ($7): crispy croissant with sweet apple 🍎 it is not overly sweet; just enough to fuel my day.
✨smoked salmon focaccia ($15): a perfect breakfast or brunch. it is packed with cream cheese, dill, onion, and smoked salmon.
✨earl grey morning bun ($6): my all time fav. it is fragrant with early grey, cinnamon, in a chewy bun. i’d always go back for this.

i was actually going for corn custard tart but it was sold out within minutes 😭 people do not play when it comes to viral and seasonal bakery.

author: Daniela V
review_text:
Interior/outside terrace: the interior is very functional, very few inside seating options. But it’s not like a comfy café. They do have a small outside seating area, which is nice, nothing special, but if you get a table there, you can enjoy your croissants in the sun.

Food quality/price: good selection of savoury & sweet food, very delicious. I got an earl grey bun & a pistachio croissant. Both very delicious, like out of another world. Loved them. I found their food to be quite expensive.
Suggestion: why not making tiny versions of the different treats (to a smaller price as well of course), so solo-visitors can try more delicious treats?

Service: friendly, functional, nothing outstanding though.

author: Kongphop Attakowitwitaya
review_text:
Radio Bakery is such a charming spot! The bread and pastries are absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. The bakery itself is adorable, with a cozy and inviting atmosphere that makes you want to linger.

The neighborhood adds to the vibe too — it feels trendy and lively, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. Definitely a must-visit if you’re in the area and love good baked goods.

author: JC SORIANO
review_text: I don’t know man. Maybe because my wife makes some slammin focaccia, considering the line, I thought maybe the food here would be outstanding but, I found myself gnawing or needing to tear the sandwich from my mouth after biting down hard on the bread. I did see someone bite down and use their fingers to help them tear it away. My jaw muscles shouldn’t get tried from having to chew so hard to be honest 😅 Maybe they’re baking at too high of a heat who knows. The chocolate croissant however was “very good” not sure I would 15 minutes again to get a sandwich or pastries here.

author: J Howell
review_text: Everything this place touches is next level. The everything with cream cheese is unreal—so soft it literally melts in your mouth. You can taste the care and quality in every bite. Shout out to Billy for the great service—friendly, welcoming, and on point. Radio City Bakery is a must-stop.

author: Mia Huynh
review_text:
I've heard so much about this spot but never got the chance to go until recently. We went on a Monday morning around 11am, and there wasn't much of a wait but it was still packed inside nonetheless. They have a window bar for you to enjoy your pastries at, otherwise, all seating is outside.

We got their croissant, earl grey morning bun, apple brie croissant, and their roast beef sandwich. Everything was delicious. The favorite of the day was definitely the apple brie croissant—which I did not expect to like as much as I did. I loved how fragrant the tea flavor was in the earl grey morning bun, and loved how crispy it was. The croissant was also an all-around standard great croissant, and the roast beef sandwich was a heart lunch bite. Even though the pastries weren't warmed up, I thought they were so good and I would love to come back to try others!

author: Andrew Berto
review_text: One of the best bakeries in nyc!! I stopped by around noon on a Saturday and had to wait in line for maybe 20 min. The focaccia sandwich I had was incredible and def hit the spot. Now I gotta get up early and head near opening in the morning to catch the other pasties and seasonal treats they sell and sell out of. The peach iced tea was also very good

author: Ken F
review_text: I'll be honest, the food was alright. It seems like a low bar, but at least it's consistent and that's great. The service was good and it seemed like all of their customers were having a good time. They also know how to make an actual macchiato and not just call a caramel latte a macchiato. The cashier also made sure that we were aware of the macchiato size which would be very helpful for new customers.

author: HAIRmonstar
review_text:
"Finally made it to Radio Bakery in Greenpoint. As someone who runs a bakery myself, I was blown away by their operation. The open kitchen isn't just for show; it creates a lively, immersive atmosphere that draws customers in. You can literally feel the heat of the ovens and the passion of the bakers.

The balance of flavors and the texture were spot on. It was a great benchmarking experience for my next step. Highly recommended for anyone looking for inspiration in NY!"

author: sabrina
review_text: Decided to brave the line as it was my birthday and I’ve been longing to try the pastries here! Line moved swiftly and we got the everything focaccia with scallion cream cheese, cinnamon roll, earl grey morning bun, twice baked pistachio croissant, and heirloom tomato croissant; you can tell this stuff is crafted with so much expertise and creativity. I’m still dreaming of those flaky layers 🥐 We met the icon herself Kelly Mencin and she was so sweet and dropped off a fresh croissant 🥹 heaven!! Can’t wait to come back on a more regular basis 🌝 also the peach tea slaps

author: Inger Margrete Hansen
review_text:
As a bakery devotee, I knew I had to visit the moment I read about it. Was I prepared for the queue? No. Should I have been, in this city? Yes.

I didn’t manage to try the pastries, but the sandwich I grabbed for my flight made me want to return immediately.

author: Chayma F.
review_text:
I had the apple brown sugar croissant, and a latte. Both very good. Only 5min wait on a Monday morning.

I really want to try the French onion soup croissant next, it looks delicious.

No indoor seats.

author: KrisKat Meow
review_text: Came here because I know Coach House to be opened late. After a little change, the renovations are lovely. Martin was our server and he was attentive. The trio appetizer and burgers were delicious. Will be back to try the rest of the menu!

author: sarah bender
review_text: came here on a whim, the first time since the remodel.. and WOW! Martin was our server, he was super accommodating and kind. We ordered the tomahawk steak and 2 salads and everything was prepared perfectly. We will definitely be back.

author: Jillian Perez
review_text: I genuinely liked Coach House. In the beginning they were good and consistent. Lately food quality and quantity has been disappointing. Also I have had a few issues with take out orders. Today I placed an order for delivery. I ordered a cheeseburger deluxe (photo attached). $14 for this and look at the amount of fries given. That’s ridiculous. There were barely any fries. Also, you receive different fries every time. Sometimes it’s crinkle fries, then sometimes it’s regular fries. I used to order breakfast, and as part of breakfast you would get toast, 2 slices. Now you receive 1 slice of toast that is barely even toasted. Why only 1 slice of toast? That’s so odd. Another time I called to place a takeout order and was told that I wasn’t “allowed” to order a kids chicken fingers for takeout for my daughter. I then asked to speak to a manager because what kind of ridiculous policy is that. The manager I spoke with ended up accommodating but she also asked if it was for a child. I guess you’re not allowed to order kids chicken fingers because they think an adult is getting it for themselves. Regardless, if I want to get chicken fingers and I’m paying for it, what does it matter? The next situation I had was just last week, where I ordered grilled chicken and a side of home fries. When I went to pick it up, I was asked if I have ordered that before, which I have. Then I was told that I wasn’t “allowed” to order grilled chicken. At this point I’m annoyed because I’ve already had previous issues with Coach House. I then wait to speak with the manager and I was told that I needed to order a grilled chicken dinner and not a side of grilled chicken. Well put it on the menu then. My husband has stomach issues and can only eat a handful of things and he likes the grilled chicken. But yet I wasn’t allowed to order that? That’s absurd. My guess is because it was charged as a side and not a whole $20 meal. It’s disappointing because I genuinely liked Coach House. Lately though, all of these issues make me not want to order from them anymore or even go there. Coach House please do better. I have been a customer for years, this is not the level of service that one should be given.

author: Aury Ortiz- Rivera
review_text: Hosted my best friends proposal in the Red Room & everything came out perfect !! Diana and Elena accommodated all our needs & our server Julius was super attentive. We had a delicious dinner & a great time celebrating our friend. The restaurant itself was beautifully decorated for Christmas !! Would recommend 100% and will definitely be coming back for dinner.

author: Sarah Bolano
review_text: I guess I’m just disappointed. I grew up in Jersey City Heights and often went to coach house with my family. They definitely improved the atmosphere, but I would say overall, the food was just…decent. For me, I say, if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. This was a community staple for years and when I was there I heard other patrons complaining about the fact that the place and food were so different. The starting bread was stale, the pizza was 5/10, the lobster bisque was 5/10, the lobster ravioli I had was pretty good though! 7.5/10. I think the price was fair considering that both my husband and I got lobster. I brought my two kids and it didn’t feel family friendly at all. It was extremely quiet, and they gave us a coloring page for my son but had no crayons. Not sure if it’s the nostalgia, but I just feel the old coach house was better /: either way, best of luck to these new owners.

author: A. S. T.
review_text: Excellent menu, great prices, live music on Friday nights. The Cabernet Sauvignon that was served was exquisite. The only things that bothered me was that the wild mushrooms croquettes (pictured) were actually just mashed potatoes, and the tacky violinist playing tacky music for an hour between the live jazz sets. Luckily the friends I invited for the jazz act had a good attitude.

author: Kim Tannu
review_text: I needed a restaurant for a repast, I had less than 3 days to book a place and the amount of people went from 30-50 to 75-80. Diana was amazing, she worked with me on the menu to accommodate the few vegetarians we had and was able to work out final details and get me all the paperwork via email and texts so I didn't have to drive there. She was professional, responsive and easy to work with. I had dined at the old Coach House Diner many times but never at CH Steakhouse and was nervous about the quality but the food was delicious! Everything was well seasoned and all th entrees came with mashed potatoes and vegetables. It was such a large crowd yet the filet mignon was cooked perfectly. Those that ordered the Dill Salmon and Chicken Marsala also enjoyed their meals. The onion soup I had to begin the meal and cheesecake that ended the meal were also wonderful. Even the cabernet that was included in our package was so much better than I expected. Our section's server, Albert was amazing and did everything in his power to make sure everyone was taken care of. I could not ask for a better experience especially on such short notice. It was well worth the price. Next time I'm in that area, I will definitely book a table!

author: Modern Spin 7410 Broadway
review_text: Came here for my God father’s repass dinner. Over 50 ppl and i must say they were amazing. Both service and food was impeccable. Very impressive menu and dessert was scrumptious!  Highly recommend. Although ill miss my chicken fingers and fries at 3am , the transition to fine dining was a great change. Well done.  Coming from another restaurant owner..

author: William Roldan (xoll75)
review_text: The food was amazing. Everything came out fresh and delicious. Very friendly customer service. The servers and staff were excellent!

author: A Eng
review_text: Our party of 16 arrived for a 10:30 dinner. We were seated quickly with tables prepared for our big party. The interior of the place was nice and renovated. It's probably the nicest diner I've been to. The staff was great and the food came out hot. I was impressed with the food and service. Parking was available too which helped with family who drove in from out of town. This diner wasn't my top choice for a late celebration, but I'm glad we gave this place a chance because we will be back for breakfast and future celebrations.

author: Norma Medina
review_text: First time returning after renovations, whole experience made us feel very welcome Julius our server was really kind and generous! Chef George rocks at the food! Will definitely come again 1 million times over

author: Stephany Rivas
review_text: Great food, loved my salad, lobster bisque  and my drink. 10 out of 10, Coachhouse has gotten an upgrade and I’m here for it

author: Lizbeth suarez
review_text:
The venue is beautiful both inside and out. The food is exceptional; I devoured my plate—it was delicious! The server was very friendly and attentive, checking on us multiple times during our visit.

The bathroom is impressive as well, featuring a baby diaper changing room and easy access. Additionally, they have a bar and a VIP room, and the space is quite large.

author: Jocelyn Herrera
review_text: First time passing by after it being remodeled and honestly loved it. Place looked very cute! Music was definitely a vibe && Martin our server was amazing !!

author: Joseline Sosa
review_text: I would like to start by saying my rating has nothing to do with the people that work there they were professional and nice people, my rating is because of the menu, im so disappointed in the change the made the menu options are terrible and to the point where the table next to me walked away. Do not recommend this place. Looks nice though.

author: Anthony Gangaram
review_text: Martin was amazing! Couch house has constantly adapted to the times and looks amazing these days! New menu is great and I recommend their angel envy's old fashion

author: Carlos Cuello
review_text: I’ve been going to Coach House for decades now. My first time there was in 1987 or 1988. God I loved this place. It was my daughter’s favorite spot to go eat. Throughout the years the food quality and service declined. As I was parking the car to go in there, I called my daughter to let her know that I was there. She told me her last time there was not a good experience and that she would never go back. I got upset but we had parked the car sans we were hungry. From the very beginning, the upgrades were extremely noticeable, the service exceeded any expectation that I may have had. Isaac, our server went above and beyond. Nothing was forced, it came naturally to him. If you could clone Isaac that place will never fail any patron. Without writing anything down, he remembered every detail of our appetizers, main course and the many different desserts with specific requests that all 3 of us had. This place is back on my to go back and eat again list. He didn’t even mention anything to us about writing him a review but his service was 5 stars. The cappuccino and the simple but classy strawberry cheesecake drizzled with chocolate syrup was to die for. The pistachio cheesecake with pistachio ice cream was delicious and presentation on point. Extremely elegant! The raspberry white chocolate cheesecake was extremely delicious. What a great experience. Again, kudos to Isaac for making our experience there a great one. Can’t wait to go back!!!

author: John Acosta
review_text: The food was delicious and the service was super fast. Our waiter Julius was very nice and super helpful. He was very attentive and made us feel welcome. The new look and atmosphere of this diner is so beautiful and chic. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Emtalvarado@gmail.com Alvarado
review_text: Great place for family and friends to hang out. The food was amazing and the staff one of a kind. Highly recommend.

author: Carmen Guerra
review_text: My godmother and I had a delicious fish with mash potatoes and vegetables. Then we tried a tasty dessert (mango sorbet), which was amazing. The service was spectacular!

author: Esg
review_text:
Today we came to Fusta restaurant for a family birthday. Such a great time. The service was great, Nazar was very attentive,friendly and kind,he gave such a great service. The food was super good. This place is a must come if you are in the area. The atmosphere was nice,calm. It's not so big inside but is worth it.
Great for any type of event. We all order different dish and everything was super good..I order skirt steak,spinach and mashed potatoes. Super delicious. The calamari also very good..usually I order this on other places and the calamari is always extremely fried like rubber not here. Totally recomend this place and I would definitely visit again.
You can get an idea of some of the dish below..ahh let's not mention for the coffee lovers like me,my expresso shot is a must, super good.
Note: the calamari is serve with lettuce but we ask no lettuce just the calamari.

author: Neftali Marrero
review_text:
LA FUSTA was a bustaa. Sorry to say, but this was my first time going to this establishment, which I saw many good reviews, so I believe that because of the special day being sunday(MOTHER'S DAY).they were not well prepared for  so much confusion,so I'm rating my bad experience on one day,but I will be back to try and give a better review on a slower day.For one was a small place and parking was challenging on tonelle Avenue, in new jersey.for this particular day.It started off with 2 waiters coming for our orders ,we told the second waiter that we put our order of drinks and appetizers with the first waiter. Never served the bread,butter, or the famous chimi churi sauce.i believe you have to pay for bottle water because they never brought regular water out,so we continued to ask for more bottled water 💧 cause it goes fast in our party.lol..the appetizers were not bad but as you look at the picture of the fried  calamari plate it was more lettuce than calamari ( a rabbit would've enjoyed that dish) they must've been running short on calamari. Another suggestion if when ordering grilled Argentinian meat  plate and you don't eat intestines, ask for no intestines cause it brings the most,and one of other meats which have to say were very good. Plus, the chimi churi sauce was delicious. As well as the salad was plenty with all you can imagine and very healthy and delicious. Oh yes,and the shrimp soup was not bad. My
Personal recommendation is this place to book on holidays or special occasions not recommended maybe on a regular day they might be better 🤔.we paid over $200, not worth it .Sorry to say very expensive, but it was a special day, and they also had another limited menu, not their regular menu.

author: Pa Papi
review_text: If you want the best freshest Authentic Argentine food you MUST stop by here and ask for Pablo. He greeted me with a big warm smile took me to the best table with a view of their TV’s and the service was best Cloth with table cloth and they serve Alcohol for those that might want to try some of De best Wine

author: corenzo wilkerson
review_text:
Beautiful spot
It's looked in maybe not so beautiful place on route 1 &9. But there is parking lot. The service is very good the staff is attentive. The food is amazing the steaks melt in your mouth. The sausages are exploding 🤯 with flavor so delicious 🤤. The ribs are delicious. We had several side all were great. If your in the mood for steak 🥩.

author: Cindy W
review_text:
We ended up at this restaurant after our flight was canceled. It was a delightful surprise!

We arrived about 30 minutes before the restaurant was due to close, but the servers and live music welcomed us warmly. Kevin was very friendly and recommended some dishes for us.

The two of us shared some empanadas and a smaller portion of the mixed grill. The mixed grill was enormous, with a portion large enough for at least four people!

The steaks were perfectly cooked to medium rare, and the sweet bread was delicious (even though I am usually not a fan). It was the perfect dish to share and taste a bit of everything!

If you love steak, this is the place to be!

author: Dalesca castro
review_text: Amazing personal, Lucas our server the manager and the other caleño guy 🫂🫂🫂 excellent 🙏🏼🙏🏼great fresh food you feel the quality really tasty😋, perfect place if you like feel at home and at the same time being cared for by the staff it’s wow. It’s classic 🙌🏽🙏🏼👍

author: Dina Gamez
review_text:
Lovely place. Nazar was a great waiter! Cute too 😋
Overall great food. Just a little bit warm inside.

author: O' Neill Morales
review_text:
Amazing food!
Amazing people!
Amazing service!
Amazing atmosphere!
This place so far has been the best restaurant I've ever been to, compared to other high-end restaurants I've been to.
Prices are reasonable, I expected it to be more expensive due to the great quality and service.
The food was amazing, so good that I forgot to take pictures of it.
But at least I captured the dessert.
And on the weekends they have live music, very beautiful classic music as you'll see on the video.
So take your wife, girlfriend, mother or significant other here and you'll both leave happy.
You won't regret it!

author: Rene Munoz
review_text: This review is written after speaking with a person who frequents Argentina as his father is born and raised in Argentina. The main focus was the meat, as that's what Argentina is known for. I was excited about it since my family has been butchers for generations.  I asked the mixed grilled meats, medium well. A week later, I still tasted the charred exterior, the lack of flavors, and the meat was over-cooked. The decor is full of Argentina soccer glories and televisions displaying the baseball world classic. The fried Calamari was not memorable and bland. The only thing worth the price was the mashed potato. Overall, it was overpriced and not worth a second visit. Over $200!! The service took too long to take our orders, and rarely did they ask us if we needed anything.

author: John John
review_text: First, I will say this is not a WHITE TABLE CLOTH Resteraunt, but the tablecloths are white, The Resteraunt name really says a lot because they WHIP your food up. I've been to many. This food was terrible. I will never go to this restaurant again or anything close to it. The chicken empanada was terrible poor qualiy. I couldn't even pick it up because it was soggy. So I needed a fork to eat my empanadas????? Never had an Empanada like that, and I've eaten all over the world. Beef empanada was fried more appropriate, but the beef used was poor quality. The spinach empanada was clearly the one that you see coming out the shell it wasn't good either. Next , the shrimps in garlic sauce a total of 6 for 22.50, which was also horrible, and a side order of spinach was not edible. I couldn't eat it. I literally couldn't swallow the food. And a bottle of pellegrino cost 8.25? That cost 4 times the amount as one bottle in a 12 pack. Then they rush you to leave. The waiter didn't have an understanding of the menu. For example, if you dont have something available on the menu what is the most popular dish or anything you suggest is the job of the waiter. The waiters and staff did not speak english enough to suggest anything in the menu. White Table Cloth Restaurants don't have 5 to 8 men waiters and busboys  standing by the bar talking. Nobody greets you at the door. They greet you at Applebee's. For those who have eaten at AUTHENTIC WHITE TABLE CLOTH RESTAURANTS knows this is a 2.5 star restaurant at best. There's an OUTBACK STEAKHOUSE not too far from this place that's probably better. Oh yeah, I forgot the bread was good.

author: Ed Steell
review_text: Wow very nice place.. I've lived in the area for years and it wasn't until last week that I realized this restaurant is the best, great atmosphere, good prices, excellent food, I highly recommend it.

author: Carlos Mennea
review_text: My wife and I recently visited La Fusta for the Copa America final, and it was our first time dining there. Despite the hectic night, the staff was incredibly friendly and attentive. We ordered a mix of empanadas (carne/beef, spinach, and jamon y queso/ham and cheese), a mixed salad, and milanesa completas. The prices were more than fair and actually cheaper than some other Argentine steakhouses in NJ. The quality and taste of the food were superb—everything tasted fresh and was seasoned to perfection. Although we didn’t get a chance to try their parillada, which they are known for, we will definitely be returning soon!

author: Erika Armstead
review_text: Great food excellent service! Nasa was an amazing server! Answered all my questions thoroughly!

author: Javier Otero
review_text: Great food and atmosphere and awesome service. Definitely I will come back soon. 100% Recommended.

author: leslie paredes
review_text: really nice place to go to. Service here was good and especially the food ! Walking out I loved that I was able to see them feed stray cats it shows that the restaurant cares about their customers and the less fortunate ❤️.

author: hector coyoy
review_text: Service was top notch 👌 the waitress were so nice and the food was cook as we asked.

author: Jade Reviews
review_text: My family and I had an excellent time here. My oldest even found some vegetarian options to our surprise.

author: Christian G
review_text: Wow!!   What a great find!!!  Food was amazing, servers were even better.   This is a hidden GEM in NJ.   Highly recommend you visit and enjoy the high quality food.   I ordered the skirt steak and parrilla.   Bought some wine and the waiters were very attentive.   Absolutely loved this place.

author: Mark Coletta
review_text: This is a hidden gem the food is always good and our family enjoys the different steaks great Argentina Restaurant and the staff is always very attentive.

author: Mercedes Landeta
review_text: Service is kind and food is exquisite! The cow feet soup remind me of the one my Mom does it was delicious👌🏼😋 we will always get back when we crave for “parrillada Argentina 🇦🇷!!! Sangria was also the perfect match 🥳

author: Emily Litman
review_text: A friend took me here to celebrate my birthday. The ambience is understated elegance with a touch of whimsy with the presentation of the cocktails and food. I really enjoyed the shrimp arepa bowl and steak with onions. We had 2 cocktails, one appetizer and the two entrees for about $90. Everything tasted great and the service was friendly and professional. I hope to return soon!

author: Victor Hernandez
review_text:
I’ve visited this restaurant several times and always enjoyed it, but on this occasion I noticed the quality has gone down a bit.

Food quality:
The Caesar salad had no dressing and the garlic shrimp lacked seasoning also. The sides of  tostones were old, they just heated up a little. I truly hope they bring back the great flavor and freshness that used to set them apart because I’ve always liked this place, but they definitely need to fix something with the kitchen staff.

On the other side… They have a very good customer service, what always makes us return there. The beautiful host Camila was very kind and find us a comfortable table. And our server Richard was attentive and kind. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Prices 💰:
For such a fancy place, the prices are very suitable to your pocket, we had 2 main course, 2 no alcoholic drinks, one appetizer and a salad for $53 excluding the tip. Which is not bad at all.

author: Catalina Leuro-Rey
review_text:
I had high expectations for this restaurant — the social media posts made it look very appealing. To start, I tried to make a reservation, but there were no openings, so I was advised to arrive and wait, which I did with my family. Parking was quite difficult even though there’s valet service, since the space fills up quickly, so we ended up parking on the street after driving around for a while.

The decoration and presentation of the dishes were very creative and visually appealing. We ordered the Venezuelan Sampler, which allowed us to try five different items. For our main courses, we had the Arepa La Venezolana, Arepa Manjar Llanero, and the Classic Pabellón. Unfortunately, the meat for all of the entrees were very tough, which we mentioned to our waiter. He was very polite and offered to replace the dish, but by that point we weren’t in the mood for anything else.

We hope to have a better experience with the food next time, as the concept and atmosphere truly stand out.

author: Nolan Rizzo
review_text: This restaurant is exceptional! This is hands down our best meal my wife and I had on our vacation. The atmosphere, Service and Food were all wonderful! Our waiter Luis was so nice and helpful walking us through the menu and giving us recommendations which were perfect! My wife ordered the Maracaibo sampler which gives you a little bit of everything and it was delicious! Luis walked us through everything that came with the sampler.  I ordered the Patacon Apollo Mechado and it was incredible! To finish off this awesome meal we ordered the flan and it was the best I have ever had. We enjoyed our experience so much we made reservations to eat here again before we leave. Thank you Luis for our wonderful experience. We will be back for the service and food!

author: danny velez
review_text:
Of all the things to say about this place, I'll start by saying that the food is great, the atmosphere is great, and the portion sizes are great.

This place is all about getting that perfect picture for Instagram but without compromising on taste. All their drinks come in special glass.

The food is delicious. The wait times aren't too bad, though sometimes it appears like they're completely packed (cause that parking situation is bad). Speaking of parking, they have valet as well.

Pass by and enjoy great food with a great staff at great prices, especially if you've never had typical Venezuelan food.

author: Jo Gu
review_text: The experience was great, it was really a piece of Venezuela in New Jersey. We had the example as an appetizer, then we had soup, pabellon and patacon everything tasty and delicious; for dessert cabello de Angel tres leches cake wow definitely recommended.

author: Natasha Reyes
review_text: This restaurant and it’s staff has been the best by far I’ve ever been to and that’s including Disney! Our waiter Jose Gonzalez was absolutely attentive and did it all with warmth and welcoming hospitality. The food is all delicious! Can’t wait to come back

author: Mike V
review_text:
I had the best experience celebrating my mom’s birthday at Maracaibo Restaurant in Union City! From the moment we walked in, the service was warm, welcoming, and attentive — they truly made us feel like family. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and came out fresh and perfectly prepared. On top of that, the prices were very reasonable, which made the evening even better.

The staff went above and beyond to make my mom’s special day memorable, and we couldn’t have asked for a more perfect celebration. If you’re looking for a place with amazing service, great prices, and outstanding food, I highly recommend Maracaibo. We’ll definitely be back! 🎉👏

author: Interstellar Productions
review_text:
Food was low quality and bland with no flavor, whoever the chef is has got no creativity on his food, it was dishes one expects at a fast food truck.

Plato Navideño ; Waiter was rude instead of helpful and made a rude comment telling me he didn’t care.  This is when  I told him the salad was too small of a portion for the price of almost $30. It was the chicken salad. The hallaca had no flavor on it’s stew and corn flour. I would give it 1 out of 10.  And the Ham bread it was the smallest two slices i ever received in any restaurant. Listen you are not Gourmet , it’s street food value food and by putting it in a fancy carousel Does not make it fancy . Small portions don’t help either unless you’re running out of business and are portioning your budget.

Maracaibo Parrilla , it was small boring and nothing fancy but it’s decor.

The Sopa de Lenteja; was bit watery and miss the flavor it was meant to have. It did have pork for smokiness. Nothing good or fancy about it. Almost bland. Try some flavor meat stock instead of water to get that intended flavor. Or let it cook little longer to get the lentils to become thicker and flavors to come throughout.

Desserts were the typical boring what you expect from a food truck , I didn’t bother to waste my time with another flan or tres leches.  Be original and invent this old recipes and turn them into fusion beauties.

Overall food was bland and missed the mark, and the poor portions in pretending to be a fancy Michelin restaurant its failed missionary. They spend more money on the look which attract young audiences of a tick tock and Instagram flair.

And finally just another Venezuelan restaurant playing with the nostalgia of those who seek an authentic flavor.

author: Cynthia Salamanca
review_text:
5-Star Review for Maracaibo

I had an absolutely spectacular experience at Maracaibo and can’t stop thinking about how perfect the evening was from start to finish. Everything from the moment we arrived to the final farewell felt thoughtfully curated and genuinely guest-centric.

Service
Alex Valencia** was beyond amazing. From the moment we sat down, he exuded warmth, attentiveness, and a remarkable amount of knowledge about the menu and pairings. He anticipated our needs before we even realized them—refilling drinks without being asked, recommending dishes tailored to our preferences, and sharing little stories about the ingredients and origins behind each plate.
His troubleshooting for a dietary preference without compromising flavor was flawless: he suggested alternative preparations that maintained the integrity and style of the dishes we loved. He checked in at just the right intervals, offering gracious pauses between courses so we could fully savor the experience.
Alex’s genuine enthusiasm for the cuisine and for ensuring we had a memorable night shone through in every interaction. He treated us like VIP guests and left us feeling warmly cared for long after the check was settled.

Food
The menu showcased a masterful balance of bold flavors and thoughtful technique. Every course felt intentional and cohesive with the overall dining narrative.
Star dishes included [insert standout dishes if you know them], each delivered with precise execution: vibrant textures, harmonious seasonings, and impressive presentation.
The pacing was perfect. Courses arrived in a rhythm that allowed us to appreciate the artistry without feeling rushed, and the kitchen’s timing was consistently on point.

Venue
The venue is truly stunning—an atmosphere that feels both inviting and refined. The interior design, lighting, and acoustics contributed to a warm, celebratory mood without being stuffy.
The dining room offers a sense of intimacy while still feeling expansive, and the ambient music complemented our conversation rather than competing with it.
The bar area deserves special mention for its chic vibe and the bartender’s flair—great craft cocktails and carefully chosen wine pairings that elevated each course.

Overall Experience
From the welcome to the farewell, the entire Maracaibo experience was elevated, professional, and joy-filled. The staff’s attentiveness, the cuisine’s sophistication, and the venue’s beauty combine to create a rare, memorable evening.
If you’re looking for a dining experience that excels in hospitality, flavor, and atmosphere, Maracaibo is a standout choice and definitely a 5-star destination.
We left inspired by the care and passion evident at every touchpoint, and we’re already planning our next visit to relive this special night.

Recommendation
Highly recommend asking for Alex Valencia by name when you book for an extra layer of personalized service.
Consider the tasting menu or chef’s specials to truly savor the kitchen’s breadth and depth.
If you have dietary needs or celebrations, share them in advance; the team is incredibly accommodating and will tailor the experience to you.

In short: Maracaibo delivered a flawless, memorable evening. Five stars all the way!!!!! Los Amo!!!

author: Mariana Raquel
review_text:
This is a must try! I’m from Maracaibo, Venezuela🥹
This place is the best Venezuelan restaurant that I have tried in my 4 years living in New York. Went with my family to celebrate my brother’s birthday, drinks were amazing, had a Polar negra, had the Cara-Caracas and a cepillao (This one came with music, made me feel at home). We shared the Mcbo-sampler to start, my favs were the mini Cachapas and the tequeños. Then we had main course, I shared an arroz chinozuela (20/20), I tried the asado negro, patacón de pernil and we also shared the Parrillada Maracaibo. Everything was delicious, atmosphere and playlist were amazing, staff were super kind and attentive with me and my family, they even sang happy birthday with us, I truly appreciated it. If you are thinking about going here or somewhere else, just don’t think it twice and go to Maracaibo, you will not regret it. Thank you guys for making my brother’s birthday dinner very special. ❤️‍🩹

author: Fatima & Juan Carlos Benitez
review_text: What a gem of a find!! We had our eye on it for a while and today was the day to check it out and it sure did not disappoint! From the atmosphere, the delicious food, and the friendly staff, our experience was the best we’ve had in a while. We had never tried Venezuelan food and it’s so nice to find out  we have one so close to  home! Posted a few of the things we ordered. Give it shot, you won’t be disappointed! Shout out to Harold Guevara and his amazing team for taking care of us as if we were in their home ❤️ thank you, we’ll be back again!

author: bianca macedo
review_text: This was my first time at Maracaibo Restaurant  and I will definitely go back. I really loved everything. The food was amazing , the service was incredible. Our waiter Harold was so lovely and friendly. We highly recommend this place. Thank you !

author: Ray Mendez
review_text:
I fell in love with this place. The food? Absolutely exquisite! every bite tastes like Venezuela itself, rich, soulful, and made with love. The papelón? To die for, sweet like a memory you never want to let go of. And for my birthday, they surprised me with a golfeado.. soft, warm, and sweeter than the gesture itself.

The people here aren’t just kind, they’re tender, genuine souls who make you feel at home the second you walk in. This week alone, I’ve already been twice that’s how good it is. It’s not just a restaurant; it’s a little piece of home, a hug disguised as a meal.

author: Carla Acosta
review_text: I am Venezuelan and I enjoyed this place very much. They have a large selection of food and drinks. Price is very reasonable giving the area. The portions are good as well. We tried the arepas, steaks and appetizers. The music was a little too loud for my taste and I think they could pick better restaurant music to provide a more relaxing experience to their customers. Otherwise, everything was on point, clean and good customer service! I want to come back soon

author: Marcela Lindo
review_text: Came to the restaurant for a private event so we were upstairs. They have valet parking which is great because it’s in a busy area. They work off tips. We were greeted upon entering. The event space is really nice with a bar area. Loved how they set it up. Servers were very attentive. The appetizers were delicious. My faves were the calamari and chicharron. The food was buffet style which included sweet plantains, white rice, chicken and beef. They also had salmon. They served churros and tres leches as the dessert. The churros were so good and fresh!

author: Katherine Melo
review_text: Amazing experience at Maracaibo! The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor and beautifully prepared. The service was outstanding, especially Frandery )Frank), who was incredibly attentive and kind. Even though we arrived close to closing time, we were made to feel truly welcome. Exceptional food and service. Highly recommended!

author: Carlos Aguilar
review_text: Truly a phenomenal restaurant with excellent service.  Our server, Daniel Castillo, was outstanding and guided us through the menu. I was really impressed with the details.

author: Mayra Ortiz
review_text: At first when I saw the menu i didn’t know what it was and I was unhappy, than came our waiter to help us explain the what the dish were I was still a little off until the appetizers came they were delicious than came the main course I was blow away with the taste and the  presentation I do say you need to try this restaurant if your not sure exactly the menu  is ask for help and they would be gladly to help I do t like to give  5* but they deserve it. You might think it’s expensive but it’s not we had drinks appetizer main dish and dessert all for under 150. Yes we order many drinks

author: Just Me
review_text:
Between the taste of the food, the hospitable service, the atmosphere. I was thrilled to have learn about this place for the first time! My husband being Venezuelan now I know he’s not alone. It’s not easy finding great Venezuelan places like these.

The pork chops from the parrillada extravaganza were INCREDIBLE soooo tender. The tequenos were unbelievable with their dipping sauces!

Please if you’re in town, or want to have a birthday party or you just want to go for drinks and appetizers come try this place! It’s incredible 🙌🏼❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥

author: Preeti Sharma
review_text:
Rainy day + Namaste Momo Cottage = perfect combo 🥟
Veg noodles were comforting and veg steamed & fried momo were fresh, amazing, clearly made with love. And the ghar wali chai (off-menu!) just hit different when it’s raining. Such a good stop, coming back for sure!

author: Vivek Vijay
review_text: Really nice cozy food. There is lot of love and story in the store and the team than just the food.

author: Go Local New Jersey
review_text: Had some of the most comforting food of my life here at this hidden gem. The momos were so filling and satisfying and paired great with the paneer. Jhol Momos are great if you want to eat something warm on a cold day. If you love Indian or Chinese food you need to try this restaurant out! I only wish the restaurant was a little bigger so I could invite more people.

author: Prabina Bhattrai
review_text: Momo Nepali Authentic Food delivers an unforgettable taste of Nepal with its expertly crafted momos and traditional dishes. The flavors are rich, with a perfect balance of spices that bring comfort and authenticity in every bite. The cozy atmosphere and attentive service make it feel like a home away from home. A must-visit for anyone craving genuine Nepali cuisine.

author: Ashish Upreti
review_text: Had the Chill momo and steam Momo. The Best Nepali Momo in all of new Jersey. Authentic Nepali taste !! One of few places in US, where I really enjoyed the momo.

author: allison thornton
review_text:
Got the chili momo. So good! Clean flavors, perfectly fried momo; the tomato chili based sauce balanced with diced sweet onions and red and green peppers, not over sauced, not oily. Packaged tight so nothing spilled into the paper takeout bag. Included in my bag was a cup of a lighter tomato-based sauce and another of a chili paste at the spice level of fresh wasabi. I’m new to this food/dish, and this restaurant, and now after one dish I’m a fan.

I thought it may of been pricy, but there’s maybe 8-10 momo in the serving. One of the women told me about the 3-5pm ‘happy hour’ with lower prices. The menu on the wall is a lil different from the website, is different from Google. Meh. It was a lil frustrating til I arrived then I got it.

It’s a neighborhood spot; you instantly feel the warmth when u enter. It feels like a family dining room inside an abandoned bodega, and I would totally invite some friends and eat there. There’s a great Mom Energy coming from the ladies in there, and that energy is also in the food. I’m going back. At whatever time of day. I ate it all. Maybe next time I’ll share.

author: John Hu
review_text: A no-frills place with very friendly staff serving a specialized menu.  I opted for the combo of steamed veg momos with veg chow mien.  The freshly steamed momos went great with the accompanying sauces.  I found the chow mien very delicious (sweet and savory) as a straightforward dish.  I'll need to come back and try the other momos.

author: Shareen Fatima
review_text: Chanced upon this place coincidentally while out and about. It’s a deli that also sells Nepalese food. Confirmed with the cashier that the chicken is halal. Tried their combo 4 box which included 5 pieces of chicken momos and a side of vege chow mein. The momos were fresh with the right amount of spicy. They give a side of sauce and spicy chutney to go with it for extra kick. Price is good for the amount of food you get. Do visit if you enjoy momos, I know I’m definitely going back for more :)

author: Shouvik Maazumder
review_text: I opted for a catering from this place for a small gathering at my place yesterday and I couldn't be happier with the experience! The lady who assisted me was incredibly sweet and accommodating, making the entire process seamless. The food, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, was absolutely delicious and a huge hit with all of my guests. Everyone loved the authentic Nepali cuisine, with the flavors being truly outstanding. I highly recommend Namaste Momo Cottage for anyone looking to enjoy great food with excellent service. Lastly, chicken chilli momos is highly recommended.

author: Shivani sharma
review_text: I ordered three items from this restaurant, but I was very disappointed. The food was really disgusting. The chutney was made without salt, and the vegetables used in the chow mein and fried veggie momos were all raw. Never order potato chili; you will get mashed potato with sweet and sour sauce. I feel like I wasted my money, and I definitely won't be going back. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant for momos.

author: Sanchit Kamath
review_text: Have been seeing this place since 2021 and today finally made a move inside. The ambience over here gives you a typical Nepali vibe and a little space for the seating area. I was craving Momos for a long time and today I'm glad to have it. I had ordered chicken Momos. The dish came along 2 sauces( 1 spicy, 1 regular) and a rice kheer. The spicy sauce was enough to make my nose runny, the other sauce was fine whereas the kheer too was okay. Coming to the chicken Momos, the staff said that they make it fresh in the morning and deep freeze it.. honestly, I didn't get the logic behind it as it's officially frozen but once they steamed it.. it did feel a bit fresh compared to what a fully freshly made momo would feel like. Honestly, I was expecting a fresh product here in a Nepali restaurant and I would admit that I felt a bit down after seeing the frozen momo. Overall the taste was above average as of now since this is the first time I've had Momos in this country! Btw  the staff is friendly over here. Looking to try out a few more dishes next time!

author: Tania Zaman
review_text: Amazing food!!! This an absolute must if you are looking for reasonably priced momos in NJ. Sooo good. Recommend the Chilli momos! My younger daughter also loves the Schezuan Chicken Noodles. Have returned 3 times and will continue.

author: Anjan Pariyar
review_text:
Food was great. It has a authenticity.

I highly recommend anyone to try and feel the taste of Nepali food here.

author: Geocentricity
review_text:
The momos reminds me of how my mom makes dumplings. An order of steamed came with 10, plump momos with noticable hints of spice and sweetness.

The two sauces are very contrasting: yellow is a slight curry/turmeric flavor and not salty while the red was spicy and strong flavor of dried chilis and maybe paprika. Eventually I ate them plain and it felt right. The seating area is small and cramped, plus most of the store is like a deli.

Although $12 for 10 pieces seems kinda steep currently, the quality of the momos will bring me back again.

author: Dhanush Sirohi
review_text:
Love this place! It’s a hidden gem
Chowmein and momos are so tasty. True Nepalese taste. It’s must visit if you are around.
The owner is also very friendly and lovely. Would definitely visit again.

author: V M
review_text:
Hole in the wall place close to JSQ .
No frills , but amazing momos .
Had the steamed chicken and veg jhol momos , both made freshly by the woman who runs the place . Very authentic feel - almost like eating in your own home kitchen!

They also recently started chaat . They gave us samples to taste - pani puri and dahi puri . Also pretty good!

author: Gregory Varshavskiy
review_text: HIDDEN GEM! My wife and I came in for lunch on Sunday and Deepa welcomed us and made us feel like family. Every dish we ordered was exquisite and made fresh for us. You can really tell that Deepa and her family are artists and the kitchen is their studio 😋

author: Harsh Kothari
review_text:
Their chili momo’s are really good, you got to try it and i also liked their chawmen.

Fried rice and chili panner was average.

author: Tarun Goud Golyalla
review_text: Looking for quick grab in the evening for a snack? You are at the right place. Must not miss the Chilli momos, and specially the crispy ones.

author: YouToobr
review_text: We had Chow Mein and chilly momo. Chow mein and chilly momos were good. Unlike Chinese lo mein the chow Mein isn't sweet and that's fine because they have the flavor of garlic, onions, and peppers to compliment. Would visit again when In the area.

author: Christopher
review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience. This was supposed to be my birthday dinner, and instead it turned out to be the worst one I’ve had. My girlfriend originally wanted to take me to Mama Sushi for a nice celebration, but after leaving the spa I decided I wanted Popeyes since I hadn’t had it in a while, and we could share it with her mom at home.

I placed my order online for pickup. When I arrived, the cashier didn’t realize I had ordered 2 drinks—I had to remind him. While he got them, I checked my bag and saw I only had 1 small coleslaw instead of the large I ordered, and 3 small mashed potatoes instead of 1 large (which is NOT the same).

When I got home and opened the chicken, it was old, possibly recooked, burnt, and completely dried out. I have pictures of everything—it was unacceptable. On top of that, my Popeyes signature sauce was missing.

This location completely ruined what should have been an enjoyable birthday meal. I regret not going to Mama Sushi instead. I will never return to the Popeyes on Kennedy Blvd in North Bergen, and I’ll be sharing this review and the photos on my Instagram review page.

author: Sky Cruz
review_text:
Very slow service. No greeting. I ordered fries that were not full and boneless wings with barely drops of sauce. Would not consider this at least on a weekend during dinner.

It was obvious who was the leader with the designated gray shirt. He had no communication with staff. The staff seemed ahead of him.

author: Shanmugavel SRD
review_text: Spicy chicken sandwich, sweet and spicy chicken wings were delicious. Service is awesome. Order was ready within 10 mins. Dine in is available but less number of tables, so may be hard to get tables during peak hours. Free parking available but depends on the time it may be free or hard to find parking.

author: saroj lenka
review_text:
First time from this store, so tried the ghost pepper wings.
Once at home opened the box, there was no sauce/ranch. Anyways we tasted fried wings, but never felt any spicy from ghost pepper. Not sure why it's ghost pepper wings.

author: Bhavadeep Kalikiri
review_text:
This is the worst Popeyes I have ever been to.
It tastes soooo bad!!!!!!!!
Makes me feel this is place is not real and tried to replicate Popeyes even tho it’s real.

I Highly recommended to never stop here!

author: Mary Ochoa
review_text: This morning I was served by a very kind young lady who provided excellent service. I congratulate her on her good service.

author: Humberto Contla
review_text: I ordered online for pick up and showed up and still had to wait almost an hour for chicken. They kept missing my order and when I complained about it, the manager really told me if I wanted my money back because I’m being impatient poorly manage and I believe the manager had horrible customer service. This is the second Popeyes of this area that I’m avoiding. for now on, I’m using mom and Pops chicken spots.

author: Roger Khan
review_text:
I can no longer put off writing this review about this store, its quality of food and service is the worse.🤬 In comparison with the other store also located on JFK Blvd this one is no better. There seems to be no quality check, the manager always looks sloppy and untidy. They also appears to be short of staff all the time, no proper greeting or communication.
Just ordered the dinner special from them and it was tasteless to say the least, the spicy chicken was awful,🤮 had to ask for the rice and beans be changed as the first one was probably sitting in the heater for a while and looked old and dry.🤮 sweet tea is diluted and neither sweet nor tea.
I do not recommend this store and will not return.
I hope that Popeyes Corporate reads these reviews and step up an inspection of these stores.

author: India Praire
review_text: If I could give zero stars, I would. Service was extremely poor — staff prioritized online orders and ignored customers in-store. I had to wave multiple times before being acknowledged. There was a complete language barrier, including with the manager, and staff showed visible frustration because I don’t speak Spanish. They insisted I use the kiosk even though I was paying with cash. Food handling was unsanitary, with no gloves worn and bare hands touching the parchment paper and placing it in the container and patting it down to stay in place. A clearly posted in-store promotion was denied, and only after using Google Translate was I told it was ‘online only,’ despite the signage stating otherwise. I reached out to corporate, but have yet to receive a response.

author: Paul Castro
review_text: Let’s start with how long it takes them to serve chicken, if it was fresh I wouldn’t mind. My chicken was re fried maybe twice it was brown the tenders were cold and when I asked to get fresh food they lady at the counter gave me a dirty look like I’m going to spend money on old chicken. I asked for napkins and I got one. The biscuits were old and hard. Avoid this place save your money !!!

author: christina peterson
review_text: CLOSE THIS POPEYES DOWN. worst in everything. workers don’t care and will laugh in your face when order isn’t correct and won’t help. management is the same way. horrible horrible. bad representation for popeyes brand.

author: Tatianna Benitez
review_text: I nicely ask the Indian guy for her to please put a hair nit on cause he pony tail was loose all around the food he looks like he was upset I felt that way went to the side where she was putting mash in a plate still with hair Loose he went and was whispering with her cause she look back at me with an upset face waited a while and went to tie it in a bun still no hair nit also for the price your paying they give you just bone or skin barely no meat then the soda machine was removed so you gotta wait till there done dealing with people just to get a refill with a little ice it’s a nightmare they Handel Uber eats people 1st and you gotta wait long time just to get your food  sad we paying for this and to have to wait to get more soda it’s even worse

author: junior
review_text: I rarely write reviews, but after my experience at Popeyes, I felt I had to. First off, the service was incredibly slow I waited over 20 minutes for a simple order, and when I finally got it, half of it was wrong. The chicken was dry and barely warm, and the fries were limp and soggy like they'd been sitting out for hours. The restaurant itself wasn’t clean either, tables were sticky, and the floor looked like it hadn’t been mopped all day. Honestly, I expected way better. Definitely not worth the money or the wait.Wont be suprised if place gets shutdown anytime soon don’t come here you’ll regret it please don’t go 0/10.

author: Marcus Delgado
review_text: Ordered a 5pc tender from this popeyes location, spent abour $40 and they didnt give me what i ordered. Instead i got a 3 pc chicken instead of what i ordered which was 5 pc tenders. They shoulda at least called me and returned me my money but no. Terrible spot dont order from here, what a waste of money! Disappointing

author: Jaquise Smith
review_text: My order was correct with nothing out of stock. The food was hot and fresh. Customer service was excellent, even though it was busy, he still maintained a professional attitude. This will be my go Popeyes from now on! 😋

author: Timothy Auyeung
review_text:
I ordered takeout, I went there and order from the kiosk and when they packed my food I had to remind them of the drink they haven't given me and then now I get home there is no French fries in my box.......for my meal......this place is a disgrace.

Reporting you to corporate for being straight terrible at what you do.

author: Delbert Diaz
review_text: Great service by Mamshi who was the server, would recommend, very clean and nice AC didn’t feel the heat from outside. Food was fresh and asked for specific piece of chicken and was giving without any issue I’m happy and full of joy thanks

author: Jesus Tovar
review_text: Great food place!! (As we know it’s Popeyes) very respectful and accommodating the people who work there!! :)

author: Michelle Waddell
review_text: Staff this place. The wait time has ALWAYS been terrible. Terrible since they opened. The kiosk makes it worse.

author: Katiuska Molinet
review_text: Everything was wrong. Super disaster. Dirty tables all of them. Too long line and people does not know want to do. The attendants without gloves. It loook like a kiosk in the Middle East. This is not represent America.

author: Greeshma Pulinkuzhy Balan
review_text: I had the Birria Tacos from here. Those were the best I have ever had till now. Nice ambience, service and good music too. Giving 9.5/10😍😍

author: Jamesline Jeudy
review_text:
9/10 Quesa Birria Tacos

I got the Quesa Birria Tacos. They were so tasty, Best I've ever had in my life, NO EXAGGERATION!!!. I think they also improved the recipe cause last time I tried it it was however a little salty, but this time it was perfect!!! You guys got yourselves a frequent customer!!💖💖💖

author: Karen G.
review_text: We loved the Birria tacos with consumé and the chipotle chicken loaded nachos. Both were delicious and the portions were very generous.  Grace was our server and she was friendly, kind and lovely.  I hope the owners of this establishment appreciate what a great employee they have in Grace.

author: Noah Spiegel
review_text: Best Birria I’ve ever had. Flavored to perfection. The Salsas added some wonderful heat and overall boost of flavors (not that it was needed). 10/10 service. 10/10 food. Will be coming back.

author: Mallory Quinn
review_text: The staff is SO friendly and welcoming. My boyfriend ended up getting their birria torta after an employee recommended it to us and he loved it. Their esquites is also incredible. This place feels like a hidden gem and if we lived in NJ, we would definitely become regulars!

author: Jason B. Ruda, MS, CPXP
review_text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND.  The food here is exceptional. The braised beef was to die for. Amazing flavor. Highly recommend the birria tacos. The loaded carnitas nachos were spectacular.
