They also have great house made hot sauces. I got the braised beef rice plate and almost licked the plate clean.

author: Juan Carlos Sulbaran
review_text:
If I could give more than five stars, I would! This taco restaurant is hands down one of the best spots I’ve ever eaten at. The food is packed with flavor — every taco feels fresh, authentic, and made with care. But what truly made the experience unforgettable was our waiter, The young lady.
She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, from recommending the best dishes to checking in with genuine warmth and kindness. She has a way of making you feel not just like a customer, but like a guest being welcomed into someone’s home. Her attentiveness, professionalism, and bright energy elevated the entire experience.

author: Sandra M
review_text: From the first time I went to Chofi's, I was instantly hooked with their tasty and flavorful birria tacos and consume. Very authentic local Mexican restuarant that has many traditional items on their menu and all for a great price. Highly recommend their aguas frescas, and they are also BYOB so you can easily make your own margaritas. There are only a few tables to eat at inside the restaurant but the atmosphere is fun and cozy. Service is excellent, always greeted joyfully despite how busy it usually is. Will continue making this my go to spot for birria tacos and Mexican food in general

author: Melissa Checo
review_text:
I was on the hunt for Birria tacos in NJ, and I found this paradise. The tacos and quesadillas completely stole my heart 💖.

The only thing I’d suggest is adding a delivery or pick-up option because the line can be pretty long, but once you get the food, it’s totally worth the wait. Everything else is excellent!

Update 2025: Chofi has expanded—or I think they moved to a new location! Now, you can go, sit, order, and eat there. It’s so much more comfortable and pleasant to visit. They’ve added delivery, and the quality of the food is still on point. I’ve developed a new obsession: Torta Birria (you have to try it, you’ll thank me later).

author: Sargam Bhambri
review_text: Incredible birria tacos!! And now they deliver in the JC area on DoorDash! So delicious. And def worth trying if you’re in the area.

author: HR
review_text:
Overpriced and Small portions!
The cost of food is too high for the amount of food they give you. I was so insulted with the size of the consomé. I have purchased a couple of times, I now can say the quality had also decreased. So for sure I wont be buying from here ever again.
I’m also not surprised to read how they just stole (took) recipes from extended family in Mexico (for the wanna be Mexican lady) and monetized it here. That for me is still appropriation.

author: Henny Salcedo
review_text: My friends and I visited yesterday after our trip to American dream and getting to this palace it was pretty lowkey but the atmosphere and ambiance was so cute, my type of place for sure. Most of us order birria tacos and one of us had the chicken tacos. The tacos were super fresh and csn see them making everything for you ugh they were amazing tacos. The only thing that we didn’t like as much were the horchatas but aside from that 10/10 tacos 😩

author: Nicole
review_text:
Came here for the Birria (which was flavorful and delicious), but was so pleasantly surprised when I bit into the Mole Poblano taco & Carne taco! 10/10!! Cooked and seasoned to perfection, the melty cheese, and especially the homemade crispy tortilla was a highlight! So delighted to not have to deal with premade, dry, corn or flour tortillas, their homemade tortilla definitely made this place stand out.

Service was amazing, everyone was kind and the place is super cute with a good vibe.

I’m pregnant👶🏻 and my baby was very impressed with the meal as well, moving up and down, left and right as soon as we tasted the tasty tacos. 😁

author: Ilya Geldman
review_text: Chofi Taco in Union City impressed me with their flavorful vegetarian options. The esquites were a standout—sweet corn mixed with creamy, zesty toppings that hit all the right notes. Their vegetarian taco was fresh and satisfying, packed with perfectly seasoned veggies and just the right amount of cheese. The cozy atmosphere and friendly service made the experience even better. It’s great to see a place that caters to everyone while maintaining incredible flavors! Will be back soon!!

author: Andrea Figueroa
review_text: This place has the best tacos and the best people ! The flavor is unbeatable . The Birria queso tacos are my favorite the fresh tortilla the tender shredded beef and let’s not forget the broth it’s AMAZING . Don’t forget to try their flan it’s so creamy !   They are also BYOB so bring the tequila they have the mix ♥️

author: Brandi Sponseller
review_text:
We got chips and guac with a side of salsa. The chips had a delicious crunch, they were thick and fresh. The guard was also fresh and covered in chopped onions and cilantro. Our favorite!

Food was quick and some of the best tacos we’ve ever had. Our son (10yr) got the steak quesadilla and claimed it to be the best ever, asked that we give this review.

author: Angela Ramirez
review_text:
PAMBAZO DE BIRRIA!!!! Most amazing birria dish I’ve had. The birria tacos are good but this birria torta is out of this world. The avocado elevates fhe dish. Yes everything menu sounds good, but do not miss out on the PAMBAZO DE BIRRIA!
I always order pick up as the place is on the smaller side. They also have house michelada and margaritas mixes.

author: Justyna Biełuś
review_text: Cashier is a very nice, helpful woman who can easily help you if you aren't too familiar with what suits your appetite. Overall, I had a really good experience for my first time trying Birrias. Would recommend others to try them, especially if you are sensitive to spicy foods.

author: Vanessa Ventricelli
review_text: We tried all varieties of tacos and they were all delicious! Everyone was raving about how good they were!! The taste, presentation, and freshness were superb!  The owner and Yamilet, the manager were so accommodating and wonderful to work with during our teacher appreciation week. Their kindness and generosity is appreciated. The restaurant is clean and modern looking. What a great local spot for some delicious food!

author: Michael Miranda
review_text: As a taco lover this place has the best tacos I have ever had in my life . I have to say the chef or the chefs of this place really cook their food with love . Everything is well seasoned , fresh , and authentic . A co-worker told me about this place and I have now had their food twice this week . Even with the level of business they have they still can give you the same quality of food that alone is amazing . I wish them continued and plentiful success . If you are looking for birria tacos , corn , flan , quesadillas, tostadas, look no further

author: Mikaela Romero
review_text: I went to this place a few days ago and I highly recommend it. It's the first Ecuadorian restaurant where I felt right at home. The food was incredible; I'd love to go back to try more dishes. The dessert is highly recommended. And the soursop juice, which I hadn't had in ages, was fantastic. They don't sell alcoholic beverages. We were able to get a table right away during the week without any problem. I don't remember the waiter's name, but he was very attentive the whole time.

author: 인언예불
review_text: I tried Ecuadorian food for the first time, and it was absolutely incredible. The atmosphere was wonderful, with saxophone music filling the air, and the BOYBeer paired perfectly with the meal. Everything was seasoned to perfection. I especially loved the Cazuela—a rich, thick, curry-like dish that goes so well with rice. Even after returning to Korea, I still find myself craving it. A truly memorable dining experience!

author: Naty Orellana
review_text:
Have been wanting to find an Ecuadorian place that felt authentic, this was the place. Really good service from the start and the atmosphere was great as well.

The food was amazing and came in really big portions, really tasty just like an actual Ecuadorian dish, would def recommend if you are ever looking for a great atmosphere and authentic Ecuadorian food.

author: Mitzi Robles
review_text: We drove from Orange county, NY to try this restaurant. I have been wanting to go for months and we finally went for my birthday. I called ahead and they didn't take reservations. That's unfortunate. We got there and we're told 1hr and 20min wait. That was insane but we took the chance and waited since we weren't close to home. After waiting about 70 min, in our car and some of us stood out in the cold since the place is small and there is no where to wait inside, we had even more delays because we were told that our party of 8 had to wait since the owner had arrived with some guests. I was clearly disappointed but in the end. They made adjustments for us and ended up giving us the table that was meant for the owners guests to us. Rightfully so. The servers were friendly, the food was very good, very nice presentation, the corviche was so delicious! I could have just ordered that as my meal. My only constructive criticism is that some of our soups and  cazuela were a tad salty. The tostenes did not seem fresh. Overall, I would go back and take a chance on the long wait times. Reservations for large parties 6+ would benefit both the restaurant and the guests. They had great music playing, maybe a little too loud for my taste but that's just preference. It would be nice to see some ecuadorian art on the walls perhaps from local artists. If you take a look at our photos you can see that it all looks delicious. I would recommend Moreno restaurant to parties of 2 or 4. Try the fruit juices and the corviche!

author: jarvic perez
review_text:
Overall 10/10
Food was good, it felt like being back at home. 🇪🇨
Service 10/10 staff were very attentive and I can tell they work as a team very efficiently.
Atmosphere was good, the Ecuadorian music made me feel like I was back home.
I do wish the space was a bit more spacey, however they make it work.
Que Viva Ecuador chuch@@!!!

author: O W
review_text: Great place for a delicious meal! Recommended by a friend, and did not disappoint. Although just have to warn you if you do not speak Spanish and have a big party making a reservation will be impossible. My husband tried to call and make reservation they said “no speak english” and hung up, hostess did not speak any English at all on arrival either. We were seated promptly and enjoyed our meal. The menus are digital with pictures and the waiter was able to speak a some English to help us pick dishes, he made recommendations and they were great! Overall enjoyed the experience, but would just like to warn others about the language barrier so they’re ready for it.

author: Strayn Wang
review_text:
The food is great, it has big portion (for soup as well) but we ended up buying three dishes. I was angry from the beginning but the latino waiter boy removes the tips for himself in front of me after he learns this. And i respect him for that the tips him anyway.
This is great restaurant with great service.

author: Johanna Astudillo
review_text: Great place for authentic ecuadorian food, really well conserved the taste of Ecuador. The only reason why I am not giving 5 stars is because the caldo de salchicha was too oily,  I had to remove the excess oil from the surface onto another plate so it didn't feel unpleasant in the mouth.  All dishes are very good size portion and be sure that you will not walk out of here hungry or disappointed. We had the corviche as an app which was amazing, and for entrees we had the encocado mixto and caldo de salchicha both very tasty. Also, on the house, they welcome you with a very delicious spicy sauce (aji) made in the ecuadorian way with tostado, I definitely loved it.

author: Jennifer Bello
review_text: Kevin and the all staff were amazing and very courteous. They were very attentive every moment. Delicious food! Kids menu should have more variety. No alcoholic drink but juices to choose Definitely come back

author: Angelica Giler
review_text: Best service ever, even do I had to wait 150min it was all worth it, food amazing, Maggie was so nice and friendly to us, it was a great experience, recommended. Maria Beatriz was so kind at entrance for the waiting booking time.

author: Veronica Bonilla
review_text: Great atmosphere, Delicious food and friendly staff. Our server Kevin was very attentive and helpful with menu options. Overall a great experience and we’ll be back again !

author: Laura Gomez
review_text: Food was excellent, we enjoy every meal and the atmosphere was great with the saxophone, nice and warm place to share with family and friends 👌

author: Ronald Betancourt
review_text:
It was such a heartwarming experience
the cozy décor and delicious food made it amazing . The higos con queso instantly transported me back to Ecuador.
Truly fantastic!

author: Brianna
review_text: We came here for dinner and had an amazing experience. This Ecuadorian restaurant truly delivers on flavor and authenticity. Every dish was fresh, well-seasoned, and clearly made with care. The food was comforting, flavorful, and absolutely delicious from start to finish. You can really tell pride is taken in the cooking. If you’re looking for authentic Ecuadorian food and a great dinner spot, this place is a must-try. We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Ellen Sanchezrosario
review_text: First time eating here and I can tell you it was amazing loved it coming back we were here celebrating my husband anniversary in heaven the waiter and waitress made everything amazing ty for making it awesome we appreciate it

author: Emilie Pozo
review_text: Great restaurant, amazing food, and the service was truly impecable. One of the best authentic Ecuadorian food I have tried. The only downside was the wait, so if you come here make sure to be prepared to wait. Food is worth the wait tho!

author: Michelle Ojeda
review_text:
The food was amazing, very tasty. The portions are big enough for two people.
Our server was Omar. He was very professional and made sure our visit was as pleasant as possible. I will definitely recommend this restaurant.

author: JOHANNA A.
review_text:
UPDATE: Went back and tried the encebollado (fish stew or otherwise known as the national hangover soup), the salchicha seca (blood sausage), lunch special of caldo de bola (beef, plantain and peanut soup) accompanied by grilled chicken breast with rice and red beans.
The encebollado in this case lacked flavor and onions and cilantro, possibly aji peruano. It tasted like a basic fish stew with yucca. It was loaded with fish, this is a plus. I took it home and added a fresh handful of cilantro and red onions and it was better. I would give it a 3.5, I have def had better!
The blood sausage was delicious and the portion was huge, a bit pricey coming in at almost 20 bucks! I would give it 4 stars.
Caldo de bola was delicious not to thick and not too much peanut sauce, could have used a bit more meat but overall I give it 4.5 stars.
The grilled chicken was soo tender very well cooked and flavorful, rice was good and red beans though a tad salty again, delicious. For the lunch special of 15 bucks I would give it 4.5 stars. Service was decent this time, have several staff standing around and you have to catch their attention for assistance

Overall I give them a 4.5, place is a bit inconsistent with flavors and service, but worth trying for the first time and/or to open your possibility up to the Ecuadorian cuisine.

Food was really good, but a bit salty, still edible so deserves the 5 stars. We arrived past 830pm and service was still great. Atmosphere is nice and suits the pricing of each plate. (more expensive than other Ecuadorian spots, but worth it). Tried the Desayuno Montubio (steak, peppers, onions tomato in red sauce, two eggs and a plantain cheese and pork meat/rind ball) , bolon was mixto with both sweet and regular plantain. The flavor was very different, more buttery, but very good! They did not skimp on chicharrón or cheese. The meat was tender, sauce a bit salty. Also had Seco de Gallina (Hen Stew, usually in a beer sauce). It was very good, great portion of meat, 3 big slices of sweet plantains, and a few slices of avocado. However, sauce again a bit salty. The hot sauce is amazing and the Naranjilla shake in water, was SPOT ON! For appetizer had the Maduro con Queso (sweet plantains with cheese) good portion, well cooked. It did not bring ecuadorian cheese, but available upon request. (also sell it by the pound) Def recommend trying this place out, and will def come back to try other plates

author: Jeremy Arellano
review_text:
Service was poor for a place like this. After sitting down, we were ignored for the first 15 minutes. Only after flagging down the staff were we attended to. The service given by the waiter wasn’t the best either, seeming annoyed to take our order. Basic items like utensils and napkins were lacking at the table, resorting to the one napkin left from another nearby table.

However where this place lacked in service, made up for it with the food. Dishes were incredibly flavorful, and the amount kept me feeling satisfied for the price. Overall, would get takeout from this place! However the service is something that needs to be improved

author: Valerie
review_text:
If you’re seeing this review JUST GO. Every dish was absolutely incredible! Very tasty! The wait is around 2 hours but is worth it. No reservations, just go put your name down and explore the area. Very welcoming for anyone wanting to try Ecuadorian food. If it’s your first time, go for the traditional dishes on the menu.

BYOB. Valet parking for 6 dollars (at the time of this review) but you can also find street parking.

author: Ingrid Schultze
review_text: Argentine Bakery has been my favorite since they opened abt 35 yrs. ago.  I had the honor to order my son°s engagement cake yesterday, and they did a SUPERB JOB…Love them all….as if family. Gracias Natalia for making Justin and Kelly°s day so special…the whole cake was fully consumed by attendees and are today still raving about it. Los quiero!

author: Genesis Leon
review_text: I was so pleased with my daughter’s birthday cake, as I have been with other cakes I ordered in the past. Everyone complimented the cake for its flavor. The sweetness was just right, including the frosting which was airy and velvety. I also loved the design and felt they did an amazing job delivering what I asked for. I will continue buying my cakes from Argentina Bakery.

author: niki kaur
review_text:
We ordered our baby shower 2 tier cake from Argentina bakery, this has been our go-to bakery for all big and small occasions given their exceptionally delicious cakes!

I showed them a reference picture of what I wanted, something simple with a few cake toppers (ordered by me and dropped off for them to decorate).

To say that the cake was LOVED would be an understatement, the cake was devoured within minutes. The flavors were fantastic especially their famous Dulce De Leche.

Our Tier 1 was Dulce De Leche, Chocolate with fresh strawberries and Tier 2 base was Dulce de Leche with chocolate, both were phenomenal!

Everyone at the bakery is so warm and friendly and they listen to you to deliver exactly what you need.

author: Rob
review_text: I haven’t given this place the credit it deserves since I usually order here off Uber Eats. I been buying from here occasionally for the past 6-7 years or so. Their cakes has to be one of the best cakes I’ve ever had. I’ve tried their empanadas and they’re great too but their cakes is something to die for. It’s so tasty and fulfilling. The perfect mix of sweet and flavor where some bakeries can’t get that perfect combination. I live local but never been here in person lol. I will make sure I stop by here one day to see the wonderful people who have sending me delicious treats all the years in person.

author: Tatianna Benitez
review_text: She gave me a cake saying happy birthday from your wife when it was supposed to be happy birthday from your husband and then she had the audacity to be snotty over the phone never getting a cake there not only other pricey she was rude and nasty on the phone

author: Lucy Ruiz
review_text:
Delicious cake
Was of dulce de leche, peaches and vanilla custard

author: Manjusha Ray
review_text: Love the sandwiches and the baked goods. As well as the cakes. Can't go wrong. Plus they are very nice and helpful with any questions

author: Agustina Rastelli Gatti
review_text: I got my wedding cake from here, and it was the best one I’ve ever tried ❤️ I will get my facturas today!

author: Barney Simon
review_text: The house special cake and the pastries are amazing.  Owner is friendly and super helpful

author: Joe
review_text:
Unfortunately I can’t recommend this place for its pastries. I’ve tried multiple times hoping maybe something will be different. Not sure what it is but the quality of the pastries is just not really up to par and the flavor of most of them is just dull. No butter flavor—just sort of salty/yeasty.

Dulce de Leche on Jersey City is a much better option in my opinion.

Maybe the cakes are better though—-I haven’t tried them.

author: Amber Tidwell
review_text: Stopped in here during my stay and  the gentleman working the counter was so welcoming and helpful. We couldn’t decide on one thing and ended up getting quite a few things. From the empanadas to the fall, the pastries. Everything was absolutely delicious. My favorite were the cookies/cakes Dulce de leche. We wanted to get by before we left town but didn’t make it. I was sad.

author: A. Ace.
review_text: Great variety of different cakes, sandwiches, and pastries made well and tasty. The place is always clean. The workers are helpful provide a friendly service, and are ready to serve you. Highly recommend this place.

author: Rox BO
review_text:
Update! Stopped by my favorite Argentinean bakery, got parking in front of the store and bought delicious "facturas" pastries and " sandwiches de miga" always the best food and service!!!
I have purchased many delicious food items from this place over the 30 years, since Don Carlos was there!!!!
This time I bought "Torta Balcarse" omg its decadent!!! Also the signature sandwiches de miga and facturas everything was fresh and delicious!!! Parking is difficult in that area, but after a few turn around you find it, I wouldn't take star off for that. A little far for me but totally worth the trip!!! Service was great!!!

author: Rick C
review_text:
I lived by Argentina Bakery in the mid 90s and now l live in CT. I still travel to NJ for their awesome and delicious empanadas!!!!
Great job!!!!
See you soon!!!!

author: Cristian Diaz
review_text: This place has been here for years and it is always amazing. I love all the sweets and cakes and empanadas. Gotta try it out you won't be disappointed

author: claudia p
review_text:
Best Argentian Bakery around, all the staff is Amazing and very friendly. I have been coming to them for 25 yrs +.
Highly recomend them.

author: Jackee Santiago
review_text: This is a small but wonderful bakery I have to stop here every time I come to the state of New Jersey thank you

author: Traci Bidwell
review_text: I got a cream puff and tres Leche pie. So yummy. Everything was homemade and fresh.

author: Sinrrys Flores
review_text: We love their cakes we drive from upstate NY almost every we need a cake

author: Nubia Zazzini
review_text: I been for years with my dad so i was due .i am from argentina  closet your going from Argentina its fab .i brought everything that why i went

author: Brian
review_text:
I’ve been here on several occasions but I will mention my most recent experience. We went on Thanksgiving day. Surprisingly, the place was not crowded so the staff weren’t crazy busy.

As usual I he food was well seasoned and the portions were more than generous. I give it a 10 out of 10.

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text: The food was well made. But it was not anything spectacular. The Tomahawk was pricy for the size. I have had bigger ones for the same price. The gin and tonic was mid at best. Service was good. I feel like this place is overpriced for Newark and especially the area in Newark. Hidden in the back. I think Newark has better offerings.

author: Yatin Pradhan
review_text: Great spot with old school vibes. We had the Rodizio and they do not skimp on portions. From chicken to lamb to steaks, everything was 💯. In case you do not like well done steaks, ask them for medium temps and they bring it right away. As someone on a carnivore diet, this was a perfect meal. For almost $70 pp, this is definitely a great deal.

author: Lizett Canari
review_text: Service and most importantly food was right on point!  Though a steak house, their seafood selection was also just as great.  I can't wait to go back!

author: A T
review_text:
Rodizio was amazing. The ribs were delicious! And to top it off, the cappuccino was excellent. The place was beautiful. I would have given all 5 stars for atmosphere but the music playing was very distracting and ruined the ambiance. It was playing the radio with ads.
But I would definitely come back again. Staff, can you please change the music to fine dining music or nice cafe jazz background music? 🙏🏻 I asked the waiter but he said they couldn't change it.

author: Zach Brindisi
review_text: Terrible quality food and service, do not waste your money here! I had been a loyal customer for over ten years, spending thousands of dollars and have brought many friends/family members. The past several times I’ve dined there the service has been poor and food quality is horrible. The meat is either extremely undercooked or overcooked. They simply do not come out with good quality food anymore.

author: Daniel Clyburn
review_text: This is a fine dining restaurant. Service is upscale. food choices fits all categories. Large portions. I had the duck breast which could've cooked for about 5 more minutes it was somewhat chewy but acceptable. The restaurant is large but i suggest having a reservation. Very comfortable atmosphere. I learned of this place from a conversation with an Uber driver. He raved about it and i became curious. Easter Sunday after church a few of us was trying to figure a place to go. I remembered me wanting to try this place and it was in the area. It was a good decision. Whew ... I would not have survived the backlash from my friends had it not been. We all agreed it was a good place.

author: Anel M Abreu
review_text: Best place to get great steak and seafood. The Rodisio is my favorite. Deserts are delicious and the staff is very friendly and attentive.

author: sam si
review_text:
“Rodizio Experience That Delivers!”

Went for the rodizio experience, and it did not disappoint! I got to try at least 10 different meats (I lost count because they were bringing them out so fast). While not every cut was to my taste, they were all served hot, fresh, and flavorful, which made the experience truly enjoyable.

The sides—rice, plantains, beans, and fries—were solid, with the fries being the standout. I do wish the pineapple had been grilled a bit more for that extra caramelized flavor. We also tried the lava cake which were absolutely delicious and a great way to end the meal.

A big thank you to the servers who took such great care of us. Their attentiveness made the evening even better. If you’re looking for a fun and satisfying rodizio experience, this place is definitely worth a visit!

author: Andrew Mcmahon
review_text: Staff were extremely attentive and polite. Had the filet mignon and shrimp. The sauce was delicious and surprisingly not sweet given it had slices of banana. My friend had the hamburger which was huge. Shrimp and octopus in garlic sauce appetizer, almond tart and tiramisu for dessert. I have been to all Fernandes' restaurants and all outstanding.

author: Anna Hudack
review_text: European Sea-bass is die for! Ribeye and lobster special was excellent! Shrimp & garlic and chorizo is always done perfect! By the way we just here for Sangria! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: T. Sanichara
review_text: Our experience has always been amazing! From the owner to Valentino to Raphael, the bartender, Gonzalo and the rest of the crew have always been great! Great service and great food!

author: Miguel Silva
review_text:
Food here was ok but it is a little pricey. Not saying it was bad because it wasn't just nothing special. I feel I could have gotten the same meal somewhere for a better price.
Went on a Saturday night at 8pm and it was packed. Couldn't even get into valet parking so we had to look in the street. Doesn't seem like the best area to be walking around late at night.
Make sure to make reservations.

The service was good, the issue I had personally was I felt I was being rushed. We were having apps and he came and took my plate away before I got more calamari. I felt they could have come a few times more to check on us. I was looking for a waiter because I ran out of drinks.

The place itself is nice and big. We were seated upstairs and it was pretty crowded. No music in the background but it's really loud. I could barely hear a friend 2 seats away. We also had this unnecessarily loud group behind us.

It's a 25min drive for me to get here so I probably won't be coming back. I feel I can do same or better closer to me. If I was from the area I would like to give it another shot.

author: Sam
review_text:
Went for the rodizio experience, and it did not disappoint. Tried at least 10 different meats (I lost count cause they were bringing them out so fast). Not all cuts were my taste, but they were hot and fresh.

The sides of rice, plantains, beans and fries were good (especially the fries). I wish they grilled the pineapple more though. We also had the dulce de leches cheesecake and paella. Both very good 👍

Thank you to the servers who took care of us!  We had a great time!

author: Kk Stix
review_text: Wow! One of the best Delmonicos I've ever had! Cooked perfectly and not overly seasoned like many places do. The sauce and the potatoes that came with it were delicious too! Staff was all very friendly and honestly I don't have a single complaint. Highly recommend!

author: Tanya
review_text: Had an amazing time for my mother's 70th birthday. We had a party of 12.  Staff was amazing, everyone's food was excellent!!! We will definitely be back.

author: Double R Detailing NYC
review_text: I’m never disappointed!! Great food and even better service. I just wish I had more space for the food it’s so good !

author: Nathan Folk
review_text: Worst lobster Ive had ever. It was frozen and rubbery. The butter they served with it was fake and the veal i got was even worse. The veal had no seasoning at all. The tbone was very burnt and the only half decent thing was the bread. It is way overpriced and they lie about their portion sizes. My order said it would come with 3 lobster tails and it only came with one. The veal was no more than 8 ounces when it should be about 12. It was small and pathetic. The service was pretty good though. The meals are overpriced to hell.

author: joe jacob
review_text: Great location as well as good food selection, only remarks some waiter seems comes out high-school, no clue whatsoever what they representating, management should not put them to take order like burger king, other than great food

author: Carlos Curramba
review_text: Classy set up in the dining room. The host was courteous. The staff wasn't as attentive or friendly. Had to be on top to request service. Multiple servers serviced with different styles philosophies of serving. As appetizers ordered a manchego cheese platter which was creamy,  and  portuguese chorizo (sausage) which had a grilled taste to it rather than sautéed in garlic,  delicious accompanied with bread which i removed the dough from the middle and ate the crust. Had   a Napa bottle of wine soft to the palate, and no after taste. As the main course i tried the seafood paella which was a bit dried, and T-bone steak accompanied with boiled potatoes,  rice, and vegetables. The steak was tender easy to cut into with a succulent taste to it. I'll order the steak again. I am not sure that I'd come back soon based on the staff customer service. Rating of 3.9.

author: Melissa Benbow Flowers
review_text: We ordered the vegan chicken and waffles, the banana pancakes, the skillet side (potatoes and eggs) the matcha, chamomile mint tea, and. Chai tea to go. The food is good, and the chai and matcha are fantastic. Like the ingredients they use for the matcha and chai and the tea are quality. I would definitely come back and try more menu items. I should also say the staff are nice too!

author: BK DUCHEZZ
review_text: My girlfriends and I came across this place by accident. We just wanted to grab a bite to eat before hitting the road after attending the Burna Boy concert in Newark the night before. We googled a few spots close to our Airbnb and decided on this one. I’m so glad we did. Food was good. A variety of vegan options and the server even made some suggestions. The service was courteous, friendly and warm. The atmosphere was adorable . They even had a Dj that started playing some tunes we could groove to. I loved everything about this place. I will make sure I visit again if I’m in the Newark area.

author: Cris Buck
review_text: Work brought me to the area and I stopped by for an afternoon refuel. The location was fairly unassuming but maybe that’s just me being used to the Northwest. I found it to be a wonderful establishment juxtaposed by the dense (but neat) industrial area. Better parking and interior space than I’ve grown accustomed to around here, wonderful separation and options for seating, service was quick and they’re very considerate. Last of all but most importantly, they’ve officially taken first place for best dirty chai this side of the Mississippi. Creamy but balanced, slight anise flavor that’s just perfect if you like that. Check it out. Food menu looks great just didn’t have time.

author: Pokeo Ninja
review_text: A true gem hidden in a rather industrial neighborhood! This is why I love using GoogleMaps to find places to eat when we travel: a wide selection of original salads, burgers, sandwiches, smoothies and crafted coffees and teas in a very hip setting, minutes from 95. I am writing the review so we can find this place again next time we travel this way.

author: W
review_text: Great food, we have the freshly baked chocolate cupcake, golden waffle, and pepper bacon sausage sandwich. Everything is tasty!

author: Hislight Studios
review_text: Great place with a mad chill atmospheric vibe. As a vegan, I make an effort to find places that accommodate the plant based lifestyle with more than salads, lol. Their vegan menu was very extensive. I felt a little cheat in me, so I ordered the vegan blueprint Phillychesse steak wrap. Which was phenomenal. My only issue was the portion size. I do feel that the wrap could've been bigger, but the taste of the ingredients made me overlook that. Well seasoned mock meat, with fresh veg inside. The fries were coo, no issues there. Lightly seasoned for an overall tasty vibe. I treated myself to the maple and also the blueberry vegan donuts. The blueberry was one point!! The maple could've been better. They should've been heated up a little more to truly let the donut melt in your mouth. They didn't hold well and became less enjoyable as time went on. But the blueberry was definitely more of the hit for me. I would definitely recommend this place, and I do plan to visit again.

author: Aija ivy
review_text: This place is beyond great! The customer service, the food, the environment is all 10/10. I have nothing bad to say about this place ever. The Blueprint Vegan Burger is my favorite…I love how they give you vegan cheese options or vegan sauce options too. Every time I go there I always see Ivan at the register or serving customers. He is a great part of BluePrint Cafe & I hope the owner knows that. Everything in the bakery is just as amazing as the food. I recommend this place to everyone!

author: Samantha Fitzgerald
review_text: I wish I caught our server’s name—he was excellent! From the time I called to check if seating was available to even after dropping the check, our server was prompt, attentive, and had our entire group laughing. The food was great with many vegan options. We enjoyed the atmosphere, and it was very clean. It has its own parking lot which made everything easy. Perfect place to go if you need to be close to Newark Penn Station.

author: Melissa Sheehan
review_text: Vegan-friendly! The menu had multiple vegan options available. Portions are massive. I had the tofu scramble which was just OK - wish it had more developed flavor. I could taste the spices, but something was missing. My partner had the sausage omelet and enjoyed it. The interior is very cute and well-decorated. There is seating outdoors as well. The parking lot is right before the building and can be easily missed.

author: Atia Allen
review_text: I went here to celebrate my daughter’s 24th bday back in January. Me and my family had such a great time!!! It was a chill atmosphere and we were able to simply relax and enjoy ourselves. The food was phenomenal!!!!!!!! My boyfriend and I went back last weekend but we arrived right before closing and were unable to dine in. I wanted to introduce him to the establishment since he had never been. We arrived too late, but we will definitely try again another time.

author: Jacquelyn Boyett
review_text:
Stumbled upon this amazing Gem. Amazing!! My partner and I really enjoy the whole experience. Victory was our server. She was absolutely adorable and helpful. She also made our tea really well. Her spirit was very warm and welcoming. She always came back to us with a smile everytime.  The food was soooooooooo good. I'm a vegan, my partner is not. It was nice to accommodate both of our food needs/wants. Food was a 10/10. The place is a vibe. The decor is industrial/ rustic with high ceilings. They had an amazing DJ the day we went. He kept some good beats going!!
I really enjoyed my time there. We will be back

author: mike professionaal
review_text: This was my first time at this spot and it was great! Definitely going back, the food was amazing with something for everyone! Carnivore? Vegan? Pescatarian? They got you! Rustic decore is brilliant! It's the Blueprint to good eating! Forgive the pics we was so hungry and the food was so good I almost forgot to take pics.

author: Aliee Delvalle
review_text: I got the chicken wings, they were good saucy but tasted dry. I forgot the name of the burger but it looked as amazing as it tasted! First food place we tried in Newark NJ! The service was spectacular and that’s what would bring us back.

author: Onika Burrowes
review_text:
IVAN is amazing!! My sister and I have been coming to this cafe for 3years or more and it is much better when  IVAN is working because his patience is amazing.  We both are picky eaters and picky coffee drinkers.

Out of all the employees who work at this cafe Ivan is the best not just I say so but people who were recommended to come here.  What a humble young man!

The food is pretty good!!!!!!!!!!  My favorite is the Blueprint vegan burger and my sister's is the vegan sausage sandwich.

The prices for the food as raised which was surprising. Which Slows me down from coming as often.

But overall the environment and food  Deserve more than a 5  start.

So check it out if you are ever in the area you're not going to regret it.

author: Magna Gopal
review_text: Super cute café, off the beaten path in Newark. Great ambience and music in a huge open and eclectic space. Food was pretty good - had the stuffed French toast & chicken and waffles.

author: Nathalie
review_text: Food is pretty good! As a vegan, i like that they have a good amount of options for me ! So far I’ve had the tofu scramble & vegan cheesesteak wrap, & both were good. I also tried their vegan maple walnut donut which was amazing . Sunday’s they have a DJ, which is pretty cool ! The server’s are nice & friendly. Overall, great experience. I’ve been here twice & will def be coming back again to try their other menu items.

author: Yager
review_text: I recently visited Blueprint Café, and although I arrived close to closing time, Ivan still provided excellent service with a welcoming and positive attitude. His professionalism and warm demeanor made such a strong impression on me that I’ve decided this will be my go-to spot for work on a daily basis, if possible. I’m so happy to have discovered this hidden gem in Newark. Having lived here all my life, I never knew this place existed, but you can be sure I’ll be telling all my friends about both Blueprint and Ivan’s incredible service!

author: Sharayna Christmas
review_text:
I visited Blueprint Café for the first time today for brunch and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. I ordered the chicken and waffles, but the chicken was undercooked and the waffle looked nothing like what was shown on their website—it was thick, tough, and difficult to chew.

When I shared these concerns with the staff, they didn’t offer to remake the dish or even ask how I wanted to proceed. Instead, they simply took the same plate and put it in the oven to re-cook it, despite it being a fried chicken dish that should be prepared fresh. I was honestly shocked by this approach. There was no apology, no offer of a replacement, and not even a gesture like offering a drink while I waited.

In the end, we left the food as it was, paid for the meal, and walked out. Given the undercooked chicken and the lack of basic customer service, I would not return to this establishment.

author: Jeffrey Osborne
review_text: Such a great low key place to get work done on a busy weekday, most people won’t travel that far from the downtown area so the foot traffic isn’t terrible, no distractions, great environment and even better food options ( vegan )

author: Darlene Laplante
review_text: I’ve been driving past this place for a while as it’s on a “trucker’s road”. TikTok led me here and I’m glad it did cause the food , the live DJ on weekends and the calm atmosphere was. 10/10!

author: Renato Miranda
review_text:
I visited Casanova during a special event and had a great time. They served many Brazilian pastries such as coxinha, pastel, chicken pie and churrasco steak and they were all delicious. The staff members I interacted with were friendly and helpful.

Parking around this area is challenging since it's near the Ferry st area but if you check Spot Hero, Park Whiz or any other parking apps you'll find many parking lots on Raymond Ave (10 minute walk) for $10.

author: Khaled Bejdough
review_text: Hi , this afternoon was my 1st at this venue. The employees are kind, helpful, hospitality Is top notch. The restaurant Is clean, the entree’s are very delicious too. Will be coming back again

author: Christopher R.
review_text: Great food, well seasoned, adequately priced, and bigger than expected portions. Good beer selection, too. There was a live band that was a bit too close to the tables and a bit too loud, but it didn't take away from the experience too much. We'll be sitting inside next time.

author: Jony Santos
review_text: This is the best Brazilian restaurant ever, the food is fresh and delicious, the staff are totally kind, there’s bands playing music whole day, and the owner is the the icing on the cake, this guy knows how to make it the best experience. If you’re not brazilian, you i’ll feel like you’re, try the “caipirinha”, trust in me, you never tried anything like that before.

author: Fillipe Candido-Fraga
review_text: I love this place. It was one of my go-to spots when I visited North Jersey. It's a Brazilian place and they mainly speak Portuguese. They have nightly live music, both Brazilian and American songs. Great atmosphere. It's becoming a regular spot for me when visiting Northern NJ.

author: Jonathan Speights
review_text: All food great. Service not to bad just gotta grab attention when drinks are needed

author: B.
review_text: Food was great but the service was horrible. The waitress was nice but after bringing us our drinks and food, she disappeared. We finally ordered drinks with her and another server and didn’t receive those drinks until over a half hour later. The workers/servers were taking shots with the locals at the bar. There was only one guy for the entire restaurant going around serving all the different meat for the ridizio. That is UNACCEPTABLE, especially on a busy day like Father’s Day. There were also a bunch of solicitors coming in trying to sell stuff to everyone. Not sure what type of management they have, but they definitely need to make some adjustments to their service.

author: binho Motorcycle Club
review_text:
The place is very bad, terrible service. They forced us to give a tip, which was already included in the bill. I will never go back to this place again. Everything is very bad. I do not recommend it.
Food: 1/5  |  Service: 1/5  |  Atmosphere: 1/5

author: Joshua Rivera
review_text: Food was good but portion sizes too big and overpriced. Won't be going back there again

author: Luciana Nascimento
review_text: Ordered some food and asked for well done the meat was burnt that’s not well done and the meat seemed like it’s been cut and sat for hours. The only good thing about the food was the fries. The sausage was raw inside. 38 dollars on food that I barely ate…never ordering again.

author: J G
review_text: Run away from this place. First of all it is not an attractive place, raw and dry. Some of the waiters are well trained to deal with clients. There is no ambience and the inside resembles those shady places in Brazil. The food is horrendous pricey for no reason. The portions are small and tasteless. The old crowd that hangs in the bar seems to be local farmers employees. Go to any other places but avoid this one. trust me you will be glad that you did.

author: N Q
review_text: Food was good service was OK not great the bartender never said your welcome after repeated thank you. She was nice but seemed like she was rushing us and the place was empty.  She was cleaning the dust off the bottles which 90 percent of places don't...very clean place but the nail in the coffin was gratuity added for 2 people. I'm a good tipper I say you know I would have left you a bigger tip then 10.95 she says sorry but it's our rules you can leave more if you like. I said sorry to late you already told me how much I have to tip. She did apologize and was nice but I hate places that do that I get it if it's a big party but 2 people for lunch at a bar when the bill was 65.00 lol ....I asked how the soup was her response was its good soup is soup you know...probably won't go back. Brazilian bar tenders I'm Brazilian I spoke English only I felt that it bothered them. I speak Portuguese but wanted the American experience..

author: Hoover E Londono
review_text: I lived in Brazil  7 years eating here is like being in Brazil . The beer the food the beef

author: Edward Phipps
review_text: I ordered a churrasco for 1 person, with medium rare steak, collard greens & black beans. The waitress took my order made me pay before I got my order, and never got back to me until she brought my order more than 30mins later.  Never acknowledged or apologized they had me waiting forever for a take out order. When I got home & looked my food, my steak was well done & I got red beans.  The food was great but…. Common courtesy & good customer service.

author: Wrthg Hvn
review_text:
Went there for some food and drinks. My friend had the rodizio, which I sampled as well. The meat was super tender and not salty.  We also had a passion fruit sangria and beers. The sangria was excellent.
The crowd was really nice. There was music playing inside and outside.  There were a lot of nice people around. It was a good crowd. I look forward to returning soon .

author: pedro pedrao
review_text: Always have a great time at this place. Specially saturdays with live music. And Leandro is a very nice guy.

author: Noah Bustos
review_text:
I ordered mixed steak.  The chicken and beef was tough and burnt, looked like it was from the day before and they just heated it up.
We paid and the lady never returned with the change, we had to go look for her. Needless to say, the place was not packed enough to say that she was busy.
Lousy place.

author: Shalese Fuller
review_text: Unfortunately I only speak English that was a big problem!! Our waitress never understood anything we asked for (straw, ketchup, steak sauce & ingredients in our mixed drinks) I had the rodizeo & the meat tasted bland.. I work close & popped in with a coworker for a early Friday meal, guess this place wasn't for us.

author: Chad Vazquez
review_text: Excellent food and decent service - we come here often when we’re in the area.   Consistently great food!

author: James Stewart Jr
review_text: Stopped in during the annual Portuguese Feast, it's a little in off Ferry Street, indoor/outdoor seating, food was excellent, service was perfect, quick, attentive and on point.

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text: Tuesdays are the day to go. They have 31.95 Rodizio. Great price. All the meat you can eat and they will come back again. What they didn’t have was the grilled pineapple. They said it usually goes to waste to so they didn’t set it up. They all have a Rodizio special for lunch. The sea bass was not great according to my companion. It was a frozen fillet. Didn’t taste fresh. The Rodizio on Tuesday is their best offer. It wasn’t packed so you could hold a conversation.

author: Cristina Major
review_text: I had a little trip to Newark and it was a bit chaotic but choosing Casa Nova Grill was the best choice for the whole trip. Evando waited on us and he was the nicest. He showed us our options, detailed about the all you can eat options. Just for his service I would rate the 5 stars and the food was amazing as well. I will definitely come back when traveling up north again. I absolutely love my experience today. Going back to Louisiana and hope to be able to go back to Casa Nova Grill again.

author: Gu Sar
review_text:
Everything was terrible. I don’t recommend this place at all. Better go somewhere else.
By the way, I do not usually behave in the manner you are suggesting. I believe it would be more appropriate for you to focus on improving your customer service, as the attention we received was truly disappointing. The overall experience left much to be desired, and honestly, I would not return to your establishment. The people who were with me that day also left with a negative impression and share the same opinion about your restaurant.

I genuinely hope you take steps to improve, for the sake of both yourself and your staff, as no business can succeed without its customers.

author: Luis Diaz
review_text: Good dining experience in Newark. Sangria was flavorful, the salad bar was fresh and the meats were all delicious. The service was good as well. Parking was not easy and I had to find a spot on the street.

author: Johan Jaramillo
review_text: Wanted rodizio for my birthday and after checking out a few places, we decided to come back here — I had been once a while ago and remembered it being good. The service was beyond great! The rodizio was amazing, with tons of different cuts of steak, all super tasty. I definitely got full fast but still tried to sample as many as I could — the picanha was especially delicious! The sangria was also a hit. Overall, a great experience and I’ll definitely be back!

author: Celena L
review_text: Didn’t like the meat or buffet selection. The hush puppies were good, fries and fried banana were good also. Drinks were strong, didn’t have a big cocktail menu. Disappointed they didn’t have the cheese ball.  Never been to a Rodizio like this. Barely received any steak options, meats were either over cooked or too seasoned. Oh they gave fresh chips, those were good also. Service was slow, no one came back to us for a while to see if we wanted anything besides the Rodizio.

author: H G
review_text: We were in the vicinity and opted to dine at a Brazilian rodízio, which turned out to be a significant error as the meats were not fresh. Additionally, we ordered some beverages that were excessively diluted. We expressed our concerns to the waiter, who informed us that this was the standard. At that point, we asked to speak with a manager. The manager, named Victor, was exceptional. He made every effort to accommodate us, and I genuinely felt sorry for him. As we informed him of our decision not to return, it became clear that this establishment is utterly disappointing, especially considering the Ironbound area, which boasts numerous excellent restaurants.

author: Cindy M
review_text: Went for early dinner on weeknight for Rodizio.  WOULD NOT RECOMMEND this.  Apparently we got lucky with beef rib that was cooked to medium (just as we would have requested if we were asked), Pichanna was next also lucky those 2 meats were awesome HOWEVER that's where it ends.  Only offered sausage and chicken, filet wrapped in bacon (well done) and garlic steak also well done.  When we requested to server "can we have meat medium" his reply "that is how it is already cooked" he followed with "not good during week, you should have called and requested medium meats" He did absolutely nothing to rectify the situation.  So when I asked "do you have pineapple " he said "no we do not have pineapple during t week only on the weekends".  We have been there for dinner on weekend and that is why when we were in area we chose to stop there again.  We will not make that mistake again.

author: Miriam Noyola
review_text: Casa Nova Grill (Brazilian Rodizio) is a wonderful place to go with family. We were well taken care of and the staff was friendly and professional. Our food was delicious. I had the paella and it was full of seafood 😋 It’s a bit far from the train station if you’re walking but definitely a place to experience delicious Brazilian cuisine!

author: Gabriel Arnaudville
review_text:
The restaurant is beautiful. The food was not very tasty, and the server Evando was really slow and bad at his job, on purpose..
It wasnt busy and he had a smug attitude and face. He of course included gratuity for his bad job which we paid. But definitely ask for a different server. We unfortunately will not try it again.

author: Lu H
review_text: Tried Brazilian Rodizio for the first time and had a mixed experience. The salad bar offered a variety of options but was disappointed by the dried and hard mini pizza and the less-than-fresh vegetables. During happy hour, the $3.99 beer price was a highlight. The rodizio's meat-serving performance was interesting and enjoyable. However, most of the rodizio meats were salty and tasted similar, which made their mouth tired of the same flavors. Despite this, overall experience was cool and memorable.

author: Kimberly
review_text:
The service overall was amazing. Evando made sure we were good the whole time we were a party of 12 and he was patient, efficient and very professional. Made sure we were taken care of immediately we highly recommend him.

The food was 100/10 enjoyed everything overall!!

author: Robin
review_text: We've visited this establishment many times. This trip included a party of 8. The food was good -- nice and filling. The service was thorough, pleasant and professional. There was live music and television screens around the restaurant.

author: Armi Castro
review_text: Great food! If you go there as for Joao Neto. He is excellent and will help you have a great time eating authentic Brazilian food. The Pichana is great and the music was on point! I will definitely come back again with my family

author: joshwin clervoix
review_text: Great food! Very comfortable and cozy intimate setting. Food comes out very fast and fresh for Rodizio and the salad bar was very good it’s like you can get an entire entree in the salad bar alone. Me and my wife had a great time only negative is the parking but I soon figured out you can park at the bank across the street.

author: J J
review_text: Loved it ! Thank you ! Very much recommended and will continue to come appreciate the hospitality !!

author: Giovanna Alfaro
review_text: Such a great restaurant! The open space is beautiful and the food was absolutely delicious — so worth it. Definitely going back! Our server Evando was super helpful and had such a great personality.

author: Nataly Romero
review_text:
Came for the first time and the experience was absolutely amazing.
Joao Neto was our sever and he was very polite, friendly  and made excellent recommendations.
Casa Nova Grill went above and beyond my expectations, definitely coming back.

author: grace ebourefi
review_text: I like the restaurant the food yummy service people just amazing specially Evando nice person so humble happy to serve each table ,all of them they who’s nicer.

author: Davi Galvao
review_text: The food was okay. All the meats tasted really dry, and the buffet food seemed kind of old and not very warm, likely because it was sitting out in the open without a cover. I was expecting a better buffet and churrasco rodizio for the price. Overall, the food was okay, and Evando provided excellent service, attending to our needs promptly and answering our questions.

author: Lakeisha G.
review_text: The tables in the middle are a little too close together. You cant even squeeze through to get out of your seat. The food was good, we had about a 20 minute wait, but it was packed and Sunday.

author: Phanit Duong
review_text: Went on a Monday for dinner and everything was fresh. My raw clams and mussels were on deck and I ate 6 platters all for $20 with tip, you can’t go wrong here! Full review on YouTube@hellachluy

author: Lex K
review_text: The buffet has a great ambiance and the staff were friendly and said thank you. The food was ok but some items are better than others such as fried chicken but the salmon was cold so choose wisely also I did notice some unsanitary conditions like sneezing and stuff so I stayed away from the hibachi would I go back ? They would have to make some changes before that.

author: Mikeyy Lunarezz
review_text: I found this place by accident on Google maps while looking at jersey mills mall. I decided to check this place out after shopping at the mall which is a few miles away. Restaurants is located in a trip mall which has free parking which is always a plus. From the outside place doesn't seem very big but that is deceiving because it's pretty big inside. There's plenty of seating very large selection of food, including fruits, vegetables and more. Staff is welcoming and your really get you money's worth. Food was great, they keep place clean and food always stocked. They even have a party room for special events. They also have a restrooms which is also clean and well maintained. I enjoyed my experience overall. If you're looking for a cool buffet and you're out with friends or family and you happen to be in the area this place will not disappoint.

author: Zac
review_text: Food was above average for this type of restaurant, and service was good. The main downside was we were seated under a leak in the roof so water was dripping on us, and it was very busy so we didn't bother requesting to change seats. Overall I would go again, but at $46 for two, I don't know if the value is really there.

author: 9TF M
review_text: We had the best experience in this restaurant. The manager was so sweet and smart. She gave us a feeling like dining at home. My son observed her dealing with some difficult customers in a very nice and smart way. Every staff was so dedicated in making you feel comfortable. Will come back again for sure!!

author: Quayah Seabrooks
review_text: The food is old and nasty .. I paid almost 70 dollars for my children and I to eat and everything tasted the same .. they don’t have enough utensils to serve the food so you have to the same utensil for different dishes (cross contamination) so  don’t come if you have a seafood allergy .. the workers  hover over you and tell you when your done eating so don’t think your not being timed .. it’s honestly not worth the money (at least not the dinner ) 70 dollars for food that’s been sitting out all day .  The sushi bar is ok and the hibachi had great uncooked meat out but it’s small .

author: Ceo wa Mairura
review_text: First paying before you eat is a good sign to start with , food was cold, just few options unlike other buffet . I don’t even finish my first plate

author: Jenuwine Blu
review_text: Great time. Clean store & friendly staff. Waited no more than 15 minutes for my table. The food was so fresh. Lots of variety.

author: Crystal Morris
review_text: I've been going there for a while and I have no complaints about anything the service is excellent the staff is very respectful and very nice and the food is fresh and they welcome anyone to come eat and enjoy yourself and I give them 10 or more star's 💯❤️

author: Justin Marrero
review_text:
This was hands down the worst Chinese buffet I’ve ever been to — and I’m not exaggerating. Every single thing I tried tasted bland, stale, or just plain wrong. The chicken? Rubbery. The noodles? Oily and flavorless. The sushi? I wouldn’t trust it to feed a stray cat. Even the fried rice somehow managed to be dry and soggy at the same time. How is that even possible?

Nothing — and I mean nothing — was enjoyable. Not one bite. I actually left hungrier and more frustrated than when I walked in. If this is what they consider “fresh” or “authentic,” they need to seriously reevaluate everything.

The only thing worse than the food was the regret that hit me halfway through chewing the first bite. Save your money, your time, and your stomach — go literally anywhere else.

author: Marina Tichonyuk
review_text: We came for the first time and I am sure for the last. Food was good with a lot of options. But the service is terrible. They require paying up-front! Never saw anything like this. Coming in and have to pay right away. AND put tip there!!! Tip before the service! So disrespectful! And then nobody came over a single time. So tip for what??? Terrible service.

author: Paris
review_text: I truly love this buffet, they have it all sea food, sushi, hibachi and everything in between. If your in the mood for buffet style asain cuzine this is the place, especially if your local!

author: Afiesha
review_text: I DONT KNOW WHAT HAPPEN TO THIS PLACE FOOD USE TO BE SOO GOOD flavorful I went there yesterday TRASH THREW UP IMMEDIATELY AND THE ROACH OUTSIDE THE RESTAURANT TOLD ME EVERYTHING I REGRETTED EATING THERE WILL NEVER GO AGAIN N STOP SELL OLD FOOD HEATING IT UP WONT MAKE IT TASTE BETTER THE NEXT DAY NOODLES WAS SO SOFT TAKE LIKE MASH POTATOES RICE SMELL SPOILED I JUST ATE PLATE OF FRUITS AND LEFT WORST EXPERI EVER I WISH TO NEVER GO BACK IMMA THROW UP AGAIN AFTER THIS REVIEW DIGUSTING

author: Ayodele Abiodun
review_text: The service here is 110/100. Girls are versatile in their doing🥰🥰🥰

author: Melissa Deleen
review_text: Not worth the price. Quality of food is poor and the environment was a bit dirty.

author: Michelli Ikawa
review_text: The food is good, but pay attention when paying the bill. We were 4 adults and 2 children and they charged us $160. Since it was the 4th of July, each adult should have paid $19.90 and each child $9.90. The total is almost $100, each person drank a soda, it doesn't make sense that they charged $10 per soda... I didn't like that

author: Derek
review_text: The food here was surprising good compared to what I paid. The service was great as well. They have a large election of food. I would be back.

author: Kseniya Karpova
review_text: The food was amazing! It's a cosy place with a relaxing atmosphere.

author: Wendy Foster
review_text: My sister n i...went to celebrate our hubby's b.day...they both where happy...we come from brooklyn n this its one gem we keeping..lol..food good waiter was on point n again the food was goooodddddd.

author: Amy W
review_text:
We were so thoroughly impressed by our meal here on Saturday night that we ended up coming back two other times during a quick weekend trip to NYC. We even rode the PATH train into Newark FROM Manhattan on Sunday evening because we had enjoyed our first experience so much and knew we wouldn’t find a better meal.

My boyfriend is Portuguese and has extremely high standards for the cuisine. We have been to Portugal multiple times and we agreed that the meals we had at Coimbra equaled the best meals we had across the Atlantic. Just like a true Portuguese place, olives and delicious rustic breads were served right away. (But unlike Portugal, there was no charge!)

My boyfriend got squid for one meal (pictured) and octopus for another. Both were so tender and flavorful, and the potatoes and vegetable sides fresh and perfectly cooked. I ordered the barbecue chicken special (pictured) for two meals, it was so delicious.

The stuffed rock crab appetizer is also pictured, another A+. The caldo verde was better than some versions I had in Portugal. The flaming chourico and aletria and bolo de bolacha desserts were perfection as well.

The prices are extremely reasonable for the portions and quality delivered. The service is incredible. Pedro was so pleasant and welcoming and helped us out with his thoughtful recommendations. He remembered us when we came back and treated us so well each time. Nelson was also very kind and friendly and we really appreciated his attentiveness. We felt like we had made new friends.

We will definitely be back. This place is worth the drive from Maryland. I can’t wait to visit Coimbra again!

author: Ahri A
review_text:
Amazing crispy skin. Garlic shrimp is delicious.

Service is excellent and the attention paid to us was top notch. Pedro took great care of us.

Coimbra is a flavor-packed experience you don’t want to miss. The citrus notes in the dishes cut through the richness of the fatty pork perfectly—it’s a match made in culinary heaven. Pair it all with a glass of their red sangria, and you’re in for a treat. Definitely try a bit of everything on the table! Pro tip: use the crispy pork skin to scoop up some rice and dip it into the salty, savory sauce. Don’t be afraid to get your hands messy—it’s all part of the fun and flavor.

author: Ricardo A.
review_text: Great authentic portuguese food. Amazing squid (grilled) and calamari,  the food is always spectacular.  Especially the cod fish items. Always pleasing to chat it up with the locals and the hostess. Parking can be a hassle if the lot is packed but never have a problem finding one nearby.

author: Wayne Eichler
review_text: Food was average at best. The two entrees were not seasoned and tasteless. I asked what the waiter recommends and read all the entrees. What was one or two that were really good. My mistake on my part to ask.  Plenty of other options to try in the area.

author: Erick Carrillo
review_text: We where here for my wife's birthday 🎉 excellent food and ambience. I like the steak and seafood. I would love to comeback another great spot in Ironbound

author: Ana Butler
review_text: Breaking from my routine introduced me to this gem. Employees understand the menu while staying approachable. You get genuine service and delicious meals. The servings here are generous and taste exceptional. Another trip here is guaranteed.

author: Maribel Hernandez
review_text: What is there not to love but the closest taste of fine Portuguese dining while not having to catch a flight to Coimbra, Portugal. My favorite was their pork cube clams, well marinated that the pork cubes and clams taste like they were one. The octopus salad was also well seasoned, maybe a little too heavy with the onions but the octopus wasn't chewy or overcooked, it was seasoned and settled well with all the flavors when served. I did not like the soup, I can get fresher soup from Seabra's on 83 Wilson Ave. The not-so-pleasant-going-towards-the-fermented soup I couldn't palate the soup after the second try.  Other than that everything else was well made, locally bought and I did love their mixed salads, the salads tasted fresh which is difficult during a time of climate justice. Maybe the waiter should of asked was there something wrong with the soup. I would have shared my opinion. The pastel de nata sweet and not too heavy but just heavenly crisp and a thick pudding like cream of heaven. There's a parking lot available on Fillmore, the atmosphere was laid-back, patrons sitting down either at the bar or on the serving tables. There's a larger dining area on the left side of the restaurant and a private room downstairs for a more private party. Waiters were attentive and courteous, they wanted to know how they can be of service as they checked in on the customers. There bartenders can be a little snarky but I understand it's challenging to be behind the counter.  Next time Coimbra, overall well done.

author: Antonio Grelicha
review_text: Undercooked suckling pig, mixed up order, wrong food on Christmas Day. Very disappointed. Having Hoped for  better turnout. Alex did not offer any remedy. Frequented place.

author: Juan Garcia
review_text: Another fantastic lunch in Coimbra restaurant, one of the best .

author: Gerri
review_text: My first time at this restaurant and it was great. The service was on point and the food delicious.  Definitely going back again.

author: Laurinda Esteves
review_text:
I had a nice celebratory dinner there with 15 people last Saturday.  The food was great as always but they packed us very tight, and you couldn't even get out.  The other negative was the  singer.   I made a couple of requests for Portuguese songs that are very popular and perfect for dancing and he never played them.   I asked him 3 times, I said when are you going to play the songs I requested and he replied "when you leave".   He kept played stupid slow Brazilian songs and the Portuguese popular fast songs were not his priority.   He needs to go or I will not be going there while that rude man is there.

Usually the singers play songs requested for any event but I did not even bothered to ask him for anything more after I experienced is foul demeanor. This restaurant needs to find a DJ, who will do a much better job.

author: Alexa Fontes
review_text: Coimbra Bar and Restaurant is a standout spot in Newark! The food is absolutely delicious, with authentic Portuguese flavors and generous portions. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, perfect for all occasionds. What truly makes this place shine is the awesome service—the staff are attentive, friendly, and make you feel right in Portugal. Highly recommend for an unforgettable dining experience! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

author: Monica Fernandes
review_text: The best place to enjoy real Portuguese food!!! It was my second time going. I took my friends, and they instantly fell in love. The prices are really good, considering you get big portions. The chouriço was perfect. The service was really friendly and welcoming. They explained all the plates on the menu and gave suggestions. I would completely recommend this place, and for sure, I will be back

author: Orang Gina
review_text: Our first visit here. Truly a gem in the "beautiful" ironbound section of Newark. We had goat and cod dishes. Clams and sausage appetizers were great, in fact it was the best sausage I've ever had. The food was beyond excellent. The bar and restaurant are in the same room so you can eat and watch soccer or Portuguese CNN from anywhere. There also appears to be an event dining room in a separate section.

author: Estela Cordeiro
review_text: Took a ride from Boston (Massachusetts) to Newark (New Jersey) to drop off some boxes at a transport company to ship to Portugal and stumbled upon this Coimbra Bar & Restaurant and what a treat it was. Our server Pedro was amazing!!! The piglet was the best I’ve ever had, with its crispy skin, and the service was 5 stars even with the Saturday lunch rush. This is definitely a site we will be visiting again. See you soon!

author: Jorge T
review_text: Great food matched by great atmosphere.  The place was packed. They could space out the tables a little better.  They really cram everyone in there. Nice professional staff. Will definitely be back

author: Leo Amador
review_text: The food was just ok.  We ordered a soup, carapaus assados, Chicken picadinho, buffalo chicken wings, ate 2 lava cakes. The price for a Macallan12 @ $25 per doze is outrageous considering the surrounding establishments  charge between $12 and $16. The service was slow! Spent over $60 (with a bottle of wine)  per person with a baby and 2 childen. We will not be coming back!

author: Alex Andino
review_text: Food was terrible. A surprise for a Portuguese restaurant in Ironbound. They served me days old chicken that was reheated. it smelled like a chicken out of the fridge that was put back in the oven. Fries were cold. Not coming back.

author: Arestides Andre
review_text: Everything was just right, plenty of food, staff was great, the place is very clean, yes I will be returning and I will recommend the restaurant to friends and family.

author: Isabella Nobriga
review_text: They should let you know when they have a special menu for certain holidays. Dishes were much more expensive on mothers day and my favorite dish was excluded from the menu. Service was subpar even though I've seen it busier. Overall I resent having to pay more for food I really didn't want.

author: charnetta holley
review_text:
The restaurant itself is beautiful with a great atmosphere, good vibes, and very reasonable prices. The food was delicious, and our waitress, manager, and the rest of the staff (other than security) were welcoming and professional.

Unfortunately, the security experience really brought the mood down. We were only in the area briefly while waiting for my daughter’s concert to finish and decided to try the restaurant after checking the website and reviews. The website states that the dress code only applies after 7pm on Friday and Saturday. We went on a Sunday, but my son and I were almost denied entry because we had on Crocs. Security made a big deal about the shoes and we stood out there for 5-10 min just waiting because of the shoes  (there was no line) After I pointed out the policy, security checked with the manager and then let us in.

My sister also had her Stanley cup with water because it was hot outside, and the security guard was extremely rude and snotty about it, saying “you can’t bring that in here, y’all must not go out much.” He then made her leave it at the front door. That comment felt unnecessary and unprofessional, and it took away from the excitement we had walking in.

We mentioned the situation casually to our waitress, and without us even asking, the manager came to our table to personally apologize. That gesture meant a lot, and it showed that management truly cares about their customers.

Overall, the food and vibes were excellent, but the security staff needs more professionalism and consistency with following the restaurant’s actual policies. Parking is also tough, so be prepared to use valet (around $30).

If the security experience matched the quality of the food and staff, this would have been an easy 5-star review.

author: Cindy Juarez
review_text:
This was honestly one of the worst places I’ve eaten at. The food was terrible, nothing tasted fresh and most of it seemed stale. We went during the week and the menu was super limited, barely any options. From the fajitas to the birria tacos, everything tasted off and not authentic at all. It felt super Americanized. I would’ve rather eaten at Chipotle or even Taco Bell.

I also ordered a piña colada and it was disgusting. It tasted super fake, like they used some kind of powder mix instead of making it fresh. I couldn’t even finish it.

I ordered a Coke too and got a tiny glass full of ice with barely any soda. They didn’t even give me the can, which was annoying because it felt like they kept the rest of my drink.

On top of that, they automatically added an 18% gratuity for a party of four, which is crazy considering that’s not even a big table especially with how bad the food and service were. The prices were high, and I don’t mind spending money on good food, but this definitely wasn’t it.

The place looks nice from the outside, but the food is not good at all. Huge disappointment.

author: Nikiea Hawkins
review_text: Food was delicious (albeit not hot) so I'll give 4 stars. And the atmosphere was amazing.  The staff was very unfriendly I guess bc my sister and I are Muslim. We sat there in am empty restaurants at the smallest table they had until I just got fed up and moved myself.  I'll attach some photos so you can see that is actually beautiful.  But they only want Spanish people in their spot 🙄 of the owner or manager disagrees then by all means invite us back.  We spent $140 for cold food. And weak drinks! This is my honest respectful review!

author: Gayathri Gopal
review_text: Had a wonderful time at this Mexican place! The cocktails were great, and the chicken tacos were absolutely amazing. The service was friendly and attentive, and the place had a lovely Mexican vibe. Overall, a fantastic experience — would definitely visit again! 🌮🍹

author: beldim2010
review_text:
Beautifully decorated spot with good food but impersonal service.

My wife and I visited Little Tijuana for an early dinner in May 2025. The moment we walked in, we were struck by the restaurant’s beautiful, artistic decor, which instantly set the tone for a pleasant dining experience. The overall experience was mixed though. Most of the food ordered was excellent with a couple of exceptions. The drinks were flavorful, but noticeably diluted.
Service was efficient but impersonal. Everything arrived correctly and politely, yet we never felt truly cared for - no one stopped by to ask if we liked the food or drinks, no smile, no friendly chat.
We can recommend Little Tijuana for its ambiance, décor, and solid food — just don’t expect much beyond what's served at your table.

Food ordered
Guacamole Trio - three types of guacamole to try and all three were absolutely tasteless :(
Mexican Fajita - excellent. Flavorful and sizzling.
Lamb Barbacoa (lamb shank) - excellent. Melting in the mouth.

author: Anchal Sikka
review_text:
Must try🍽️

Tijuana Burrito ( Veg)

(limited Veg options, but the burrito tasted so so good. It was a lot of veggies with fresh sour cream was m and the habanero sauce)

The presentation and ambiance was lit. The music was so so loud!! But the vibe was great.

Perfect was a bigger party if you want to have fun and have amazing food. The DJ seemed chill and the mixes were really good.

Gratuity is included and the prices are kinda high.
Overall worth it!!

author: Fatima Mendez
review_text: So awesome place to chill and vibe, the best part is getting to chose your vibe settings here. They have three different levels. The lounge , you dance and have drinks, the dinning room where the music is at its mid and the rooftop, super elegant and that’s where I was loved it!
