Had a great time🫶 the owner did such a great job and he made us feel so welcomed that’s really what made me want to stay cause I don’t like being in Newark. The only thing I did not like was the valet parking. I get the $25 to park but what threw me off is that the guy didn’t let me enter the restaurant from the parking lot and made me walk around to the front. But when I came back for my car I saw he let someone else go through the back. So idk if maybe she’s also the owner prob. Idk. But I’d hope if they could change that because I had heals on and it was super dark and a bit of walk to go to the front.

author: Tanesha Peralta
review_text:
AMAZING, we held an office party here and it was fabulous. The food tasted delicious and the space is beautiful.
The manager, Larry, answered all our questions and offered great menu options (Including options for vegetarians).

author: Erin Orth
review_text: My friend and I stumbled across this place while on vacation on The Union Presents “Blackout” open mic night, and didn’t realize how lucky we got! The entertainment was amazing, the atmosphere was incredible, the food was on point, the drinks were strong and the service was the best I’ve ever experienced. To our waitress, I wish we’d gotten your name, you made our night and thank you for the recommendation for other places after you closed. We will definitely be coming back!!

author: Anudeep Jain
review_text: Food was decent but I gave 3 star because of poor billing. They charge gratuity on the bill irrespective of the group size. Wonder whether that is even legal.

author: Adilene Llanes
review_text: The food was decent, but overall the experience was disappointing because of all the extra fees added to the bill. In addition to the menu prices, there was a non-cash adjustment fee of $6.72, an automatic 18% gratuity, and a $25 parking fee. None of this was made very clear upfront, and it significantly increased the total cost. The food itself was just okay—not bad, but not good enough to justify all the added charges. I would recommend paying cash when eating here.

author: Debra Tencio
review_text: We dined here on Saturday, September 27. The food was cold, the dance floor in the separate area and the rooftop was closed. The DJ played a couple of bachata songs and 1-2 merengues but it was mostly rachet music. I didn't expect to listen to Pop Smoke at a restaurant called Little Tijuana. Our server Fernando looked bothered the entire night and was eager to give us our check so we could leave. The vibe was NOT it.

author: DIEGO MORALES
review_text:
Ordered the Al pastor torta. I was surprised it was really good. Small portion, fries were cold.
Appetizers we ordered queso fundido and guacamole. That was really good.

The drinks were okay, but the service was terrible. I had a torta de al pastor and it was really good, but it’s hard to appreciate a solid menu when the poor service drags everything down—especially with gratuity already included. I ordered one drink I really liked, but the server never came back to see if I wanted another; I probably would have ordered three more rounds. I was with a group, and even though the menu states that gratuity is included, our server acted like they didn’t need to earn it. Our bill was $200, and paying an added $36 for almost no service felt steep. Overall, the dine-in service is bad, and I won’t be coming back.

author: Kinda Jessop
review_text: Love the look, vibe and service here! We had the Four Lokos drink flight and a Watermelon Martini. Delish! However, food was okay. We had the elote and loaded fries. Not bad but definitely not on my foodie bucket list and I love Mexican food. Loved the selfie corners and decor. Music was pumping. Loved the staff birthday rollout!

author: Kenoa Askerneese
review_text: Visited shortly after brunch so food options were limited but good nonetheless. Chicken quesadilla came with a side of rice and beans. Had a Sunset in Tijuana. Everything was so so good. You can tell isa vibe at night too. Staff was friendly and helpful when explaining menu options. Lots of photo ops too! 😊 I'll definitely visit again.

author: Erica Liguori
review_text: Came here for dinner before seeing the NJ Symphony at NJPAC. We had Karina. She was fantastic!! Being first timers, we needed help navigating the menu. She recommended some items and we ordered all of her recommendations! Sooo dang good. We had the birria nachos, the crispy shrimp tacos, and the California burrito. We were STUFFED but everything was incredible. Our drinks were yum too!! Such a cool spot. Looks like it turns into a club at night! And they have so many events to attend; brunch, special DJs, drag shows, birthdays, hookah, bachelorette, etc etc. Only downside was that we had to pay $25 for valet.. thought that was pretty steep for just dinner. If we were staying into the night and attending the club scene, totally understand, but just for dinner? Idk I feel like $10 would have been more reasonable.

author: Leona Palevac
review_text:
I went by myself sunday 10pm to have their roasted chicken tijuana chicken entree, which was advertised $18 on the site. When I arrived the entrance was interesting and the place wasn't the "barra" on google maps but Little Tijuana and had same pictures of this barra place. When you enter there is a big empty ballroom and a staircase to your right, as well as a staircase down before that to the kitchen I think. You have to go towards the brightly colored stairs and take a right to enter the bar area. I don't know what else is in the building but the bar, bathroom are beautiful and interesting, albeit terribly noisy.

My bartender gave me an ipad with the menu, and I was informed by it there's an automatic gratuity of 18%. I did NOT like that. Then I learned the dish I wanted was $24, not $18, and the bartender didn't know but returned a few minutes later to inform me they didn't have roasted chicken. I then asked for tacos and they said they didn't have the steak, but they did have pulled pork so I got tacos al pastor for $19, chips and salsa for $5, and two modelo's $6 a piece. The food was good, but I did feel sick from eating the tacos and worried as to whether the meat was really food safe.

I would go again in a heartbeat, especially if they changed the audio surroundings in the bar to not be deafening... especially if they fixed the televisions. You can put closed captions on the television if there's no sound for them.

Overall it was ok, but really, REALLY not worth the price I paid whatsoever. I would not recommend you eat here until Little Tijuana gets an actual manager in their kitchen. I will update this review and do a whole new one if the business offers me, as I don't like leaving businesses with poor reviews but this place needs improvements. I will say there was some decent flavor in the tacos, so they definitely have some staff in the kitchen performing. IT's certainly their management that is lacking with inventory control. My tacos had I believe canned pineapples too, dull in color but with good flavor.

author: Art Dopplis
review_text: The decor and atmosphere were both amazing. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food was great. There wasn't a party going on this night but it still has a nice upbeat vibe. I would definitely recommend and we intend on returning next time in the area.

author: China Smith
review_text: The place is beautiful to look at. We had an awesome time. The food was okay for me. The atmosphere I loved. The music and staff were good. The music was great but not to loud that you couldn't talk over dinner. I would go again.

author: Marisol Colon
review_text: The restaurant is not in the greatest area, just to start. The service was awful our waiter forgot our appetizer order, forgot our drinks - he said he’s a little busy and didn’t even apologize. When we ordered dinner they didn’t have the steak fajitas, how is this possible when you’re a Mexican restaurant. The sangria tasted like kool aid - yes KOOL AID!! The only reason I came was because of the Christmas decoration and the ambiance that was supposed to feel magical. Don’t waste your time coming to this establishment. The gratuity was also added without our consent - apparently it’s done this way. I guess that’s why he sucked as a waiter.

author: Nancy Sears
review_text: Anytime I’m near the airport. I make a point to stop at this place. Their paella is not to be missed. The bartender Benjamin is so nice, informative and attentive.

author: David K
review_text: We walked in on a Tue eve and enjoyed a very good tapas dinner.  It’s a good menu with traditional choices and well presented.  My daughter has brought small business groups to the restaurant and it’s great for small parties as well and regular diners.

author: Sushmita Jadhav
review_text: Went here on a Friday night. It was nice and peaceful, not too loud. Food was really really good. Imo it’s a must visit place in NJ

author: Carlos G
review_text: Mompu nails the vibe with a sleek, modern dining room, chill back patio, and genuinely friendly staff. The sangria was spot-on, but the papas bravas stole the show—crispy, perfectly seasoned, and utterly delicious. The chicken skewers and house bread with spicy tomato sauce were solid picks. The mussels were just OK, and the tres leches dessert, while clever with its pound-cake base, could’ve used more moisture.

author: Nancy Cintron
review_text: It had been a while since I made it to Mompou. I was starving after our flight back home and decided to stop for some tapas. As always, Mompou did not disappoint! Our bartender was amazing and every tapas dish was excellent! We splurged and ordered the chocolate trio dessert! AMAZING!!!

author: Joshua Cooke
review_text: Came here with some friends and tried many different dishes from the tapas menu. Most of them were very good and we enjoyed the experience. I liked trying things that I normally wouldn't have ordered by myself. The staff was very attentive. Pictured below is the baked potatoes, hangar steak, fried calamari, empanadas, and avocado crab salad.

author: Angel Hsu
review_text: Cute place in ironbound for tapas and drinks. Love the bar seating area and bartenders are friendly. They have a solid selection of draft beers as well. Just wish they’d update their tapas menu every now and then. Also pricier compared to other places in the area. The tres leches cake though, best I’ve ever had.

author: F'burg Foodie
review_text:
While working in the area a co-worker suggested we try this tapas joint.  Went in on a weeknight and they were pretty busy, so be sure to make reservations.  Service was really good during our entire stay.  The menu is loaded with some really nice, appetizing Spanish dishes.  But what impressed me most was that the food was very nicely prepared!  After going to another local “Spanish” joint nearby I was very unimpressed with the way they prepared their food and felt that most all places with that outdated exterior and interior were going to be this way… It was refreshing to find this place that has a very updated and beautifully decorated interior and food to match.

Bottom line – Definitely worth visiting, but make reservations!  Oh, and get the paella!

author: Danielle Claros
review_text: cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, tasty tapas with beautiful presentation, fun variety of drinks, and everything came out super quickly! my friends and i had a blast pregaming here before our concert at prudential - totally looking forward to coming back soon🤠✨

author: P Gill
review_text: Had a fun Sunday afternoon lunch. We did the Tappas items from the menu. Octopus was very good. The highlight was the flamenco trio plus drummer. They were spectacular.

author: Benjamin L
review_text:
Overall great experience. Food was delicious. The highlights would be the traditional paella which flowed with tons of flavor. My only thing is I wish there was more rice with the paella, but tons of seafood and meats was nice. The meat platter was also tasty, just sad there was only one lamb chop. The negra paella was also worth a try. Definitely go with a group of 3 or more people to try more tapas and enjoy all they have to offer.

My only concerns was we went on a weekend night and were seated by the open window, where cars kept zooming past loudly. Ask to be seated further back in the restaurant and away from the street.

author: Jonathan Dorf
review_text: We had a great early dinner before a show at the Prudential Center. Easy to walk from to the venue. Awesome staff. Super attentive to my wife who has celiac disease - so many GF options even very good GF bread - seriously!

author: T Henderson
review_text: The food and customer service were amazing. Tabitha, thanks for making my first time memorable.

author: Denise D.
review_text:
We had a blast celebrating my friend’s 40th birthday in a private room here. The servers were friendly and attentive. The room has a modern rustic vibe. That with our birthday decor for the place was so pretty.

The food was delicious our group of 20 people enjoyed
Tapas: dates stuffed with blue cheese and wrapped in bacon, empanadas, chorizo al vino, tostones, and grilled Pulpo 🐙
Mains: steak, paella pasta, vegetarian paella, and grilled pulpo with potatoes and spinach.

The place has a beautiful design overall and the food was great.

author: J. Manes
review_text: The complimentary bread with garlic sauce was a winner. The drinks were nice. The lamb chops were over but tasty. The grilled octopus, shrimp and sea bass were okay. The biggest glaring issue was the traditional paella. When the waiter says it doesn’t look right can I send it back for you it’s not good. Even after waiting for another one it was not great. Not one spec of Socarrat which is what makes the dish.

author: Pratik Paddle
review_text: Everything we ordered was delicious and the service was great. I also like the vibe and the music here. It would also be a good spot to come and have a drink at the bar. We had the pinchos de pollo, the octopus, the squid tapas paella, the batatas bravas, and the mushrooms. The complimentary bread and dip they give you is sooooo good too. Our favorite was the mushrooms but everything we had was delicious. We had the tres leches for dessert and it was AMAZING. Very rich though, definitely share it.

author: Jo Atfo
review_text: Can't believe I never came here. The food was so good, except for the vegetarian paella...a hard pass never again.  Had the mushrooms and salad, delish. And oh man, that dipping sauce they give with the bread was amazing!  Sangria was ok.

author: Kan WD
review_text:
Food was great but it was a bit salty. The sangria is nice and strong. Not sweet.
$3.99 fee for credit card and the suggested tip on the receipt is based on the total with the fee. If you're a big group, be careful.

author: Dena Scoullos
review_text: Delicious tapas. Many gluten free options. The tapas are great to share and taste all different flavors. For two people we ordered 6 small tapas and it was perfect. Great drinks too!

author: Peter Yong (PedroJoven)
review_text:
Nice little eatery and good service. Food's mostly ok. Jamon Iberico was excellent. Hanger steaks were done properly, medium rare. Alcachofas were not fresh and tasted like from canned. Mussels were tender. Paella was ok, can't say authentic Spanish, especially the peas but conceptually good lacking the socarrat. Spicy friend chicken wings is definitely not Spanish but ok taste. Pan con tomate was good. Empanadas tasted good but not Spanish. Ensalada was fresh. Lamb chops were done properly and well seasoned. Flan was good.
Price wise is expensive for the quality and quantity, New York City high end price. 4% charge for using credit card which is also higher than normal.

author: Joseph Marino
review_text: The food here is incredible, especially the patatas — my absolute favorite! The drinks are fantastic, and I really appreciate that they have great choices for those who prefer plant-based options. Eating in made the whole experience even better than takeout. I’d definitely recommend this spot to anyone nearby!

author: yuchen wang
review_text: Food is good, for Arroz con pollo, although it taste good, and we do like dark meat, but it has too much bone, we expect whole piece of meat like chicken legs or chicken thighs that easier to eat.

author: Robin Stephens
review_text: We had the best experience here last Friday. We celebrated the holidays from work with our families and were treated like royalty. The food was delicious, the kids were comfortable and the service was very laid back and friendly! My pork chop dinner was sooo good! The minestrone soup that comes with the bread is fantastic!! Our drinks were also really good! Can’t say enough good things, yummy and friendly and parking across the street!!

author: tracey napoleon
review_text: Made reservations for 4  on Saturday at 4:45. When we got there it wasn’t crowded, so we were seated right away. The staff was  professional and attentive. The restaurant has an old rustic vibe which was ok for me. We ordered some apps the..scallops stuffed with crab meat and scallops with calamari in a spicy sauce. It was just ok. I wasn’t able to eat the calamari, because they were rubbery. The lentil soup they served was good. My dinner was Salmon with crab meat on top. It wasn’t good. The salmon was flavorless and was on top of a red sauce that wasn’t good at all. My husband enjoyed his meal which was the steak ham and egg special. I should have just gotten the Paella Valenciana which my friend said was good. Over all the experience was good. If i do come back I will get the Paella Valenciana.

author: Peter Lo
review_text: We ordered the calamari, octopus and clams casino for apps.  All were very good.  Calamari crispy and that marinara sauce had a little kick which made it better.  octopus was tender and not rubbery.  The clams were satisfactory.  My daughter ordered chicken and rice and me and my wife order paella Valencia for 2.  Entrees were good.  My only disappointment was they pushed the "still" water on me which cost $10.  All patrons beware as it's a up sell tactic.  I hated it cause I was targeted and no other table got screwed.

author: Antonio Gil
review_text:
Great service. Food was ok
I had the octopus Galician style very nice done and soft pulpo. it had a good taste but pieces were cut to thin and for my taste the pulpo could use a little more and  heavier grade Spanish Olive oil. The caldo gallego soup had a great savor, taste, but it could use a few more white beans lol...

author: Jo Atfo
review_text: First off, the staff is amazing!!! Every time I go..amazing!  I've been going here for years but this is the first time I dined in because I was with a friend.  I love the food especially the patatas, my go to.  Drinks amazing, and I love that there are options for the plant based community.  Dining in is way better than taking out, which is what I'm used to doing. I highly recommend if you're in this area.

author: Eric Beckley
review_text: Excellent food and prices fair for the quality.  The seafood pilaf was AMAZING!

author: Kerry
review_text:
We came on my birthday for an early dinner. The designated parking lot is perfect, I actually watched the parking antics out the window as we ate 🤣 when you walk in you are in the bar. It seems a gallery of sorts with modern art on the walls small but cozy bar area, enough space for someone to enjoy a meal there. We were seated immediately in the dining room, very pretty atmosphere classic old world art reminiscent of my European grandparents’ dining room art ❤️. I chose this restaurant based on the reviews of the paella, we ordered the paella for two and enjoyed the escarole soup while we waited.

The paella was amazing the seafood really does come out perfectly cooked. The meat; chicken and sausage were really good but the amount of meats compared to the seafood seemed less (maybe because it had been said I like seafood more, which there was plenty for both of us). There was plenty to eat and still enough fit each of us to have a full meal the next night. The fresh made potato chips are amazing we wound up taking them home too.

The only reason I gave less stars for service was because I had to ask for lemon for my water so many times, there were plenty of servers to attend to all your needs,  the service was fine after that was resolved.

We both  enjoyed the whole experience and plan to return. Thank you for the great birthday dinner.

author: Gary Liebchen
review_text:
I'm starting this off with what I didn't like.  They put a $6 fee on our bill for credit card.  I get it.  They get this ridiculous fee from them, they pass it on to you. The establishment has to wait to get their money.  But to charge for debit card is wrong.  They had the money in their account before I got home. On top of that they put the fee and tax in suggested tip amount.

Now onto Spanish Tavern. The place is beautiful.  Old school charm.  The staff is terrific, also with a bit of old school charm. Our waiter Jose was great.
They start you off with soup served up at the table.  We started with garlic shrimp and paprika.  Just fabulous.  (Bread was stale and other tables had same issue) I got a seafood paella with shrimp, mussels, clams, scallops and lobster in a fantastic tasty rice.  Lydia got the lobster dinner and was not disappointed, though she would have like a bigger lobster as they only have 1.25 lb size. We finished with flan which was very good.  I also need to mention the pitcher of white sangria which was delicious, well made and among the tastiest we can remember.

author: Robert Czarneski
review_text: Excellent establishment... If you want a great meal before a event on Newark,  you must check this place out !!!

author: Steven Pardalis
review_text: Been going to the Ironbound for 15 years and tonight’s meal was just pathetic. The service was a complete joke. Saw our waiter maybe 3 times, couldn’t get plates cleared, got given two separate bottles of empty ketchup, and didn’t even get to consider dessert because we never got a menu after waiting for 15 minutes. Two of us got lobsters that were barely a pound, overcooked, and had almost no meat. Really just disappointing overall. Go somewhere else.

author: Anonymous
review_text: This restaurant is PHENOMENAL!  After reading other reviews, I decided to go here for Thanksgiving!  I live in Queens, NY and went to Newark to see the movie "Sara's Oil" wanted a spot for dinner and they did not disappoint!  I highly recommend and will stop by again when I'm in the neighborhood!

author: Renee Lam-Whiteman
review_text: Omgggg if you are looking for delicious seafood and paella. This is the place. When you walk in, it’s like you went back in time, almost like you’re on a movie set. The staff is polite and willing to serve. I highly recommend the garlic giant prawns, the paella and the sangria. It’s in Newark but luckily they have a parking lot. Great food!!

author: Alicia Laing
review_text: This restaurant is amazing. I was searching for a place to hold a surprise birthday dinner for my boyfriend. I looked at a few places but decided to try out this restaurant because of the reviews, and when I say they did not disappoint; they absolutely did not disappoint. The food was amazing, the service was amazing, everything was just amazing. When I initially reserved it, it was supposed to be for 10 people, and I was told I couldn't get a private room because the group was too small. To my surprise, they gave us a private room anyway. The room was so beautiful. I've been to many restaurants, and I don't think I've ever gotten  this great service. The food was soooo delicious. Their appetizers oh my goodness they have this mushroom in garlic sauce that I don't know who's foot they put in it, but I could have eaten that one dish the whole night and I would have been satisfied. The vegetables I believe they were steamed, but they must have been steamed in love because they were amazing also. Everyone in my group, including the birthday boy, loved the restaurant, food, and service. I can't wait to go back again. When I got to work the next day, I told everyone they needed to go here. Oh, and not to mention it was not expensive at all. I absolutely love this restaurant.

author: Todd Reed
review_text: Holiday party at Spanish Tavern was outstanding. Food excellent portions and everything was delicious from the appetizers to the main dishes and dessert. Sangria was big hit as well.

author: Danny Mcguiness
review_text: Newark is really cool, never been here, coming to see a hockey game and came for lunch and whatba great surprise, white table cloth and servers all over, great service, the bread was great, complimentary soup, very tasty, we had the roast pork quesdilla very nice and flavorful and I had bone in chicken in a sherry sauce, super good, desserts were tasty as well! Super old school classy feel, will fo again.

author: Raymond Lim
review_text:
Delicious food, good service, in what looks like a housing area.

Seafood paella is chock full of shrimps, clams, scallops, mussels, and half a lobster. Very good.

We have a nice dessert, not unlike a crème caramel, which is quite nice.

Well priced, recommended if you're in the Newark area.

author: Lou Uffer
review_text: Excellent dinner. Great food and service. Best place we have been to in the Ironbound section of Newark. Convenient parking lot across the street.

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text:
We have been coming here for years. The food does not disappoint. They make the best grilled prawns - langostinos around. The dish comes with the potato slices. The steak was cooked as requested and had good flavor. There is always complimentary collard green soup when you have dinner. We drank the mango sangria. For dessert we had the bread pudding and crema catalana. The crema looks like crem brûlée but it’s a little more lemon flavored. The waiters were very attentive and moved our items out of the way quickly to make room for the next course.
The place is an inviting intimate setting.

author: Regi Taylor
review_text:
The hotel shuttle driver recommended that we try The Cornbread Soul Food restaurant. He was absolutely correct in his suggestion.
Dropped in about 7p on Friday night, the place was fairly busy. The staff was amazing, willing to walk 1st timers through their menu choices.
You better bring your best appetite cause you can't eat it all, especially if you select the large meals.
The collards are perfect and you'll drink the "pot liquor "
(juice), the cabbage was slightly crunchy exactly as I like them and the juice was consumed as well.  The yams were sweeten just enough to make your mouth water as they enter your mouth. Of course the Cornbread was the perfect compliment to the meal.
The turkey leg meal was overwhelming, much more than I could eat without taking a nap in the restaurant after eating. Had to get the doggie bag to finish later. The catfish was cooked with a highly seasoned batter that took away from enjoying the full flavor of the fish.
There were many other items I wanted to try but knew I was allowing my eyes to be larger than my stomach.
I appreciate this shuttle drivers recommendation and I too want to suggest this restaurant as a must try!

author: André Thierry
review_text:
Scored à free night from Marriott Bonvoy, staying at the Courtyard Newark Downtown (I broke up with a woman after we saw Wu Tang & Nas at Prudential, but y’all don’t need to know about that.)
Annnyywaayz doe …. My main motivation from taking the train from Manhattan to NJ was to return to Cornbread Farm to Soul, and it did not disappoint! Had honey chicken & black eyed peas and macaroni and cheese and sweet teas! (Just one sweet tea, but I had to keep the rhyme scheme).
Absolutely delicious!!
Ten-course menus in Manhattan are nice to flex with, but nothing will satisfy me like soul food done right.
I cleaned my plate and filled my heart. Glad to be back.
And the service by  Bernice Kim was as professional, warm and faith-restoring as the food and drink.
Thank you Cornbread and Bernice, for making my Friday night and return to Newark memorable
And also making me forget what’s-her-name.
Much love to y’all.

P.S. yes, I know there is a Cornbread in Brooklyn, but THIS location is where it’s at. Felt like I was back in the ATL ❤️

author: Dr. Reynaldo. Evangelista
review_text: Straight up foodies and flavor enthusiasts! Prepare your taste buds for a soulful journey through the heart of New Jersey, where hospitality meets mouthwatering cuisine. My recent visit to Newark's gem of a restaurant left me utterly speechless and completely satisfied. As I placed my order with the courteous cashier, I could sense the passion and dedication that went into every dish. And oh, the food! Each bite was a symphony of flavors, a tribute to the rich traditions of soulful cooking. From the tender fried chicken to the decadent macaroni and, every morsel was a delightful revelation. But the true star of the show was the impeccable service. The gentleman who served my meal did so with an air of grace and genuine care, ensuring that my dining experience was nothing short of exceptional. I urge you, dear reader, to embark on your own culinary adventure and discover the magic that awaits you in Newark's best-kept secret. You won't be disappointed. So, why wait? Treat yourself to an unforgettable dining experience and indulge in the phenomenal offerings of this soul food haven. Trust me, it's a journey worth taking. Enjoy!

author: Stephanie Cartagena
review_text:
Review update/

As you can see by my originally review I was hyped. I got home and saw that zi didn’t get the BBQ sauce I requested many times. I paid $40 and was absolutely SHOCKED at the small portion size. As for flavor I like the Mac and cheese bur everything else had too much salt.

The ladies there are amazing but I wouldn’t buy again.

I posted pics of the food at the restaurant and then what $40 got me when I finally opened up my bag at home.
—————————————-

Ok hold up ✋✋✋✋

First time calling and first time coming here and LET 👏 ME 👏 SAY 👏 THIS👏

The service from Nana, Bernice, Shakira was top notch……

I mean I couldn’t stop talking about. They made it clear you arrive at 9:59 and they close at 10pm and they will take care of you.

I almost don’t want to rate them so high so it don’t be getting packed in here Lol

But highly recommend. Quality service and even at night food looks fresh and the smell will have you ordering way more than you were planning to.

5 ✨✨✨✨✨

author: Dionne Warren-Palmer
review_text: We stopped in here to eat for dinner after seeing the excellent reviews and food pictures. This restaurant did not disappoint! We were greeted when we walked in by NaNa and Shakerea. They are friendly, funny and very outgoing. The dining areas are clean with modern decor. We didn't have to wait long for our food to be brought to the table. My husband and 2 children ordered different entrees and they were all delicious!! It was a lot of food. We couldn't finish it all. Unfortunately, for us, we couldn't take it with us because we were staying at a nearby hotel before a cruise. We are looking forward to our next visit, and Cornbread Farm to Soul will be on our first stops to visit!!

author: Kevin Craven
review_text: This was a STELLAR experience! My friends said that we should all try this place out before the Brandy & Monica concert, and I couldn’t be happier that they did! This place felt like HOME! First off, the service is TOP TIER! There are many places that need to take note because the service I experienced was unmatched! It’s a lovely set up with the full menu on display. I ended up ordering the whiting fish with a side of mac n cheese, and it was absolutely divine! Soul food at its FINEST! Don’t call it soul food if there’s no soul! The fact that they call it farm to soul is spot on because I tasted the love! The fish was so nicely seasoned and crispy! The Mac n cheese got me ready for Thanksgiving! Perfectly cooked, cheesy and flavorful! I also tasted my friends yams, and collard greens, and they were NEXT LEVEL! Those were the best greens I’ve had in my life! The cornbread was also amazing! The woman who took our order was thee absolute kindest! I believe her name was Na, or something like it. She understood hospitality, and my friends and I all greatly appreciated her! All of the staff were just so helpful and friendly, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience! I can’t wait to get back!

author: Kim Quick
review_text: This is my first time here and the food is absolutely delicious.  Had an issue with, and it was resolved immediately. Thank you, Bernice, Za’Myah, and Hassan for providing top-notch service. Very surprisingly it was quite affordable. We have five fish, mac & cheese, collard greens, black-eyed peas, and chicken for under $35. And then we got the Southern Twang beverage that topped it off perfect!

author: Elizabeth Amadiz
review_text:
If you’re looking for soul food that feels like it came straight out of grandma’s kitchen, this is it. I ordered the turkey wings with mac & cheese and cabbage, and let me tell you—those turkey wings hitttttt. The portion sizes are generous (so much that I couldn’t even finish mine), which means I get to look forward to leftovers tomorrow. Definitely worth every penny.

What made the experience even better was the staff. Kim, Bernice, and Nana treated us like family. We weren’t just customers, we were sitting, talking, and laughing as if we were at home in a southern-style kitchen. That kind of warmth and hospitality is rare, and it really made the meal special.

Between the incredible food and the welcoming atmosphere, this spot is a gem. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Robert Williams
review_text: Popped in randomly and ordered the catfish, yams Mac and apple cobbler. All of it was great. Nice creamy Mac and cheese fresh fried fish. Customer service was on point. And the dining area is nice, cozy and clean. Would definitely come back

author: Princess Lizzy
review_text: This food smelled and tasted so good I forgot to take a picture before we started eating! Mike and Nana (I hope I’m spelling her name right) were so enthusiastic and inviting, from the moment we stepped through the door. The catfish was HOT, fresh out the fryer, the mac & cheese was amazing and the cornbread was too! Coming from Atlanta, this was a great first stop for some food and we already agreed to order more tomorrow. Thank you Cornbread!! 🤎

author: Robert Hill
review_text:
Overall the food was very good and flavorful! I had the turkey wings that were very tasty and tender. It was a big portion(3 wings). I had the cornbread that tasted almost like a cake. I personally prefer it not that sweet, but it was good. The cabbage and mac and cheese were good as well.

My wife had the fried fish which she felt was a disappointment with it being dry and salty.

My cousins had the fried chicken and collard greens which they felt were a hit!

Overall, I would say it was a good experience!

author: Bentrice Jusu
review_text: The cornbread is actually amazing! The fish, fried to perfection, you hear me?! Hassan and Mike were incredibly hospitable and treated my complicated order with ease and care. Every time I come in, There’s a diverse crowd  (Asian, Black, Hispanic, white  men and women, and the food ALWAYS looks so delicious. Definitely a staple on broad street, and with it being right across from city hall, well I think they are here to stay! Would recommend 10/10!!!

author: C T
review_text: Nana the waitress was so nice and attentive. Bernice the cook, kudos to her the food was immaculate my first time here and I ate all my food!! It was amazing and fresh. Kim the manager was also so nice and made sure we were taken care of. Definitely would recommend this place and definitely coming back.

author: Neiko Alexander
review_text: The food was amazing! Catfish was so hot, fresh, and crunchy! I don’t play about mac and cheese and it certainly met my expectations. Cornbread was moist and not crumbling apart! Nice comfortable aesthetic too!

author: Krystal Simmons
review_text: Couldn’t even snap a picture before digging in. Food smells amazing, and tastes even better! Worth the price, about $20 for a meal with two sides. If I’m being honest, I normally don’t like cornbread but it complemented the meal perfectly, not too sweet but not bland either. Everything tastes very authentic and made with love and care. The restaurant was clean and I enjoyed the R&B/Afrobeats music. I will be returning!

author: nicole Idriceanu
review_text: Jasmine is the best at teamwork, hospitality and efficiency. The food was amazing (Collard Greens, awesome) and Catfish Poh Boy takes me to new Oreelans: crunchy, robust fish, light and smoother tasting. Thanks Cornbread Soul Food! Thanks Jasmine! Will be back soon

author: Joey Barrett
review_text:
This is the best catfish I have had in a long time and some of the best I have ever had. The baked macaroni and cheese is made almost identical to how my family in South Carolina made it growing up same with the potato salad. On top of all that the cornbread is amazing, sweet and moist. I will definitely return!

In addition to the wonderful, authentic food every one is very friendly. Wonderful service, clean restaurant, no issues at all!!!

author: Bunny
review_text: Berniece, Zamiyah and especially Mike are awesome and they are courteous!  I came in feeling very sad and they lifted my spirits.  Thank you die the good souls food and also making my soul feel better too with their kindness ❤️ I dined in and Mike bright me my food and was very professional and courteous and he is handsome too.  Gos bless this establishment!

author: Richard Harrison
review_text:
I stopped in town while visiting a friend and searched for nearby restaurants when Cornbread popped up. I’ll admit—I’m very particular about my soul food. But let me tell you, this place more than held up to my standards. Every dish was packed with flavor and you could tell it was made with love.

The highlight wasn’t just the food, though. The customer service from Janelle and Mike made me feel like I was right at home. They were welcoming, attentive, and truly made the experience memorable.

And listen—do not sleep on that baked chicken. It is nothing to be played with! Cornbread fed my soul in every way, and I’ll definitely be back whenever I’m in town again.

author: Krystal Quiles
review_text: Mike and Bernice were amazing, the cornbread was excellent and very fluffy and sweet. I’m eager to dive into this meal because it smells delightful. The whiting always fresh- It’s my favorite.

author: Ashley Hackett
review_text: Very disappointing experience. We ordered calamari, chicken Cesar salad and cheeseburger. The chicken was very stale and rubbery. It appears to have been rewarmed several times before serving. Order burger medium - came overcooked. The calamari was also very rubbery. I cannot understand how this restaurant has any more 2 stars honestly.

author: Tezeta “Tez” Roro
review_text: By far one of the worst restaurant experiences I have had. As a business owner myself, I am not quick to give a negative review yet this place lost every opportunity to make things right. We called ahead after an event an NJPAC for an early dinner. We were quickly sat which was a good start. We ordered calamari as an appetizer. I can tell from the first bite that it wasn’t quality food or preparation. The crispy coating came off flaking and I had a hard time grabbing the rubbery calamari underneath with a fork. I ordered a ceasar chicken salad as it felt like a fairly safe option-I was wrong. Before the plate even hit my table I can see how hard the chicken pieces were. Clearly NOT freshly made and looks like it has been warmed up several times. We couldn’t get a waiter to even look our way for a long time much less ask us how the food was. We had to flag someone down and tell them. She told who I believe was the supervisor. No acknowledgement again for a good amount of time. One of our party ordered medium burger and it came overcooked and saturated in whatever sauce was in it. We felt hostage to the place as we wanted nothing more than to leave yet couldn’t get acknowledgement, resolution, a bill or ownership of this experience. The waitress ultimately came with our check. And guess what? It had “suggested gratuity” INCLUDED on our bill and credit card charge which we had to cancel out. It is unfortunate as this is a venue that is well positioned being close to NJPAC yet that days experience has puzzled all of us about the ratings and reviews thus far which is what we based our decision to go there on. I understand that an establishment has an off day or maybe a different chef. Total and complete disregard for the quality of food that comes out or the experience tells me a lot about management. It is often when things don’t go well that businesses have an opportunity to win over customers and create loyalty. There was ZERO ownership, effort or acknowledgment here hence my 1 star review.

author: Rolland Colis
review_text: The paella was as super tasty as it was generous - I felt like I had kept eating it as it went on forever (which is important to me).. unfortunately no frond, but still an awesome dish.. my partner got a shrimp salad which was also quite generous . And I topped it all with a flan.. so decadent and good ! !  I plan on coming back here, especially if staying at RT again !

author: Yuri Choi
review_text:
The restaurant is beautifully decorated and has a nice atmosphere, which is why we chose it for dinner before a concert at the Prudential Center. We had a group of six and came in on Friday night around 5 PM with a reservation. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing.

They advertise lamb right at the entrance, but when we asked for it, the server told us they didn’t have any. On top of that, a few other menu items we tried to order were also unavailable, which was frustrating.

The menu looks extensive, but most of what we tried fell flat. The Caesar salad was probably the worst I’ve ever had.. the chicken was dry and flavorless. We ordered our steaks medium, but they came out almost well-done. Pasta and risotto were the only decent dishes, thankfully.

For a place calling itself a steakhouse, the quality didn’t come close to expectations. Even the restroom felt like an afterthought as their toilet paper was not stocked inside the dispenser, just hanging outside, which was sloppy.

Overall, despite the nice décor and convenient location, the food and service really missed the mark. Sadly, I wouldn’t come back.

author: Tonja Howard Jenkins
review_text: Food was good. Well seasoned and fresh. Our server was kind and accommodating. There was a slight language barrier for us (no one in my party spoke Portuguese), but it all worked out. The music was the only thing off about the ambiance. The decor was steakhouse, but the music was diner/cafeteria. All in all, a great time.

author: Anna Burgess
review_text: What a fantastic night at Medallion Steak House & Seafood. The food was beyond incredible — honestly, out of this world. But the standout for us was our waiter, Carlos. He was thoughtful, kind, and so considerate, and he truly went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. Carlos is the reason this felt like more than just dinner. Highly recommend.

author: Jessica
review_text:
Absolutely awful. Ordered the chicken cordon bleu, and it came out half raw. RAW CHICKEN. One side of it looked like they hadn't even tried to cook it (and the cheese was still solid), and it was drowning in sauce. Told a waiter that it was raw, and he gave us a weird look, looked confused, and said they'd make a "new one in 5-6 minutes". First of all, a brand new one of that thickness would take far longer than 5 minutes to cook, and second of all, they just reheated amd replated the same food (with the slice I cut off placed back on top). Even cooked properly, it wasn't good. The frozen chicken cordon bleu from Barber Foods is better. Whatever, we just wanted to hurry up and leave.

They also served what looked like house-made potato chips as an appetizer, which might've been a unique feature if the chips hadn't been soggy.

But things got worse when we got the bill. After being charged, we noticed that an extra $4 had been added, as well as a "suggested tip" of 20%, with another line for "additional tip". The total charged amount included the "suggested tip", making it a mandatory tip instead of a recommendation. This is for two people by the way, not a party of six. Called the manager over, he explained that the $4 was their credit card fee - this wasn't stated anywhere beforehand. Then, he tried to claim the suggested tip amount hadn't *really* been charged to the card yet: a flat out lie, considering we could see in the bank app that it HAD been charged. Next, he tried to claim that they charged the suggested tip but would refund the total afterward to be whatever we wrote on tip line... we pointed out that the receipt line said ADDITIONAL tip, not total tip. He stared blankly at the additional tip line and said "I've never seen that before". Brother, you're a manager and have no idea what your receipts look like?? Huh?? No, if we wrote something on the additional tip line, I am 100% certain that it would've been added on top of what we'd already paid. Then, he got frustrated with us and said "You know what, I'll just refund this and do it myself, I pay my employees". Uh, if you *actually* paid your employees, you would give them a liveable wage instead of relying on tips to do it for you. To be clear, we weren't arguing that the staff didn't deserve tips, but arguing that it's scammy and dishonest to charge a "suggested" tip and then ask for more on top of that, when the customer is going to assume that the bill didn't automatically include a tip (y'know, like how every other restaurant operates).

Dishonest business practices abound.  Wonder how many people they've scammed into double-tipping using this method.

author: Roger Beaujard
review_text: Very sad excuse for a steakhouse. I had the T-Bone which as you can see was more of a bone in strip steak with almost no fillet. No stand out flavor at all, very thin. Absolutely not worth it. Massive disappointment. I've literally had a better steak at Denny's and that's really sad.

author: Marc
review_text:
So, they don't have any draft beer (they said they were broken... lots of lost sales there). They were also out of the chicken appetizers.  Cod rolls are basically fish sticks, according to server. "Free" chips were super stale, gross. The only thing good about the main dish, was the mushrooms.  Walls were pealing paint ans floor tiles were cracking. Presentation was poor.

Not impressed.

author: Lauren Tinha
review_text: Our team had reservations earlier today, Joseph our server was amazing, he saved the day! The food was okay , but I was disappointed to learn that house items such as the calamari, the chicken parmigiana, and the surf and turf were unavailable during our visit. For that reason, I’m leaving a four-star review. However, Joseph’s excellent service and thoughtful plate recommendations truly elevated the experience to what felt like five-star hospitality. I will return, and I hope the restaurant will be better stocked on my next visit.

author: Jill C
review_text: Really good food! Went during happy hour and got 2 margaritas each at $15. T-bone steak was really good and juicy.

author: Latrone Huggins
review_text: Was an upscale feel with a down to earth staff that attend to our every need. The atmosphere was very comfortable and music was beautiful. A very nice outing for sure.

author: A R
review_text: Great food, great place and exceptional service. The steak was tender and cooked perfectly. The flan was amazing. I spilled a part of my drink on the table, and the waiter cleaned it up and brought me a whole new drink.

author: Max Sulla
review_text:
Understaffed. Definitely not Brazilian. Nice hard working staff but so short staffed that they have no chance to be attentive even if they try. Two waiters and a bartender sharing all roles include a host post.

Didn’t ask once if we need anything else once mains were served. Medium rare steak was medium well. Didn’t ask if we would like coffee or dessert after dinner. We had to ask for bread service. Brought main courses
And left dirty appetizer plates on the table. We had to ask to clean the table.
Don’t know how to make a decent dirty martini either.
And then they added 20% gratuity for a party of 2 !
Convenient location for pre show dinner.
Next table over burger looked good though.
Hope to find a different pre show place to dine at near NJPAC.

author: Del Stokes
review_text: Facilities are nice and welcoming. That is only thing good I can say about the dining experience. Chose the location for my wife’s birthday dinner because it seemed upscale and had okay reviews. Wife is GF(celiac) and tried to order accordingly. Had two different wait staff confirm her order but neither seemed to know what was up with the food choices. They said the kitchen staff would handle the order of grilled chicken and mashed potatoes carefully. Food came out smothered in gravy. She had to send it back while server looked befuddled. Wife didn’t dare to trust anything else from the kitchen or staff. I hurriedly ate my meal and we left. Feel totally flustered and angry that a special dinner was ruined. Would definitely NEVER return or recommend location for another person.

author: Thomas Gross
review_text: I wasn't aware the restaurant was in a hotel and it was a little hard to locate. But, my wife and I are glad we found it. The atmosphere was quaint and quiet. Our server, Joseph did his job well. We didn't have to wait all evening for our food. It was brought to us promptly and the presentation was excellent. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. And again, kudos to Joseph for his service. I had the t-bone, mashed potatoes, asparagus and rice w/bean sauce. My wife ordered steak w/onions and french fries. We both had salads. All foods were cooked to perfection. Very tasty. If there's a negative to our visit, it's the portions are large. I'm a big eater and I had to carry home leftovers. To much food. I highly recommend a visit.

author: Imigrou
review_text:
We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! The food was delicious and generously served, with every dish full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service was outstanding — very personalized, with a staff that was clearly well-trained and attentive.

The atmosphere is warm and family-friendly, making it the perfect spot for our Sunday lunch. A special mention goes to the maître d’, Fabiano, who was especially kind and attentive throughout our entire meal. His attention to detail truly made the experience even better. Highly recommended!

author: Unknown Unknown
review_text: We had such a great experience thanks to our two waiters! Chantel and Renan. They were both friendly, attentive, and made sure everything came out perfectly. You could tell they really cared about their guests, we never had to ask for anything twice. Excellent service from start to finish!

author: Fred Becker
review_text: Just went in for a quick lunch and super impressed.  The steak sandwich was wonderful: tender meat and wonderful blend of flavors.  I ordered it medium and it came out perfectly - not easy to do on thin pieces of steak!  Well done!!!

author: nessa i
review_text:
From the atmosphere to the service to the food, it was overall pleasant
The price is very reasonable and the food is well seasoned. Renan our Brazilian slwaiyer was very nice.

author: Barrett Zeto
review_text:
Highly recommend this place 100%. The staff here was on top of their service, especially right after a show at the NJPAC theater. Small dining room, but made up for the very nice servers and attentive care they put on their customers. Food was fantastic, sauces are DELISH! Burgers are amazing. Cauliflower tots just as amazing. Very transparent on what they have to offer.
Black owned business as well, love being able to support 🙌🏼
Much love to yall!

author: Karen K.
review_text:
Amazing first experience at the yard. Came here with some coworkers for lunch and was pleasantly surprised by this hidden gem. Staff were super friendly and helpful when placing our orders.  Also, they would always come check on us and made sure our drinks were always filled. Superb service!

I ordered the seoul sista fried rice. Beautifully plated with a flower in the bowl. The fried rice was made with kimchi that wasn't overly spicy and a large fried egg on top. The Yaya sauce was creamy and paired well with everything. Overall, loved the dish!

My coworkers ordered the oxtail sandwich, the walla chicken and the chopped thigh wrap. Everyone loved their dishes and want to come back to try the other dishes.

Lastly, we ordered the grilled coconut cake. This is definately a MUST try! First time having a grilled cake and I can say I've been missing out!

author: Adam
review_text:
Had the Fish Fillayyyy with cut-fries, very very tasty. The fish filet sandwich was great and also,  that Walla Sauce I was dunking the cut-fries into was SUPER tasty.

The staff service was excellent. Very attentive and friendly.

Ended up ordering "The Breast" to go and had every intention of having it for dinner but... it's just too damn tasty. Eating it now. 5/5 stars. nom nom nom

Keep up the good work, thank you for existing and also for being open on xmas eve. :)

author: Gina DeGesero
review_text: the warm welcome from the ultra friendly staff set the atmosphere for a meal filled with layers of flavor, spice and the right touch of heat. get the walla sauce and put it on EVERYTHING you will not regret it. save room for the coconut cake, slightly grilled , warm with a moist crumb *chef’s kiss* this is a meal I will say dream about for a long while. can’t wait to come back to Newark, thanks to the yard <3

author: Michael Robinson
review_text:
If you’re seeing a show at the NJ Performing Arts Center and are looking for a bite, this is the place. Even if you aren’t seeing a show and are nearby, this is the place.

I grabbed their chicken sausage roll before a show. It was so good I had to come back again after—to my memory I don’t think I’ve ever done the same restaurant twice in a day. Their fried chicken sandwich was one of the best I’ve had in recent memory (photo included), and they’ve got *sweet potato tots*—nuff said.

Many thanks to Owner Kai and The Yard staff will definitely be back again🔥🔥🔥

author: Jessica W
review_text:
Had the ox tail burger with a side salad. My fiance had wings. It was fye!🔥
Great service. Good music. Cool spot. BYOB. Will definitely come again. 💖

author: Candace Lennon
review_text:
Wow! Wow! Wow!
Out of all the places we googled, I picked the yard. The staff, the food, the grilled pound cook!!
My friends and we're so happy I did. We were not disappointed by a long shot! The staff greeted us as soon as we stepped in. They were very attentive to our needs the whole time.
Even though our flight was cancelled this past Saturday 11/8/25, this excellent experience at The Yard made up for it.

Thank you to all the staff at The Yard.
C Lennon Jacksonville FL

author: My3ti534
review_text:
Talk about service with a smile. As soon as we entered we were greeted with a warm welcome. Oseeta, our waitress, sorry for botching your name, was a ray of sunshine, warm, pleasant and courteous.
The food was to die for. I ordered the rasta pasta with beyond which comes hot or cold. I opted for it hot. While my husband had the shrimp burger with sweet potato tots. We fell in love with every bite. We also ordered fried cauliflower with sticky icky sauce for the table. There were other sauces but this one stood out for me. And let's not talk about the fried Georgia banana pound cake which we initially ordered for our son, but after the first bite we changed our minds. They deserve twenty stars and more

author: Maryn C
review_text: The food is incredibly flavorful, the staff are really kind and attentive, and the atmosphere of the restaurant in the park was very enjoyable. The dipping sauces were the highlight! Spicy ketchup and sweet tots were an excellent combo 👌

author: Maria Sweeney
review_text: This place is an amazing find. We were in the area to see a show at NJPAC and we happened upon this incredible gem of a restaurant! As other reviewers have said, the service is fantastic, so attentive. The food was delicious and beautifully presented. We are definitely coming back here with family and friends!

author: Corey W.
review_text: Well my wife and I visit the Yard a few times a year and they have some great burgers and sauces that are pleasurable to the palette. I had thr oxtail burger and my wife had the Seoul sister fried rice!  It's always a vibe with the music in Military Park in the city of Newark!

author: Bryan McAllister
review_text: Excellent experience.  The team here is welcoming and customer service-focused.  The food is excellent!  For me, I love the sweet potato tots and the marsalla dipping sauce - I'm probably spelling that wrong.  The Yard is on my rotation when I visit Newark for work.

author: Matt Mitchell
review_text: Very friendly staff and amazing food. The Seoul Sista Kimchi Fried Rice was amazing! Got it with the jerk chicken added and do NOT regret it! New fave place in Newark. I wish I had a bigger stomach or more reasons to be in Newark because I want to try so many of the menu items.

author: Catherine Santos
review_text:
We found this amazing spot before attending a concert at NJPAC. I wish there were enough words to describe the quality of our experience.  The staff were so kind and friendly.  Our food was delicious! This Philly girl will happily admit that I had one of the most delicious cheesesteaks of my life!

I hope we attend another show in Newark just to eat at The Yard.

author: Scorpio Lyte
review_text:
I've sent a few people to this restaurant after I was ranting and raving about the food during my initial visit on Nov. 9th 2024   Some of the people I've mentioned it to, have been more than me.

I had the oxtail burger with hand cut fries that were so good I kept eating before picking up my oxtail burger.  The burger was everything too.  I also took a lamb burger home that night which was ok but I'll chalk that up to me warming it up in the microwave.

Fast forward to yesterday July 12th 2025.  There was an Afrobeat festival going on in the park surrounding The Yard.   Hold on to that information.

Now before I go with what I didn't like about my experience, I would like to give a shout-out to the guy who gave me a different burger after I realized I made an error on my burger and offered to pay for both as it was my mistake.  He took back the original I ordered and gave me the kind I wanted without charging me extra.

Upon walking into The Yard, there were 2 signs that read "ALL Orders at the WINDOW. NO Bathroom".

In my mind I figured that meant all to go orders are to be placed at the window & the no bathroom was to keep the people who were attending the festival, out of the establishment.  Crowd control.

My mother and I walked inside to a restaurant that had 2 tables out of about 6 tables with customers. In other words there were about 4 tables available.

I proceeded to tell the employee we will like a table for 2.

From there we were told to order outside at the window.  Confused but we complied.  Once we were outside by the window, we sat there for about 7 mins while the worker appeared to be getting orders together.  At this point I'm ready to leave but I know my mother wants to try the food since I spoke highly about it.

The employee came outside to give out a few orders.  While walking past us twice not saying a thing then I asked "why are we ordering at the window if there are a few tables available?"

She mentioned that they were trying something different because of the festival in the park.😡

We ordered from the window, paid for our food at the window and then were let in to sit down at a table. 😕

One paying for food in advance when I'm going to be sitting in your restaurant is so strange.  Two I never got an answer how ordering from the window then immediately being seated was beneficial for a customer whose intention was to sit down at a table and order.

In addition to that whole process, the food was t served on plates but takeout containers.  We weren't handed a jar/bottle for condiments but one small cup of ketchup for each of us.  Mind you we both had burgers and fries.  And plastic forks, not that they were needed.  I will post pictures

I hope whomever goes doesn't ever experience what I did.  I didn't feel like a customer.  And to think I traveled from another state to try this again and allow my mother to try it as I loved the food.

I made up my mind that I will never go back to that restaurant.  I think the only thing that could change this is a conversation with the owner.

author: Luna Reed
review_text:
Went here recently with my father who lives out of state, this restaurant was a great introduction to the city of Newark.

The atmosphere was very warm and inclusive and you could tell that people are regulars here, it was nice to see our server call their regulars by name.

The presentation of the food is absolutely beautiful (See pictures), and the taste was amazing, our server brought us several sauces all of which were great.

The only thing that could be improved is the seats were a little bit uncomfortable.

P.S. the cream soda is S++++++ tier

author: Ronnie
review_text: I saw a viral foodie review that featured the oxtail burger and the shrimp burger and knew I had to try them both. It was an hour drive each way but I wasnt going to let that deter me. Although the place looked completely full and there was a very large party of about 10 people seated, we were greeted immediately by the host when we arrived and seated. I noticed the owner going around to all of the tables and actually talking with every different party. That really stood out to me. When he made his way over to my table, my husband and I really got the sense that not only does he take great pride and accountability in the quality and taste of the food but he is also a very warm individual who goes out of his way to welcome everyone. I didn't feel like I was talking to an "owner", I felt like I was talking with family. My pictures don't do the food justice but everything was phenomenal and well worth the drive! We got the oxtail burger,  shrimp burger and a chicken sandwich. I actually have made plans to visit again very soon and I absolutely can not wait. This is food that is worth an hours drive each way.

author: Robert Morales
review_text:
I walked in curious and hungry, craving something hearty like a classic cheeseburger and fries. That’s when I discovered the Oxtail Burger—my first one ever—and wow, it did not disappoint! Absolutely delicious and totally worth the stop.

Anaya was awesome, super friendly, attentive, and full of great energy. She even checked in right after my first bite to make sure everything was perfect. Top-notch service and an all-around great experience!

author: L.A. T
review_text:
💎 Gem in the heart of Military Park! It gave me an at-home feel with comfortable seating, friendly service and the best playlist adding an extra razzle dazzle to the experience. The menu (which is digital) has eye catching names for the selections and everything we ate was made to order. From the
Fried Salmon Cakes to the Chopped Chicken with grits we thoroughly enjoyed each bite. There is an outside seating area, concerts in the summer and live music regularly. It’s a beautiful spot and would highly recommend.

author: Charles Binau
review_text:
Our waitress was Aniyah and she was amazing. She convinced me to go with the Oxtail Burger.

I am glad I did!  Seasoned well, lots of flavor and cooked perfect.

My colleague ordered the lamb burger and he really enjoyed it too. We both got the sweet potato tater tots. I got mine dusted with brown sugar. I’m definitely going back.

author: Jason Malandro
review_text: A must experience before a game (or other event) like no other. Redd’s serves up giant cold beers and some delicious food as well. It gets super packed for games, so arrive early and get yourself a spot. Right across from the entrance, so it’s a quick jump over to pick drop.

author: katnnv
review_text:
Reading about this place online, while on the plane to Newark, I was really excited to give it a try.

The plan was for my husband and I to have dinner and a few drinks while our son attended a concert next door.

The beer selection was great, lots of choices and varieties. The food was delicious.

The atmosphere was ok. Aside from the great play list being played by one of the bar tenders, there isn't much else to say about it, except that there is a lot of space and they could accommodate a large amount of people.

The night we were there, it was fairly dead.  Maybe a handful of people at the tables and even fewer people at the bar.

My husband and I sat at the bar and were greeted fairly quickly, but after that the service was non existent.

After getting our first round of drinks and our food, we never got the chance to order another round, except for once when my husband had to flag someone down who had walked by his empty glass multiple times.

The rest of the time the staff stood at the end of the bar conversating and seemed to forget all about us.  We would have ordered at least another round or two, but finally gave up and left to try the place next door instead.

I do love that the bar staff were wearing themed shirts based on the concert that were playing next door. That was cool. The employees were also very nice, just wish they were a little more attentive.

author: Ottotinne
review_text: Very nice and generally calm place to go and hang out with any type of group. I love coming back to this place every once in a while. Heavy inspiration from Bavarian culture. Great for social gathering and watching games. The Beer and Pretzel was nice and the prices were not too bad. The people were also very friendly and helpful in making the right decisions.

author: Holly G
review_text: I want expecting much from this place honestly, looked like your basic sports bar. Service was very friendly but it was really loud. If you are looking for a quiet place to chat, might not be the best option. But wow, the food was SO good! Honestly probably the best bar food I've had in a long time. And I thought the prices were pretty reasonable for the portion sizes. We had the potato pancakes, which were nice and hot and savory. My weiner schnitzel was crispy and the veggies with it were cooked perfectly and well seasoned. The spatzle was absolutely delicious. My husband had one of the sausage meals and really enjoyed it, especially the sauerkraut which was made in house. He also loved all the NJ Devils stuff around. Would recommend for a bite before or after a game or show at NJ PAC which is a quick 10-15 minute walk away up the street.

author: William Pataky
review_text:
We have been to Redd's many times over the years before Devils games, wrestling events and concerts.
The key is to get there early and start a tab with the bartenders that way ordering later on is much quicker and easier.
We have always found the food to be very good. The prices have gone up over the years but that's a nation wide trend.
Even when the place is packed I've never had food take more than 15-20 minutes from order to being ready. You order via a bartender or at the food window and they give you a buzzer. The you go back to the window and pick up your food.
The staff has always been great but of course when you have a packed bar you will be dealing with a certain degree of nonsense which will wear on the patients of even the best bartenders.
The biggest issue is the bathrooms which get a little jammed during busy times.
The street outside is closed by the police and it is always a great festive atmosphere before events.
Redd's is safe and comfortable and being directly across from the Rock , you can't go wrong.

author: Leona Palevac
review_text:
Had the sausage and my girl had a burger! The burger was missing the special Cajun portion to it but our friendly bartender took care of it. The beer was mighty and large and I only wish it was also volunteered in a cooled stein, but I don't know if that's too ridiculous of me to ask!

Place is definitely trans friendly so do not be afraid. They get doordashers who should be forced to wait out front if you ask me. They're too awful standing near the bar, stop allowing them to do that.

Give Redd's a visit! Ask for your order with a toothy smile and I promise they will respond in kind. :)

Update: idk it's not even an event afaik but auto gratuity on a solo check I expect bc of >$50 or

author: Jiani Ding
review_text: Be aware that this restaurant automatically adds an 18% gratuity even though it is entirely self-service — you pick up your own food and bus your own tray. There is no option to choose or adjust the tip percentage. This feels misleading and unfair, especially when no table service is provided. Customers should know about this practice before deciding to dine here.

author: Alexander Law
review_text: I am an immigrant from Germany and loved the food & beer selection. I used to live in Newark before moving to Wisconsin in 2012 and came back to visit. I was so happy to see this place and had a great time. Great authentic food! Thanks for a great experience!

author: Eric Davis
review_text:
I wanted to like this place, but the experience left me feeling overcharged and misled.

This is effectively counter service. You order at the bar, pick up your own food at the window, and clear your own space. Despite that, a mandatory 20 percent gratuity is automatically added, even on a quiet evening with no game playing. There were maybe 20 people in the entire place. The signage suggests the mandatory tip applies during games, yet it was applied regardless, with no explanation and no option.

On top of that, the payment screens still prompt you to tip more, which feels excessive given that the service is entirely self directed. At that point it feels less like a gratuity and more like a surcharge.

The food did not justify the pricing. I ordered the beef brisket, which arrived dry, overcooked, and served on plain white bread with no sauce. The fries were plentiful, but I did not come for fries. At nearly 27 dollars for the brisket alone, I expected something significantly better than average.

To make matters worse, a pretzel listed at 14.99 was first charged correctly, then later rung up at 16.99, plus the mandatory 20 percent tip again. I did not feel like arguing over two dollars, but it reinforced the overall impression of sloppy pricing and a lack of transparency.

By the end of the night, two beers, two basic meals, and a pretzel came close to 90 dollars, for counter service and mediocre food.

I understand Newark pricing and I am not opposed to tipping when it is earned. What I object to is mandatory tipping layered on top of premium prices, especially when the customer is doing most of the work. There are better options nearby that offer clearer pricing, better food, and a more honest value proposition.

I will not be returning.

author: Brian Kalucki
review_text: Great place but seems as if they now auto add a 20% gratuity to all tabs, even if paying cash. Ordered 2 Miller Lite Liters, $15 each (which is a great price for an arena beer!), but to be forced to tip $6 on 2 pours is ridiculous. I'm assuming too many people walked out on the past without tipping and caused this. Or, it's bc the AW next door has been doing this for years and Redds wanted to capitalize. All in all, great place to hang out, with great staff, but a poor policy when it comes to gratuity.

author: Emil Tabakhov
review_text: Bar atmosphere but food is probably worse than I could have imagined.  Everything tasted like it was previously frozen  including the brisket.  Crossing my fingers hoping family and I don’t get sick.  Probably better off eating inside the arena with this type of quality.  We left most of it on the table and not to mention the service non existent but they do not forget to add gratuity up front. Total dump!

author: Aleister Theda Wolfgang
review_text: I was here recently for the party they hosted before the G-Dragon concert and it was absolutely wonderful. The staff was friendly, the food was delicious and quick to come out and the drinks were also delicious. If I'm ever in the Newark area again, I'm definitely coming back here.

author: Blck Bettie
review_text: We stopped here before going to the Prudential Center to see Bill Burr and Andrew Dice Clay! The placed was packed and loud, but not rowdy! Everyone was having a good time while enjoying their drinks and food. Typical German food, which had a good taste; I think I would visit again and try their burger.

author: Santos Shetty
review_text: Highly recommend this place for a hang. Great vibes on game nights and non game nights. Great beer selection and decent food choices. Love the vibe ❤️

author: Jamie Solley
review_text: We ended up visiting on a slow night, there was a big event going on in the area. But the food was so FRESH! I ordered a fish fry expecting to feel like I just had a heavy meal and it was actually refreshing! If I lived in the area this would be my Friday night spot!

author: Peggy Freier
review_text:
Cool place.
Food is good but not authentic german, still tasty. $7 Appetizers during Happy Hour is unbeatable!
Staff is great for laughs or conversation.
It can get crazy on event nights and there is no Happy Hour.
Regular nights are not crowded and you'll definitely find a seat.

author: Nicholas Rivera
review_text: Man this place has changed for the worse. I am assuming the bartenders are just being extremely rude. I  was told I need to show 2 IDs for 2 beers. Mind you I am a grown 40 year old man. My gf and I entered looked for seating because it's impossible to order and then find a spot ... She sat down I waited 10-15 minutes in line to get to order and was told no unless I have 2 IDs. I'll just go next door...

author: Kamilah Harrison
review_text: Both the Red Bull Wrap and Smoked Polish Kielbasa were really good and the staff was super friendly. Such a cool spot!

author: Therese Marie
review_text:
Popped in for lunch while visiting for a concert & devils games. The place itself is great! Was really impressed with their photos, decor, and overall appearance. Truly thought we'd love the place.
We sat at the bar, and there were maybe 6 others in the place. Immediately greeted and took our order.
Ordered nachos - which were really chips covered in BBQ pork toped with old lettuce and old jalapeños.  The BBQ was good, but the overall plate was at minimum 2/10. Motz sticks were not fully cooked, so we were unable to enjoy those.
After we had our initial order taken, however, we were not spoken to again. We were not asked how our food was, especially noticeably that it wasn't being eaten. No ask of drink refills, not even water.
We ended up chatting with a couple who sat next to us, so we were hanging out there for a bit, again with absolutely zero service still.
It took me almost 15 minutes to get someone's attention for my check, which was a whole different girl. I noticed they already added a 10% to their checks, and I did see the sign but was frustrated as it wasn't busy, and the service was terrible and did not deserve an automated tip.
Overall, this experience was a 1 star experience.
However, after cody johnson, we popped in since the other bar was packed. I didn't catch his name, but he ended up making our second experience there way better. He was welcoming, chit chatting with us, and checked in a few times while we hung out. I didn't explain my experience earlier, but I did ask about the 20% automatic tip for events. He explained it added on for purposes like a concert but doesn't apply until the evening or nighttime. I asked a time frame, and he said normally after 4.
This frustrated me more as we were there and left before 4pm. Essentially, we shut down the bar with him and a few others that night, and he made up for bad experience earlier that day.

author: Josh V
review_text: I was here before a concert at Prudential. Not a bad place to grab food and beer. Still relatively expensive compared of you are willing to walk a few blocks away but cheaper than what you can get at Prudential Center. Chicken tenders are pretty solid.

author: Vickie Clayton
review_text: Five stars isn't enough for Don Pepe! This gem has been our go-to spot for authentic Portuguese cuisine for years. The paella is a standout, but the real stars of the show are the fresh fish dishes - the red snapper is cooked to perfection every time. Save room for the flan, it's the perfect sweet ending to an unforgettable meal. Whether you're with family or friends, Don Pepe never disappoints. Highly recommend!

author: Elsa Amaral
review_text: Hosted my daughter’s bridal shower here, and it couldn’t have been more perfect. Tony, our maître d’, was absolutely incredible—attentive, supportive, and ready to help with anything I needed. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the food and service were outstanding. I highly recommend hosting your next event here!

author: Ron M
review_text: We had not been to Don Pepe in over 20 years.  The atmosphere was the same as we remembered, but the food had lessened in quality. The Paella was not as good with regard to the seafood to rice ratio. The garlic shrimp was still quite tasty as we remembered. The Sangria also did not disappoint.

author: Paul Rosetti
review_text: An old school restaurant with great atmosphere and outstanding food . Everything you order from the menu seems to be perfectly cooked . The paella is filled with a variety of seafood delights. incredible side dishes

author: Kim Clark
review_text: Wow! Delicious. We shared the clams casino, I had garlic shrimp. My friend had the grilled branzino. Everything was SPECTACULAR. I meant to take many more pics, but we dived right in! Worth the trip from Brooklyn for SURE.

author: Matthew Wheeler
review_text: My wife and I stopped by Don Pepe's for dinner.  Wonderful food, large portions, prompt service,   an overall excellent dining experience!  My wife had the paella,  I had assorted seafood with Penne pasta in vodka sauce.  Spoke with owner upon leaving, he has been there since 1981!   Make a point to visit Don Pepe's if ever in the Newark area.

author: GrAcIE W
review_text:
Late post.
Heard good things about this place and finally a group of 6 of us made it there for dinner a month ago. Food was decent especially the Garlic Shrimp and Oxtails. But we were not impressed on the Paella as we had better at other places.
Overall not bad, but think it’s a little over-hyped.

author: Rose Nixon
review_text: I went to Don Pepe for a team lunch. They have a lunch menu with paella for $20-$30 depending on seafood/meat plus multiple other options. The seafood paella with lobster was delicious and large enough for 2 servings. The interior of the restaurant is quite large and there is a free parking lot.
