author: DJ Lou Productions (DJ Lou)
review_text: I can truly say it was the best meal I ever had. I had the steak and my wife had the halibut and I love the garlic shrimp and the sangria was out of this world. Definitely a real good experience of service was totally awesome. I would say it’s worth a trip, check out the photos.

author: Andrea Lewin
review_text: 36yrs ago after saying our I-do we had lunch here. Decided to return to the beginning forananniversarydinner. Great staff and service also met the owner.

author: Robert Lai
review_text: Excellent menu. A little pricey. Good parking. Service was very fast, especially when we told them we had an event to get to in 1.5 hrs. Paella Valenciana was great!  Atmosphere can be a bit loud, but tolerable. Lots of seating.

author: Xander Sequeiros
review_text: Excellent service, food on point, the waiters know very well what they are doing and know the menu very well to offer you what you order

author: Jimmy G.
review_text: Discovered by chance in 1998, a fellow wedding professional called me to photograph a wedding for his company, the reception was at Don Pepe Newark, NJ. The Bride & Groom had a table for us, treated us as one of their invited guests. Soon after the reception began I knew I had to bring my wife back to this special venue asap. We’re both solid fans of Don Pepe. Thru these many years that have passed, we’ve taken many family members to D. Pepe. Always on the mark! Consistent! Top of the line quality, food, service & atmosphere. Don Pepe is worthy of our Birthday celebrations. So happy to have discovered this place.

author: Elaine
review_text: Had the chance to try this spot for a work holiday event. Definitely a must-try in when you're in the area. The food was decent and portions were great. The service was quick and friendly. The vibes were comfortable but classy.

author: susan bartolo
review_text:
Great meal with friends.
Food was very good and service was excellent. Staff is knowledgeable and can offer suggestions on food preparations.
Octopus,  mussels, clams and veal were all very good.
Paella is delicious and plentiful.
Their bread is also delicious! Great for dipping!

author: Kristin Klingaman
review_text: Celebrated a birthday dinner and had reservations. Service and food was amazing! We would definitely come back!

author: T Blanco
review_text:
We had dinner for 4, even though when we arrived it was very busy they sat us within minutes.
The server was attentive, mentioned the specials and gave us time to review the menu.  The service is impeccable, from the changing of the silverware and plates to bringing additional bread and refilling the water.  Everyone’s dinner was delicious, the appetizers as well as- we had the broiled octopus, super tender and full of taste.  I would definitely recommend this restaurant if you are looking for great food, attention and reasonable prices.

author: Allie Rodriguez
review_text:
The location was convenient, and the restaurant had great reviews, but unfortunately, I was not impressed—both by the food and by my experience with the valet. While he didn’t park my car, he had plenty to say about how I parked it, which was an unnecessary and off-putting start to the evening.

My bill came to $88 for a paella for one and an order of stuffed mushrooms. While the presentation was excellent, the flavors fell flat. The paella lacked authenticity—I couldn’t taste any saffron, and it was disappointingly bland, as if it was made for diners who shy away from seasoning. A proper balance of salt and saffron would have enhanced the dish, but it just wasn’t there.
Hoping to make the most of my time before an 8 PM show, we ordered dessert. Unfortunately, the flan was overly bitter due to burnt caramel, and the custard itself was overcooked, making it unenjoyable.
The service was great, and the plating was beautifully done, but the lack of authentic flavors was a major letdown. I had high expectations, especially given my travels and past experiences with this cuisine, but sadly, this meal didn’t live up to them.

review_text:

Good location in Newark.

author: Jameelah Wright
review_text: An absolute delight and fantastic time. Passed through on recommendation from a family friend and we all went together. They have many halal options for other muslims passing through for a bite. A few things we got were the chicken salad fish meals and mine a deluxe cheeseburger. And an Uptop (what I usually called an Arnold Palmer) the portion sizes for us all were great and hearty and filling and the fries that came with my meal were the perfect fresh and crunchy. Our server Vivian was an absolute delight and helpful. We happen to be there at a time it wasn't extremely packed  but still busy. I liked sitting down but by my own habits I definitely would take my meal on the go, there were many beautiful areas around to rest and eat. All in all would love to visit here again when I'm in town.

author: Shawnette Fields

author: Daniel Valentine
review_text: It's all about the energy of the place! OMG needs to become a landmark! You cannot visit NJ without going here! Chicc The Comedian, the owner is an absolute vibe! When you walk in, he makes you feel like family! You would swear you knew him for 10 years plus already. The food: fantastic! Great value for money! More than enough goodness in each serving. The service: award winning! The staff: brilliant! So glad I found abut this! Please know, if you go here once, you will be back two or three times or more! I went twice in a week! Yummy.

author: Margie B
review_text: It’s a takeout with food was ready right on time. I ordered it online… I have a left leftover for another meal So good and plenty

author: A C
review_text: Food was really good service was fast and good. This is a carry out establishment. Had the rice bowl with chicken, broccoli, and shrimp with yum yum sauce on top. Family had bbq wings and fries and sweet chili sauce wings and fries. The chicken was great bc it was still crispy with the sauce..not soggy like some other places. The sauce was really good and food was fresh and seasoned well. OMG! You have to try it!

author: Dawn Woody-Poitra
review_text: Here's an honest review. I saw an Instagram video about this place and wanted to give it a try. So I visited on August 31st. I purchased the crabmeat deep fried corn, a seafood cheesesteak sub, and a Philly cheesesteak sub for a total of $39.45. There was a wait about 15-20 mins, which wasn't terrible. The food was good, but not good enough to have me return for a 2nd time.  I enjoyed the deep-fried corn even tho there was plenty of shell in the crabmeat. What helped with my decision not to return was the owner's demeanor & interaction with me (a paying customer). I originally thought he was intoxicated due to his slurred speech, but I didn't smell any alcohol. He was speaking extremely loud, drowning out the lady behind the counter calling orders. There's no seating, so I'm standing along the wall with other customers waiting for my order. He announced out loud to no one in particular that Good Morning America emailed him & that he was about to be rich. So, after I received my order and I'm heading out to my car (still talking to a friend on the phone), this ridiculous guy said to me,'You on the phone? I thought you were Crazy!'  This is the guy who's receiving a lot of support from his community, and this is his reaction to be out in public clearly high off some narcotic and talking foolishness to someone supporting his business. 👎🏼

author: Amir Jefferson
review_text:
Excellent food & many creative comfort food selections. Must repeat!
Limited Food Menu:

1st Philly Chicken cheese steak w/ loaded fries

2nd Meal was: Steak-Brisket, cheese-potato & stir fry shrimp (off daily special menu). Official! Plus side order of bread & apple pudding!

3rd BBQ Beef Short Ribs & Shrimp Stir-fry Dinner $30

4th Bourbon Jerk Lamb Chops & Shrimp Stir-fry Dinner $30

5th oxtail and jerk chicken over rice

🔥

author: Tiphani banks
review_text: I think they call it OMG because when you eat it you say omg no . My boy got very sick from eome funny jerk chicken pasta thing . I had a loaded potato but they forgot load the seasoning and flavor . HUGE PORTIONS of the flavor was there it would be worth that money because the plate can feed more than 1 but I doubt anyone is finishing this . I’m just disappointed tbh . Service was nice

author: AJ Home-SOLUTIONS
review_text:
Absolutely Delicious FOOD! Compaint: 25 minutes wait time😡... But I highly recommend. Pictured R 2 meals from (not online) "Special Limited Menu":

-9oz. Prime Ribeye Steak & Shrimp Stir-fry Dinner $25  (WOW!!)
&
-Surf & Turf Catfish Cheeseburger w/Truffle Parmesan Fries $20

YES SIR Spectacular!

author: Laurie Gibbons
review_text: Them lamb chops saved y'all! Lol cause all that broccoli 🥦 is uncalled for. Even if it doesn't come with it on menu they gonna pack it in there for $30 🤣🤣🤣 Tasted good tho so imma sit down somewhere B4 they ban me! Staff cool a little off putting but oh well and it feels more like a chicken shack than a restaurant. Great music also saved ya! Bbl when I wanna waste $35 on broccoli 😘

author: TRIPLE THREAT BRAND
review_text:
Listen here, I had to think long and hard about writing a review, especially one that was not going to be very flattering. However, after speaking w/quite a few people (most of whom had a similar experience w/OMG), I decided to share my experience w/full transparency.

So let's get to it...my experience was downright HORRIBLE! Let me explain as best I can w/o being too lengthy (if that's possible).

Ok, I am a foodie, and will travel anywhere for good food/service. My family also owned a restaurant so I totally understand what it takes to make a restaurant successful. W/that said, from the moment I walked in people were complaining about the wait. U could literally cut the tension in the air w/a knife. Now, I don't mind waiting because good food takes time...so I'm ok w/that. However, many of the people did not feel the same way. They may have ordered 1 or 2 small things and had to wait nearly an hour...so they were very upset.

When I finally get to the register I asked if they had real or imitation crab meat. The young lady (who was great) said she did not know and to let her ask (which was the appropriate thing to do). A little guy w/dreads gave her attitude when she asked the question. So I then asked, and he replied that it was real crab meat. Now I am starting to get annoyed because the bad customer service reviews that I read prior to going are starting to show face. I finally place my order and go wait outside. While outside many of the people going in and out are complaining about either the wait or the service...I mean mostly everyone (no exaggeration).

People who left and came back nearly an hour later still found that their food was not ready. One older lady ordered 2 items but they only gave her one and made her wait for the other. Why not have both ready at the same time? That didn't make sense! Anyhow, the elderly woman also mad because people who had come in and ordered way after she did, got their food first. She was not happy, to say the least.

So I would go back and forth between the waiting area and outside so I could check on my food. One time doing so, the little guy w/the dreads was mumbling and no one knew what he was saying. He looked my way and I didn't respond because I had no clue what he was saying. Finally, we realized that he was calling a name (which no one understood). He then turns to the owner and makes some seemingly unprofessional comments, and they both start giggling like school kids. It was very disrespectful as well as a complete turn-off.  Then, they turn on the music (gangsta rap w/the curses), and blast it like they're in a club. People couldn't hear u before, so y would u would blast music now. As the music blasted, the owner was putting on an all out concert. How can u sing, rap and dance over people's food while ur cooking....and it's super hot in there? So now it's ok to spit and drip sweat in people's food? Unbelievable!

So as I sit there staring at them, they continue to mumble things about me (I assume). Because I was not happy by any means. I was sitting w/a few ladies and they were appalled w/the service and behavior as well. One said she and her husband experienced the same thing a few days earlier, and the other lady said she'd never come back.

When I finally got my food (after 40 plus minutes or so), I noticed that my container was very messy. They just throw U a bag to bag ur own food, and when some people told me to check how it looked....I was mortified. My food looked nothing like the pictures...i mean nowhere close. I was on 🔥!  I will post pictures so u guys can see what i'm talking about.

Also, when the guy brought my food up he said to the owner, this is his...which really disturbed me. If he was cooking, how did he know what I ordered? Did u purposely mess up my food or do something to it? And I'm not implying that he or anyone did. However, when have such poor customer service, people are cussing and acting inappropriately, it makes u think the worst.

In closing, I want them to succeed but they have to do better. Extremely disappointed!

author: VISION
review_text:
I WAS PLEASANTLY SURPRISED. THE FOOD IS VERY GOOD. IT'S HOT AND FRESH. YOU MAY WAIT 20 MINUTES OR MORE DEPENDING IN HOW BUSY THEY ARE, BUT FOR THE PRICE, IT'S WORTH IT.

IT'S A SMALL PLACE. TAKE OUT ONLY. THERE'S A "HYPE MAN" KEEPING THINGS LIVELY WHILE YOU WAIT. HE'S NOT OVERBEARING, BUT YOU'LL KNOW HE'S THERE. OVERALL, NICE JOB. IT'S IN A DECENT LOCATION, BUT PARKING CAN BE TRICKY. 4.75.

author: Rodney Long
review_text: The food at the establishment I visited was extremely displeasing. Upon arrival, I inquired about the availability of the oxtail hero and oxtail fries, only to discover that none of the items I desired were in stock. Consequently, I opted to order the seafood platter instead. Regrettably, the preparation of the shrimp and meat on the platter seemed to involve an excessively intense chopping, akin to blending them. The resulting taste of the food was unpalatable, and I would strongly advise against patronizing an establishment that sources frozen fish and shrimp which maintain a distinctly frozen quality, likely stemming from prolonged storage in sealed packaging. I warn anyone who's traveling from a long distance to disregard going to this place. Don't waste your time.

author: savanna stroud
review_text: The name says it all OMG. I enjoyed my food so much, and the pink lemonade was good as well, plus the customer service was great. Can't wait to go back to try everything on the menu lol 😋

author: Eric Smith (Mr. So Large)
review_text: One of my new favorite food places!!! OMG is the right name 😋, bout time someone knows how to put that food together right!! You have to order 30 minutes before though cause they get very busy.

author: Nickee Coppa
review_text: Every dish is amazing, and the portions are large enough that you will have leftovers. The owner and crew are funny and pleasant. Overall, we love this spot.

author: Barry Turner
review_text: I just got a loaded potato called Bobby and Whitney. Man that thing was delicious! Freshly made and the service was great.

author: Dyani Crute
review_text: This is my second time eating here and the food is to die for. Today I ordered the seafood cheesesteak and it was so good. The food is definitely worth the wait, today was packed with customers.

author: Tamara Bush
review_text: I tried OMG for the first time last week, and I was pleased with my order. I got the yumyum seafood boil, and it was GOOD! The only thing is I didn't get my yumyum sauce, so I will be back to try it again!

author: Melissa Henry
review_text: My first time ever hearing and eating at this establishment...7 out of 10...the food was delicious but the owner attitude was horrible...I support all black own businesses but I will not be supporting this one again.. first impressions is everything..

author: Frederick W. McCrone
review_text: OMG exceeded my expectations and provided exceptional customer service! The food was simply outstanding!! Highly recommend for top quality entertainment and great food.

author: Moses
review_text: Terrible food quality, terrible food presentation, everything looked dried and not taste. The native rice was just terrible. Hard. Not fresh. And red stew was flavor less.

author: Samuel Oghogho
review_text: Food is really great.Well made African and Nigerian dishes.I tried Ofada rice and the  sauce and it was fantastic.Also got a takeout the jollof rice which is always amazing.Food can be pricey but its worth every penny.

author: Sonia
review_text: The lady serving the food was very rude and lack customer  service and for what ever reason, in a rush to take the customers  orders. I went into this restaurant  to purchase food for myself and a friend that was visiting  from out of state and was embarrassed by the service that was provided. The character of the lady was extremely poor and tasteless. To the owner please train your staff and employees  on how to deal  with the public no matter where  your customers are from. The treatment  was unacceptable  and becuase of this I will never patronize this restaurant  again.

author: Ify Akpone
review_text: I love coming to this place every time I visit Newark, New Jersey. The food reminds me of the motherland Nigeria. I love the fact they have special soups for everyday of the week…Mon-Fri and they all taste amazing. I do recommend their Efo-Riro you can never go wrong with that meal. And their Jollof Rice is practically the best Jollof in Newark. Don’t argue with me argue with your mother oooo. But sincerely if you want a good naija meal and you are in the Newark, NJ area stop by you won’t regret. 😁😍

author: Oyin Ayo
review_text:
My review is about catering. We do not know the owner or anyone working from this establishment. Although, I gave a 5 star for the atmosphere, I can not actually rate the dining space since we have never eaten there. We are a family that simply loves good food.

I have used 9jabuka to cater very important milestones in my family order the past year. It is the only jollof vendor my partner will accept.

Depending on the number of guests, they have only provided the best of the best! We have ordered pans of jollof, ayamase w/ white rice, nigerian salad, pepper soup, and most recently a cooler of jollof rice. I believe they are reasonably priced for catering. They are always on time for the pick-up and the food is always fresh, tasty, and hot (if applicable). There is a $50 deposit if you need to borrow a cooler like we did. We will continue to be a customer.

author: Arthurlyn Cee
review_text: Service here is terrible! Unfortunately, the server who assisted us had a very negative attitude, which made the service unpleasant.

author: Update
review_text: When I see good things I don't hesitate to support and give commemts. I went for a party 2 blocks away from this restaurant, saw cars parked outside tge restaurant, so we decided to check the place out. The environment was classic, the food is well cooked and delicious. i have been back there with friends and family from Trenton, which is over 56miles to enjoy the food again and again. I feel much as if am in Lagos each time am there. Pure Nigerian food, you need to try it.

author: Ebenezer A. Awolesi
review_text: This restaurant evokes memories of my youth in Nigeria. The food is excellent, service is professional.l, there are a wider variety of choices.  Having a catering service is also a plus. I ordered ahead and it was ready upon arrival.  This is our go to Nigerian restaurant. And strongly recommend this to anyone looking to enjoy Nigerian cuisine.

author: Tunde Ojo
review_text: A friend recommended and i decided to try it out. Best tasting Naija food I’ve had in north east area in a while. I ordered half pan of Ayamase and Ogbono and the meal was very well packaged and more importantly so delicious. I shall be back again

author: kimberly deschamps
review_text: I started visiting this restaurant about a year ago after trying every Nigerian restaurant in Newark and surrounding towns. My husband has an eclectic palate and so far most restaurants have been a miss. I bought the banga soup with the catfish head and it was soo good, it broke my heart to share it with my husband. After that I tried the edikidikang soup and it was a hit with my husband. I love the different soups every day..bitterleaf, egusi, vegetable is a hit with him too. We ordered jollof and fried rice for my baby shower. It is my go to for food now. I absolutely love the moi moi and akara. The staff recognize me and are very helpful and efficient. There is a sit down area but I do strictly takeout because I am always running errands. They close at 7pm and not open on weekends and I respect that because the food is always fresh.

author: adrien nicholas
review_text: First time visitor, the service was welcoming. As I came towards the end of the day there wasn't any pounded yams or fried plantains. But the jollof rice was tasty, but turkey was a bit on the oily side.

author: Tosin E.
review_text: I was in the area to make my hair and was really hungry. Saw high reviews on google and decided to try. I got the ofada & ayamase... the taste was average. The ofada was just a lot of oil and ponmo, and the quantity was small...quite unsatisfying.

author: Journey4Peace
review_text: Joloff is not good to me, they give u sooo much rice w very little meat, then what I thought was a trky wing I purchased on the side an it was just the tip, which was hard...very hard an chewy, tiny piece of cow foot just the bone, happened twice, i decided to gv another chance but im good now, we need zoodoo African spot back, the customer service is rushed but the tip jar is rte there , oh also over priced

author: FR. WENCESLAUS E. Y. Yoh
review_text: Among many in New Jersey,  I found this restaurant the best. Real naija taste is here that will wow you. Original delicious Nigerian food with a clean environment and kind, welcoming and understanding staff.

author: Adeshola Andre
review_text: Delicious yummy food, clean environment and deliver food on time,no disappointment

author: humphrey phery
review_text: I always love coming here. Had moi moi, veg soup, banga soup, some fried turkey 🍗 and fried kidneys ..... with poundo yam and amala.... that's like 2 days food gotten one time... I really enjoy the moi moi here... so tasty, succulent and nice color 😋

author: Adekemi Alabi
review_text: Delicious and tasty food.Very classy and d owner’s customer service is outta dis world.All d way from Indianapolis she made me feel at home.

author: Oghenetejiri Okpodu
review_text: the food tastes great , i miss nigeria so much that it made me feel at home again, i will definitely come here again

author: T.
review_text:
Authentic Nigeria food absolutely delicious.

Lagos is right here.

author: Samuel Wale-Oladimeji
review_text: Considerable prices, food is 100% Nigerian delicacy. An Afican Restaurant to visit in Newark Nj area. Njoi ur meal

author: Monica Palencia
review_text: Ichiran is hands down one of the best ramen spots I’ve ever been to and easily my #1. The ramen is on another level—rich, perfectly balanced, and packed with deep, authentic flavors that burst in your mouth with every bite. The chashu is incredibly tender and flavorful, literally melting in your mouth and taking the ramen to the next level. From the broth to the noodles, everything is done to perfection. The employees are respectful, attentive, and quick whenever you need something. This place is an absolute must-try for any ramen lover. 🔥🍜

author: J J
review_text:
Went to Ichiran Brooklyn
Honestly, it’s exactly what you expect from Ichiran — super consistent, same flavor every time, and still hits the spot.

We sat at a regular table this time, not the booth, so it felt a bit more chill and less “exam mode” lol.
The broth was good, noodles were on point, and I like how you can customize everything.

BUT the toppings are still kinda tiny 😂
The pork, the green onions, everything feels like “sample size.”

A little pricey, but I still end up coming back.

author: Hermes Arriola
review_text:
We went here after a nice sweeeem.
Here’s a weeb comment. I went to an ichiran in Kyoto many years ago. I was hungry and they were offering it for breakfast.

When I heard that ichiran was coming to Brooklyn of all places, I was excited, but never had a chance.

This time was different. We went and it was wonderful. I like that it’s 1 type of ramen and it’s delicious. 2 if you’re vegetarian.

It’s very tasty and I recommend getting kaedama to really fill up as the noodles given can be slurped down in no time, and you’d have plenty of broth.

Really great place. Highly recco and apparently kids eat free. Ughhh… kids. They always eat free. Like what the heck. Why not borderline geezers like me?

I didn’t take pics of the food because we were hungry and photos were not my priority.

Anyways… EAT IT!!!

author: T M
review_text:
This ramen is really yummy — honestly some of the best I’ve had in NYC. The concept of the restaurant is super cool: individual booths, minimal interaction with servers, and no tipping culture, which I appreciate.

That said, there’s only one thing on the menu, and I wish there were a bit more variety. Also, I was a little appalled at paying $28 for ramen and still having to peel my own egg.

I’ll probably be back because the ramen is solid, but I’d love to see this place expand its offerings and refine a few details.

author: Rimi Gill
review_text:
The ramen is pretty good and the solo booths are fun, but I find this spot is very overpriced for what it is. $26 if you want ramen and basic toppings. Ramen is my favorite food and I’ve tried many of the NYC staples. This was my least favorite and I’ll explain why.

They make you peel the egg and my egg was served cold and overcooked. The pork (chashu) is plain and not braised. The broth and noodles are very good. I was missing the bamboo though and it’s not an option to add on.

The service was weird. I got a 4 spice level based on their recommendation. I found it not spicy so I asked for more and was told I would be charged extra if I wanted over 10. I wanted a 6 anyways, but for $26 you should be able to choose any spice level…

Once I got my extra pepper, I was told I have to add it right away and they would take the extra since it is a secret recipe and they can’t leave it with me. I felt pressured to add it quickly instead of tasting intermittently to my liking. I get it’s their special recipe, but maybe don’t ruin the eating experience by hovering to take the extra pepper back?

I’m glad I tried this famous spot, but I probably won’t be back

author: Daniel B
review_text:
I ordered the Classic Tonkotsu Ramen with the following customizations:
• Yes Chashu
• Medium Garlic (recommended)
• Rich broth
• Yes to Scallions
• Level 2 Spicy
• Medium Dashi (recommended)

The ramen was delicious — seriously flavorful. The broth came out rich and creamy with a nice balance of heat from the spice level I chose. It wasn’t overpowering, just enough to linger in the back of your throat in a good way.

I’m really glad I took the time to customize it, because I think that’s what made the bowl hit just right. The garlic, richness, and spice ratio worked perfectly. The noodles traveled well and had that classic springy texture. Chashu was tender and buttery, even delivered.

For delivery ramen, this was top-tier. Not cheap — with all the fees, it came out to $27.77 — but the quality was strong enough to justify the price for a once-in-a-while treat. Would definitely order again, with the same customization.

author: Constance Rhodes
review_text: Had a great time on a sunday night. Broth was delicious and the booths were fun. We waited in line for maybe 25 min at 8:45 pm. Soup came quickly afterwards! Add ons were maybe a little expensive for what they are but the rest was great!

author: Annie Robertson
review_text: obviously fire, as always. I got the set which is good but a bit more expensive. Next time I think I’ll get the vinegar sauce they have and maybe just add an egg instead. Nice staff, good food, good vibes.

author: Z z
review_text:
All the other Ichiran locations had ridiculously long lines 🍜, so we drove out to this one in Brooklyn. This spot only offers one type of ramen — perfect for the indecisive 😅 — though the menu overall is pretty limited.

The price is about $30 per person, which is fairly normal for NYC 💸. As for the taste: not bad at all, but definitely not worth a super long wait. The broth was the best part — rich but not greasy, really flavorful 👍.

There were two kinds of pork: one served in the soup, and the other on a separate plate. The one on the plate was much tastier 🥩, while the one in the soup had a really strong, almost unpleasant smell 🤢.

Overall, it’s worth a visit if you’re nearby and want to avoid long lines, but not a must-visit spot unless you’re in the area 📍.

author: Dwight Kenneth
review_text:
Ichiran Bushwick has a really unique concept with the solo dining booths and quiet vibe, but overall the dine-in experience left us wanting more.

The ramen itself is good—solid broth, tasty pork and seaweed, and the egg was actually great (even if you have to peel it yourself at the table). I’d rate the ramen itself an 8.3/10 for flavor.

But the overall experience drops it down for me. You order on a tablet, there’s no real service to speak of, and everything feels pretty impersonal. The pricing also feels high. A regular bowl starts at $20 and jumps to $26.50 with add-ons like egg, mushrooms, seaweed, and scallions. And the portions for those extras are small. $3 just for some extra scallions is WILD!!! .

Ambiance was fine, but nothing amazing. Honestly, it seems way better suited for takeout than dining in.

Overall giving it 3 out of 5 stars. Worth trying if you’re craving tonkotsu in Bushwick, but I’d skip the booth experience and take it to go next time.

author: Star Nguyen
review_text: The broth is deep, rich, and almost secretive, whispering layers of pork and spice. Each slurp of perfectly firm noodles feels like a quiet confession in a world too loud.

author: Kevin Le
review_text: Once you get into the establishment, there are tablets for you to place your order and then you have the option to sit in a single booth or table. We sat at the tables and were greeted promptly about our order. The time it took for our order to come out was fast, maybe about 5 minutes of waiting. the broth was warm ( I would’ve liked it a tad bit hotter), the chashu in my opinion was too flaky. The server and front desk were really nice and helpful.

author: Sage Staten
review_text: I’ve been here countless of times and enjoy my experience each time. They recently added a kiosk system which takes away from the full experience however the ramen is still amazing. Make sure to keep track of your points if you’re a local like me. They add up quickly. This place is also nice for bigger groups. I brought a party of 7 here for my birthday and we all had a good time.

author: Hidenyan
review_text:
Ramen is as good quality as the one in Japan, but portion is small although the square bowl with too much raised bottom looks big.
Serving is kind of slow due to cashless system.
I ordered a kaedama (it says 15 seconds blah blah...), but it actually took 5 minutes...
21 bucks including tax and tip.

author: Kristina Sørensen
review_text:
Overrated in my opinion.
Toppings to the ramen came 20 min before the actual ramen and I’ve definitely had more flavorful ramens. Ramen was okay but in my opinion it was not worth the hype. Also smaller portion than you think as the bowl is not as deep as it looks

author: Hsin-Roe Pan
review_text: The broth here is really good! It comes in such a cute box. It doesn’t get crazy busy at this location either. Only the meat tastes a bit mushy and the portion is pretty small for the price. Not bad though

author: Rony Gomez Jr
review_text: For this trip to New York this place was the best food we ate all trips! I ordered two bowls back to back. It was a great experience, and it brought out the little kid in us with the curtains. This place was perfect 👌

author: Mimi Coleman
review_text: Ichiran Ramen is hands down my favorite ramen spot of all time! I’m not even a big ramen person, but this place changed everything for me. The soup, noodles, and katsu pork are absolutely perfect — so rich, flavorful, and satisfying. I finished every last bite! I also love their katsu pork appetizer — I order it every time. This famous franchise truly lives up to the hype. A must-visit for any ramen lover (or even non-ramen folks like me)!

author: Yaya Perez
review_text:
Went to eat by myself this place was recommend by so many people
The ramen was so rich and full of flavor.Noodles perfect
I had the perfect meal, quiet, comfortable and fast service. Best ramen I've had , Would go out of my way to come back again

author: Josie U.
review_text: I always love coming here. The food never disappoints— it’s hands down the best tonkotsu ramen. The seasonal items are delicious too. I loved the yakibuta!!

author: J
review_text: Chicken tikkah Mac and cheese was amazing. It consists of 2 well marinated tenders on top of Mac and loaded with the minty sauce. The spicy smash burger was good, but next time I would request no mayo sauce (or only on the side). Definitely trying the Nashville sandwich and the chicken & waffles combo next. Definitely a top pick for Nashville style halal on Bedford Av.

author: Ahmed Farid
review_text: When I entered the restaurant, there was no one at the counter. Three workers were outside talking, and I had to call them in for assistance. They came in with a bit of reluctance, which didn’t feel very welcoming. I ordered the Pataka Fries with chicken ($12), which turned out to be delicious, topped with a sweet sauce and served in a generous portion, perfect for one person. I also tried the Beef Smash Burger ($9); although it was quite small in size, it had a good flavor. The ambiance was pleasant and comfortable for dining. Overall, it was a good experience, and I would recommend visiting.

author: Hatice Büşra Kürk
review_text: We ordered nashville and tikkaville burgers. They were delicious, I did want my food to finish actually. The personnel was very kind and helpful as well. We ordered smash burger for the kids without spice, pickles etc. and they ate all of it, even though it was just cheese and meat and we ordered another. Pataka fries has a special sauce with garlic and spices, it was addictive🥹 I will tell my friends about this place and certainly come here again.

author: Vincent Li
review_text:
Chicken sandwich and fries both came out cold.

Also they charged us for an extra grilled cheese sandwich and when we brought it up they said it would get fixed before they charged it but it didn't.

Food looked good, but 100% not worth

author: Mucho Garcia
review_text: Really enjoyed this place!! The food was really yummy! The fries was warm but on the colder side when it was served to us and so when I told them about it they gladly made me a new fresh one and it was soo tasty with a nice crunch. The playlist was really good too lots of Charli xcx and Ariana Grande so good vibes. Really happy with everything we ordered and would be back the next time we are in the area.

author: Mahedi Bhuiyan
review_text: I’ve been coming to this Namkeen for years now and the food, service, and quality has been consistently outstanding to this day. Most recently I went with a big party and the crew there handled all the orders with confidence and professionalism. Major props to the guys in the back pushing out all this amazing food. Definitely try the Nashville sandwich if you’re there, the clucking waffle sandwich is also a great option, but do not miss out on the loaded pataka fries (my personal favorite). Thank you Namkeen, and keep up the great work!

author: Fateema Akter
review_text: Namkeen is such a pretty restaurant and the staff are so sweet, especially Angie in the front :) We got the chicken and waffles, “hot” is not for the weak.. and the waffles were so tasty!! Everything comes out fresh. Definitely a great place to go with friends.

author: Penguinrating
review_text: Excellent place, excellent atmosphere, good service. The sandwich was excellent. The waffle was very fresh. The chicken was fresh. All the ingredients were fresh, a little spicy for my taste, but everything was good. The bathroom was a little dirty. The entire place on the outside was very clean. I liked hearing the chefs singing in the kitchen. A little expensive. The chicken had a lot of flour. Speedy 6/10.

author: Shamiha S.
review_text: Amazing spot! Affordable and delicious. Everything we tried was flavorful and well-spiced. We ordered the clucking waffle sandwich, the tikka melt, and their spicy smash burger. All of them were great!

author: Dania Zaidi
review_text:
Amazing Experience at Namkeen!

Food at this place was on point! We tried the Nashville and Tikkaville burgers, and both were absolutely amazing. I loved their Dhamaka fries – perfectly seasoned and paired wonderfully with all the sauces. Everything was made fresh, so it all came out hot and delicious.

The staff were incredibly helpful and attentive, ensuring a great dining experience. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving flavorful burgers with a unique twist!

author: Arsalan Atta
review_text: Incredible! I used to put chutney on my burgers as a kid, never expected a restaurant to do this. I should’ve taken a photo of the meat after taking a bite, it was great!

author: Yujing Wang
review_text:
Got scammed by the Good Google reviews 😅
The chicken tenders were way below my expectations. Anyone who’ve tasted Dave’s Hot Chicken would understand my disappointment.

author: sümeyye kabasakal
review_text:
The place was super cozy I loved every little detail. It was simple, but the small touches were so aesthetic. My friends ordered the Chicken dhamaka fries, the Waffle Sandwich, and the Tikkaville Sandwich. I was full, so I didn’t get anything at first, but I ended up taking a bite from their food and it was delicious! They loved everything and said they’ll definitely be coming back.

When it was prayer time, I asked if they had a bag or anything I could use to pray on. One of the employees went to the back and brought me a prayer mat. They were so kind and thoughtful. We loved the place, the food, and the people. Definitely going back again!

author: Abhinav Sridharan
review_text: Truly one of a kind fast casual Indian dining. The Nashville sandwich was the right amount of seasoning and crisp with some desi flavors. The mac and cheese and tikka bites hit the spot also.

author: Ashley
review_text: Best fried chicken in Williamsburg, possibly all of Brooklyn. Addicting sauce, fluffy buns, and a ton of chicken. The maple wings, the classic sandwich, the Mac and cheese are all stars. We usually order pick up but dining in is low key with good seating.

author: Will M
review_text: The staff was very nice and the place vibey but the chicken sandwich was just okay. I got the medium and it didn’t feel spicy at all, I got the hot and it was just overly seasoned, not really hot.

author: Kiran Aravapalli (akakiran)
review_text: Went here a while ago and then came back, I think it has really dropped off - the tenders I ordered were cold, and the mac and cheese was also cold and given to me before my full Oder, And possibly the worst cole slaw I’ve had in recent memory and look how small it is! Biggest issue was they no longer offer tap Water! - Aparently people broke the cups (in Williamsburg really?) - it is a disappointing cash grab and I won’t be back because of it.

author: Craving Calories Foodie
review_text: Pricey but Halal. The atmosphere is pretty clean and calm. Service is good. Chicken is pretty-made and heated before serving. The Nashville sandwich is average. The waffles and chicken do not go as a sanwich/burger style. It’s practically too big to be eating as a sandwich/burger. It looks really good aesthetically in pictures/display.

author: Rupkatha Mukherjee
review_text: I just wanted to mention that their food is good but extremely spicy. Me and my friend ordered mild chicken tenders and chicken waffle and we almost passed out because of the spice level. My friend and I are both Indians from India, and this space offers extremely spicy food which can make you dizzy. The taste is great, no doubt but you will surely get sick the next day. I usually do not write reviews but for others safety it is required. I was extremely hungry so I took a few bite and then felt super dizzy and was sweating. They did offer us extra ice cream since we couldn't eat the food. The ambience is nice. My recommendation will be to add a warning when you are adding that level of spice. My friend is from Delhi who likes spicy momos and paanipuri and this was extreme. Stay safe out there!

author: Farhan Eram
review_text: We came with a party of nearly 32 people and even despite the immense traffic - service and quality of food was nothing short of terrific. We all left the establishment on the cold winter night feeling full, warm and most importantly, SATISFIED. Thats the Namkeen way!

author: Weston Corbin
review_text: The steak is phenomenal in every sense. The dry age is perfect and the seasoning is just right. It truly is a quality steak. The portions on the salads, appetizers, and sides are large enough to share. The German hash browns were particularly delightful. The atmosphere is somewhat stale and the service is good, not great. Overall, one of my favorite New York steakhouses.

author: Ilyxoxo
review_text:
Honestly, I wouldn’t come here again. The atmosphere is great and the place looks fancy. The food and the service on the other hand, not so great. Our server was friendly, but very pushy. My table noticed he kept insisting that we add additional items to our meal, if you know, this place is very expensive. So that was off.

After getting the bill, we tried to tip $15 because I thought tipping was the customers choice based on the service provided, but apparently not. We had to tip $50 which is insane. I don’t know how this is acceptable to these people, you’re already making tons of money from your overpriced items , but that isn’t enough for them.

Now the food, it was ok. I enjoyed the steak and the sundae, but it wasn’t worth the price. I’ve eaten at steakhouses with better food and service, where they actually don’t force a $50 tip. I’ll be seeing myself there.

author: Caroline Tomon (Carrie)
review_text: What a great experience!! I recently had the pleasure of dining at Peter Luger while visiting my son in NYC. We did jit gave reservations the evening we dined however we did arrive earlier in the evening. We shared a house salad and tried the bacon to start. The salad was perfect as a start to our meal, simple yet fresh and delicious. The main course was absolutely amazing. The steak was cooked to perfection and just melted on your tongue. We enjoyed our server Mr Lou immensely who added some fun to our meal. Nothing beats spending time with those you love especially when the time you get is limited and spending a bit of that time with a bottle of champagne and a delicious steak and great service is appreciated. This experience was a treat I won’t forget and I hope to repeat on another visit to the city.

author: Doug Ainsworth
review_text: Excellent experience.  One of the best steaks I've ever had. We did feel a little rushed but service was still great. We got the steak for 2 and was amazing. Really need to order it rare or medium rare its still going to cook in the butter once it's on your table. I know it seems over the top but spooning the butter over the meat takes it to another level. Can't go wrong with the German potatoes and finished it off with some cheesecake.  Had several cocktails and a beer all were very good as well. For how well known and rated the place is prices weren't super crazy but you will spend 200 to 300 for 2 people. I would definitely come back again or at least try the one in Vegas.

author: Bill
review_text:
Peter Luger delivered an old-school steakhouse experience that felt cozy and down to earth at the same time. We shared the steak for two with creamed spinach and sautéed mushrooms. The steak (medium rare) was incredibly tender with plenty of rare, juicy center cuts, and the signature sauce added a refreshing contrast. The creamed spinach was silky and perfect; the mushrooms were fragrant but a bit salty. Portions were huge, easily more than we could finish.

We ended with the cheesecake and its iconic mound of whipped cream. Our server Eric was charming and funny throughout. Also worth noting: they only take debit or cash.

A hearty, high-quality, and quintessential NYC steakhouse experience!

author: Vanessa Yiu
review_text:
One of the best steak experiences I’ve had! The steak was insanely good—juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The crispy fries were the perfect side, and the desserts were just as impressive.

The vibe is classic NYC—bustling and full of energy. Staff were super friendly and made us feel right at home. Be ready for a bit of a wait even with a reservation, but trust me, it’s totally worth it.

If you’re looking for an unforgettable steakhouse in NYC, Peter Luger is a must-try!

author: Vivian N
review_text:
We shared one steak and also got their sundae which was huge! We got our steak medium and it was pretty good. We made sure to drizzle the meat juices on the meat as well.

The server served us each a slice of the steak in the beginning which I thought was pretty cool. It also explained why most of the google review photos didn’t have a fully intact steak lol.

The sundae was a must-try for us- they’re known for their whipped cream. However, the ice cream itself didn’t taste like anything special. There was just a LOT of hot fudge and whipped cream. It was good but also got sweet/heavy fast. It could definitely feed four. The server showed us how to eat it which is to stick the entire long spoon into the sundae and pull up lol but it was so big.

Surprisingly the milk chocolate coins were really good imo.

Oh and I don’t think they take credit card (it’s written on the menu) so make sure you bring a debit card or cash.

If you are celebrating a birthday or something, we did see them sing happy birthday to a couple tables.

author: Del Mar Dave
review_text:
Love it or hate it - it's incredibly popular and not always easy to get reservations. New York mainstay, tradition, with a cult following who fiercely defend its reputation as one of the top steakhouses in the country. I'm probably one of those. Your waiter will likely be a stodgy older gentleman with years of tenor.

I don't know of any other restaurant that only takes CASH - no credit cards wow. Unless you have a Luger's house account charge card. I'm one of those; had it for over 30 years. Be careful don't forget about this - bring CASH.

I'd love to tell you everything is excellent, but I've always ended up ordering the same things, never did a deep dive on the menu.

STEAKS. Important advice, if you go solo, don't get the single steak, order the steak for two it will cook to your temperature better, the single is too thin. You're going to love the dry-aged (they age in their own butcher shop in the basement - some creepy stories down there over the years for sure), it's a Porterhouse cut with both Filet Mignon and New York Strip, in an extra thick-cut steak. So, take the rest home for sandwiches and skip the steak for one.

SIDES. Recommend several: Shrimp Cocktail they are giant - add side of extra-hot horseradish. Sliced tomato and onion (goes great with the Peter Luger Steak Sauce). Thick cut bacon, also great with the sauce. My last trip, for the first time ever I went with a Caesar Salad which was excellent. If you're looking for a rich, creamy, cheesy Creamed Spinach, you'll probably want to pass on their version - it's more "spinachy".

DESSERT. I've only had one. The giant Ice Cream Sunday - assuming you have room in your stomach after dinner. Outstanding love the globs of chocolate sauce.

This is not a new and shiny place, for those looking for an upscale dining experience. 100% OLD SCHOOL. I love the place, its cozy to me despite all the high energy and touristy crowds. Arrive, check in, have a Martini at the bar and take it all in. Love it or hate it - you'll have an experience you won’t regret.

author: Gavin Ransom
review_text: Brilliant!  Love the crazy busy vibe, the old school charm and the fantastic food.  Started with the awesome bacon and a cedar salad, both perfect.  We hit steak for 3 between the 3 of us and it tasted wonderful but was easily enough for 5! The PL fried potato was nice and tasty.  Cheesecake and Holy Cow fudge sundae were both fantastic and massive and the side of cream was enough for days and days!!!!

author: Omer Anis
review_text:
Lunch at Peter Luger in Brooklyn was nothing short of phenomenal. I ordered the steak for one, accompanied by the creamed spinach and the legendary apple pie, and every bite was perfection. The steak was beautifully charred on the outside, tender and flavorful inside, truly the kind of cut that reminds you why this place has been an institution for over a century. The creamed spinach was rich and perfectly balanced, and the apple pie… simply unforgettable! comforting, crisp, and decadent all at once.

A special mention must go to Denise, who made the experience exceptional. His warmth, attentiveness, and effortless professionalism elevated the entire meal. He struck that perfect balance between friendly and polished, making me feel genuinely welcomed and cared for.

author: Cathy Brelly
review_text: It was our first time going there but definitely not the last. The steak was delicious, overall the foods we've ordered were perfect. The service was commerdable as well.

author: Cindy Francis
review_text: My husband and I celebrated our anniversary at Peter Luger Steak House in Williamsburg, and it was incredible! The rustic old-time charm adds such a warm touch. Eric, our server, was amazing, attentive, kind, and even surprised us with an anniversary treat. We had the Steak for Two with baked potato and fries, perfect portions and absolutely delicious. Finished with the chocolate mousse cake and homemade whipped cream, which was the perfect ending. A true New York classic worth every bite! 10/10 recommend and can’t wait to return!

author: San
review_text:
Even with a reservation, we waited about 30 minutes standing in a crowded corridor before being seated — and our table ended up being right next to the restroom. The hygiene standards were disappointing: staff handled cash and then served food without washing hands, and several aprons looked noticeably dirty.
The food itself was good, but the overall experience did not match the expectations.

author: Goran Vadina
review_text:
Everything was absolutely perfect at Peter Luger. The steaks were flawlessly seasoned and cooked to perfection. The meat was beautifully seared on the outside while perfectly juicy and tender on the inside. The house beer was top quality and complemented the meal wonderfully. Overall, it was an excellent dining experience that I would highly recommend.
Ps.. cash only is a little bit down side as I dont like to travel with to much cash in my pocket.

author: Randall Hicks
review_text: This was a bucket item place for me. I didn’t know if I would ever have a chance to eat here. Reservations were easy through their website but plan ahead the time slots are taken up and it can be difficult to get in here. The staff are very welcoming and knowledgeable about their food. We did arrive about 30 minutes early for our reservation and the staff were gracious enough to fit us in with under a 10 minute wait. We ordered the Sizzling Bacon and tomato and onion appetizer. Both were phenomenal. Side note, the bacon slices are very big. We ordered 1 a piece and that was 1 too many. We started with a Cesar salad that was great. Then for our entree we had steak for two. We have different preferences for our doneness and the restaurant was able to accommodate that without difficulty. For dessert she had the chocolate mousse cake and she was impressed. Peter Leugers is a world class steakhouse and is on many people’s list to try. It’s worth it if you’re given the chance. Very important-they only accept cash or a Peter Leugers card.

author: Hanna Lin
review_text: Rsvp is highly recommended! We love the service and the atmosphere of the rustic steakhouse. The steakhouse for 2 was perfect for me and my daughter. My husband and son opted for a couple of burgers instead, but they unfortunately wasn't impressed.

author: Jenny Shin
review_text:
We visited as a group of three — two women (Two women who usually have small appetites) and one man — and ordered the steak for two, baked potato, tomato and onion, and spinach. The portions were generous, and we left feeling very full and satisfied.

Our reservation was for 5:45 PM on a Tuesday evening. Although getting to the restaurant during rush hour from Manhattan was a bit challenging and the location was somewhat unusual, it was absolutely worth it. It was the best steak I’ve ever had, and the high price felt completely justified. Everything we ordered was delicious, and the place was quite busy. I would definitely visit again.

author: Elizabeth Wang
review_text:
Peter Luger in Brooklyn is definitely worth visiting — the steak was delicious, cooked perfectly, and you can really feel the sense of tradition and history in the place. The old-school vibe adds to the charm and makes the experience memorable.

That said, it’s pretty inconvenient that they only accept cash or debit cards. In 2025, that feels a bit outdated. Still, the food and atmosphere make it an iconic spot that’s worth trying at least once

author: Aleksandra Dacko
review_text: Dining at Peter Luger Steak House in Brooklyn was truly exceptional. The steak was a masterclass in preparation, perfectly seared on the outside and tender within, showcasing the deep, rich flavor that only comes from expertly aged beef. The accompanying salad, though simple in concept, was executed with remarkable precision and freshness, proving that even the most straightforward dishes can be elevated to excellence. The atmosphere carried the weight of tradition, with a timeless New York charm that made the experience feel both iconic and intimate. Service was attentive yet understated, allowing the quality of the food to remain the centerpiece. This was not just a meal but a reminder of why Peter Luger continues to set the standard for steakhouses.

author: Joshua Dyer
review_text: Peter Luger delivered a great experience. The portions were generous, the service was attentive, and the steak was cooked to perfection. The apple strudel was a nice finish and tasted really good.

author: Peter Vu
review_text: L’Industrie absolutely lives up to the hype. The crust is light, airy, and perfectly blistered with just the right chew, while the sauce is bright and balanced—not overly sweet. Every slice feels thoughtfully made, from the classic Margherita with fresh basil to the richer toppings like burrata and pepperoni that add real depth without overwhelming the pizza. Even when it’s busy, the quality stays consistent, and the slices come out hot and fresh. Easily one of the best spots for authentic, no-nonsense pizza that still feels special, and well worth the wait.

author: Alexey Subach
review_text: Overall the pizza is nice and probably one of the best spots to try New York style pizza. To me the flavours were not as prominent and the price/quality ratio was a bit low. This place often has a large queue and the staff is not able to cope with the demand even they all work hard. Sausage pesto pizza didn’t have as much sausage but it surely had the spots of cream cheese that they put on most of their pizzas. I wish the baked cheese had a more prominent flavour. The dough structure and crunch was really great though. The New Yorker pizza was nice but the flavour was very straightforward of course. Overall if you want to try the New York style pizza then I do recommend this place. Not sure I want to be back and try it second time though

author: valeri bolkvadze
review_text:
Just had the best pizza experience in Brooklyn, and it's no wonder L'Industrie is topping everyone's lists—it's the best for a reason! Tucked away in the heart of Williamsburg, this spot nails that perfect balance of no-fuss vibe and top-tier quality. I grabbed a classic cheese slice and the mushroom one, and holy cow, the crust is insanely crisp and thin without being floppy, with that ideal char that screams "made with love." The sauce has this rich, tangy kick that pairs perfectly with the gooey, high-quality cheese—none of that rubbery nonsense you get elsewhere.
What sets it apart? It's not just the pizza; the whole setup feels effortless. Minimalist counter, friendly crew slinging slices like pros, and that fresh basil on top? Chef's kiss. I scarfed down two slices and was already plotting my next visit with friends—maybe the pepperoni or sausage next time. If you're in Williamsburg craving pizza that actually lives up to the hype, skip the lines at the tourist traps and head here. Hands down, one of my new favorites alongside spots like Martha's for that reliable quality hit. 10/10, would recommend to anyone who takes their slices seriously! 🍕

author: Mike
review_text:
In my NYC Summer 2025 Pizza Top 5 list, there's a shared second place. One goes to L'Industrie Pizzeria in Williamsburg.

This is what I imagine a NYC pizza to be. The crust is a bit crispy, but not too crispy, not too little—just right. The dough is perfectly thin. The tomato sauce is fantastic. The cheese is subtle and not overpowering, and most importantly, there's no dripping grease on the pizza (unfortunately, like with many other NYC pizzas).

Be prepared for standing outside for about 20 minutes (in NYC, the waiting line duration is always 20 minutes, no matter where or what you're on line for). The staff is treating you with the typical NYC roughness but everyone is still friendly. Don’t forget: Ya‘ll always get a smile back when you smile first!

Around the shop, with a few standing tables—you usually get the pizza to go—you can still find the original, not-yet-quite-gentrified Williamsburg. But don't worry, everything is still harmless here.

Highly recommended.

author: Dessa R
review_text: On a Saturday evening, worth the wait. The line goes fast because the staff are super efficient. Got a slice of the cheese pie and for fun, a slice of the bacon & fig jam. The cheese slice was delicious, great char, cheese/sauce ratio and flavor….now the bacon and fig jam was soooo delicious (salty & sweet—>perfect balance). It’s gets crowded as it’s a super popular spot, if you find a spot inside along the windows, snag it). Next time would love to try the burrata slice.

author: JungJim 1776
review_text:
L’Industrie Pizza — Burrata Slice Review

Busy for a Thursday, but for good reason. I ordered the burrata slice and the presentation was excellent. Overall, it was a very good slice — 7.9/10.

The crust had a nice crisp, though it could’ve used a bit more time in the oven. Slightly greasy, but not enough to detract from the experience. Still well-balanced and enjoyable.

The atmosphere was my main downside: standing-room only and very crowded. Elbow-to-elbow dining made it feel a bit chaotic and had me feeling antsy. That said, I appreciated the small details — like the canned water branded with L’Industrie, which was a nice touch.

If I return, I’d skip the single slice and go straight for one of their artisan pies with more toppings. While it wasn’t the best slice I had that day, it absolutely held its own on a full Brooklyn pizza walking tour. I’d definitely recommend it.

Scorecard

🍕 Slice: 7.9/10

🔥 Crust: Crisp, could be more done

🧀 Toppings: High quality, well-presented

🏙 Atmosphere: Crowded, standing only

💧 Details: Branded canned water = nice touch

author: Jason Fong
review_text: This is it! The hype is real! This is the most delicious pizza I’ve ever had. Lots of flavor from the grana padano, the sauce was deep and tangy, basil was fresh and beautiful. Crust was perfectly crisp, with just the right amount of chew. It’s worth the wait. On my trip I also tried best pizza, John’s of bleecker, Angelo’s, and I liked this the best by far. Service is impeccable as well.

author: Ryan Naman
review_text:
Is the hype real…?

Short answer… Yeah!

Guess we got lucky going in on a cold ass night cause there was no line and plenty of room to grab a spot to stand and eat a slice!

This pizzeria has been on the bucket list for a minute and I’m glad I was able to make the trip out to grab a slice!

I don’t remember the names of the slices… but they were fantastic! I love pesto and on pizza that’s this killer it was an amazing experience!

But I’m here to rate the cheese slice baby!

8.9 Amazing, would definitely be back and would eat it drunk in bed every time!

author: Mendel Davis
review_text:
Absolutely worth the trip from Baltimore! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I came all the way from Baltimore specifically to try this spot, and it did not disappoint. The burrata pizza was phenomenal—creamy, fresh, and perfectly balanced—and the Margherita pizza was classic, simple, and executed flawlessly. Every bite reminded me why great pizza doesn’t need to be complicated.

On top of the amazing food, the service truly stood out. Wendy, one of their incredible team members, went above and beyond and even let us try the Neapolitan dessert—which was the perfect ending to an already fantastic meal. She was warm, knowledgeable, and genuinely made the experience memorable. Wendy absolutely deserves a raise and a promotion.

Between the quality of the food and the outstanding service, this place is a must-visit. I’d gladly make the drive again without hesitation.

@Wendy hmu on Ig @godsworkinprogress234

author: James
review_text:
This is possibly the most hyped pizza spot in a city that's known for pizza, so I had to make my way over here to this Brooklyn spot. The line was present, but not too long - about 15-20 minutes or so

I got the Burrata slice, which is just a basic cheese pizza, with some burrata on top
If I had one word to describe this slice - it would be light. It was so thin, and so easy to eat. There wasn't an excess of anything - cheese, sauce, or thickness.
The dough was probably my favorite part. The air bubbles near the top showed how well-fermented the dough was. It was very airy and fluffy overall. The only downside was I thought the bottom could've been cooked a bit more - it was missing that cracker-like crunch associated with other NY pizzas. While still cooked well - there was a good char on the bottom, better than most places, it wasn't quite at that absolute top level

The mix of cheese & sauce over the top was very high quality. Like mentioned before, there wasn't a lot of it. I think I prefer a pizza with more cheese as it's a little bit plain for me, but the fundamental aspects of each ingredient are fantastic. I thought the cornicone on the outside was also very good
The burrata topping was very nice, and probably the highlight for me. It's not something you see at most classic pizza places, and it added a super creamy nature to the sections where it was present

This pizza cost me around $7, so it's on the slightly more expensive side when compared to a typical slice. I would say it's enough for a light meal, but don't expect it to keep you full for long.

Overall, I think this pizza is excellent, and one of the best individual slices I've had. The artisan style is impressive, but if given the choice, I think I'd stick to the more classic NY-style variety. 9/10

author: Michael Wedd
review_text:
One of the great NY slices. Get in line with 20+ minutes to spare at peak times. Get the burrata, NY slice, sausage and pesto, or anything else. Order to eat in (standing) for the real experience.

The crust is crispy, the mid crust gooey, and the toppings like burrata being deluxe without over the top add ons.

The service is friendly and smiley despite the chaos. Legit!

author: M M
review_text: One of the best pizza in NYC!!!! Dough are freshly made. Doughnuts are also made in house. You can see they mix the dough and the dough that are proving to rise. Pizza itself was really aromatic. Crust was perfect. Highly recommended

author: Rachel Deterding
review_text: Worth the hype, although expect to wait in line for a bit (we waited about 20 minutes on a Saturday around 2:30pm. If you want to dine-in inside, expect standing dining only and to be elbow-to-elbow with others with a fair ampunt of noise. The line moved pretty efficiently, and the pizza was really good, and decent value. The staff were efficient and friendly.

author: Herman Ng
review_text:
In my opinion it is the best pizza in NYC that I’ve had. What I like about the pizza is it isn’t too heavy, more on the light side. The bottom is crisp with hardly any flop.
I went to the Brooklyn location on a Monday, early afternoon. There was a banal line but it moved quickly. There are spots inside or outside to eat your slice.

author: Ryan Tammaro
review_text:
Super light slice with a nice blend of cheese and sauce but a crisp slice. It’s excellent!

Loved the chocolate chip cookie but probably not worth $4

You’ll have to contend with a line and likely limited to no seating but worth it for this slice!

author: Mohammad Naimur Rahman
review_text: Went to this place for try the pizza as I heard is very popular. Sometime you have to wait in line to order. I tried two of their popular pizzas. The food was ready with in 20 mins. The pizza taste was really good. Also after finishing the pizza tired the ice cream too. The food was really good. Highly recommended 👍.

author: Erin Johnston
review_text: Probably my favorite slice in NYC so far. Had the burrata slice and a Pesto sausage special. Crust is very good. Crispy on the bottom and thin but with a nice chew. Flavorful. Ingredients and toppings were all high quality. Pricey for a slice of pizza but in this case, it’s worth it! Visited on a Thursday around 4:30pm and no line/no wait.

author: Callin Mullaney
review_text: One of the best pizza places I've been too and a top contender in NYC. The staff was ridiculously friendly, the slices were huge and amazing, and the wait time (despite the long line) was not a big deal. This is a must stop for any traveler visiting Brooklyn or a local looking for the best place. Can't say enough great things about this place.

author: Tom Bouwhuis
review_text: L’Industrie is an absolute bucket list spot and more than worth the hype. We arrived just as it opened and it was already starting to get busy right away. By far, these were the best slices we had during our time in NYC. We tried three different slices— the burrata, the L’Industrie slice, and the spicy salami — and each one was absolutely awesome. Perfectly crisp, flavorful, and unforgettable. A must-visit for any pizza lover. We shared 3 slices with the two of us and were super full after.

author: 조현진 (jhonny)
review_text:
I took a bite and it was so good that I got back in the long line to buy another one. But soon you came over and said, “Are you guys buying again? You don’t need to wait in line twice,” and helped us out. And that’s when I met the best fig jam ever. (I won’t say too much in case it causes any trouble for your shop—but I’m sure you know what I mean 😉)

We felt like we received such a big gift that day. Your warm kindness made us fall even more in love with New York. Thank you so much. You’re truly the best pizza—and it was one of the best moments ever. 💛

A hundred stars!

author: Ellen Turner
review_text: Big portions, fresh ingredients, great value. I liked that they had impossible meat and friends liked their jerk chicken. I do wish I had read the review that said to get a bowl before our visit, the burrito is a two hander and will burst with the amount of food they put in it.

author: Jimmy Y
review_text: Ordered uber eats from here, paying full price for half the portions isn't fun.  Can't recommend the delivery here.

author: Yvngumar
review_text: Couple things to say about this place. 1 its a pretty small place to dine in not much tables around as you can see in the video but plenty of space to move around. The menu is pretty wide as in there are a diverse amount of options to choose from which is good. It’s Mexican grill so the 2 main course are tacos and or burritos. There is also the option of the bowl which is plenty if you ask me but not as much as it would be in its counterpart hot peppers. Hot peppers and Guac time are kind of like the apple and Samsung companies in this situation. Both are competing within the same industry of Mexican grill restaurants and both have relatively the same options when it comes to choosing the ingredients. There are only a few slight differences like the portion sizes, sauces available, pricing, locations etc. I will not get into every one as I would be here forever but all you need to know is that compared to hot peppers this place is somewhat lacking. I paid $17 for a burrito bowl for half and half portions when the guy clearly charged me for double. I also told him to tell me when I was ordering something that would cost extra and he neglected to do that so communication is not a strong point in this place. Overall the atmosphere is clean and oriented and it does smell nice so I will give them that.

author: Conner Nevel
review_text:
Fresh and tasty ingredients. However, do yourself a favor and get the bowl

They’re not great at wrapping your burrito

author: Dana Curran
review_text: A great quiet place to get delicious food in generous portions. This is like what Chipotle used to be, but with better quality and not a massive corporate chain.

author: Jack Gray
review_text:
Visited the restaurant for the first time today and everything was flawless. The guy that built my bowl was friendly, accommodating, and diligent. Everything was incredibly clean and the AC was working overtime, and while I didn’t dine in, the seating looked comfortable and ample, as far as the Chipotle-esque restaurant model goes.

The bowl itself was a great value; it tasted great, was uniformly constructed, the ingredients were fresh, and it was extremely filling, which is a hard find around here these days. For $15 I can’t think of a better value in the neighborhood to be honest.

I’m vegetarian/pescatarian so the impossible meat and fish options were clutch.

I enjoyed this over Chipotle by a long shot, and am happy to have a quality alternative.

author: Kagu Kagus
review_text: Food is really good. Portions are fine only if you buy at the store. Used uber eats to get their food the other day.... bowl had such a small portion in it. For a moment i though driver ate some of it 😆 (he did not)

author: N. T
review_text: It’s SO GOOD but I had food poisoning from this place (burrito bowl)

author: Pete Deserto
review_text: The spicy cauliflower burrito bowl over lettuce is a delicious and refreshing meal on a hot summer day. The crispy cauliflower, combined with flavorful guacamole and mango salsa, creates a delightful explosion of taste. The freshness of the lettuce adds a nice crunch to each bite. Overall, it's a tasty option for those seeking a flavorful and healthy dish.

author: Zaryab .Z
review_text: Salad Bowl - Light yet filling, with a perfect mix of fresh veggies and flavorful dressings. A great choice for a healthier meal option.

author: Inshrah Siddiqui
review_text: Salad Bowl - The perfect light meal that’s still full of flavor. The fresh ingredients make it a refreshing option for any time of day.

author: Rameen Mansoor
review_text: Salad Bowl - A fresh option packed with crunchy greens and your choice of toppings. It’s light yet very flavorful.

author: Umair Saqib
review_text: Burrito Bowl That’s Just Right! Loaded with fresh toppings, flavorful protein, and a perfect balance of textures.

author: Dil ki bt
review_text: Loaded Nachos - These nachos are the perfect snack when you’re craving something cheesy and indulgent.

author: Omar Waqar
review_text: Great prices and portions. Lots of seating and clean. Close to the water. Much better than Chipotle

author: Nachiket Mehta
review_text: Angel - wow. Never experienced better service in NYC. Amazing burrito also. Highly highly recommended.

author: Yaniv Gheber
review_text: Very friendly and quick, great food! Great if you're hungry and need a perfect quick meal!

author: DREX Official
review_text: Went here for the grand opening and was 2nd in line; super friendly staff and customers lol; I had the jerk chicken and bought a bag of chips!

author: Melinda D
review_text: Delicious 😋, I recommend the mango salsa on your burrito bowl

author: Alisha
review_text: The flavors are fresh and vibrant, and the staff is super friendly

author: Anthony Nieves
review_text: Whoever thought of this place is a genius,  a moderately small space but lots of choice, friendly staff, fast service, and an app that lets you order seamlessly and has Google pay as an option. 10/10 would recommend and the food is just the icing on the cake, amazing tender and seasoned boneless chicken with tasty, crispy fries, this is just an absolute unicorn of a place and you should try it! If the owner is looking at this, I would love to be a part of any advertising/ promotion because I enjoy this place so much!

author: B E
review_text:
We ordered salads from Royal Greens and overall it was tasty just like other salad places in the area. There wasn’t a lot of each of the toppings added and they forgot the avocado which were paid extra for. They also don’t note which of the salad dressings have dairy and which do not.
Overall the app works well, quick and easy ordering/pickup, and good promo for new customers. Customer service was also responsive to issue with missing avocado and credited the account. I’d give a half star extra for that.
We’ll try again and see how it goes. Decent concept of being able to order different foods from one place to pickup.

author: DESMONT
review_text: Wonder Williamsburg is a fantastic spot with a unique concept! I especially want to highlight the salmon bowl—fresh, delicious, and perfectly balanced. Every detail of the dish reflects the high quality of the ingredients and great care for the customers. The atmosphere is cozy and modern, creating a welcoming vibe. It's definitely a place I want to return to and explore more of their exciting menu!

author: Emily Moenning
review_text: I got shrimp tacos from the Mexican brand. Flavors good, shrimp cooked nicely. Cold and stiff corn tortilla led to cracking and breaking. But it’s nice and thick. I feel like if they warmed up the tortilla I would be giving them a 5/5 stars. It’s nice in a pinch because you can choose different cuisine options and it’s right by the Trader Joe’s which is good for errands. I would come here if you’re starving and need something convenient but if you want tacos because you’re trying to have like a cute Mexican lunch you should just go to an actual taco place.

author: Dave
review_text: Oops all ghost kitchens!!!! Never seen worse reviews for a place on google ever. This place operates TONS of ghost kitchens on grubhub. Why? Because if they told you the food was coming from wonder, you would check the reviews and not eat there. Unfortunately, this is something you have to do now for any restaurant you don't recognize. It almost tricked me and I am pretty pissed about it. Go away.

author: Emily Porter
review_text: Love this place . Mya does an amazing job every time I order a meal. She’s very pleasant and professional. I appreciate her customer service.

author: Jimmy Tanico
review_text: Ordered the brisket and gotta say I was pleasantly surprised. I get the concept and was skeptical. Got the brisket home and I was genuinely impressed with the price and value. My daughter lives in Williamsburg and I am in the suburbs and I expected the  typical Williamsburg price gouging. Honestly, I am writing this after buying the same brisket meal a second time. When you go back to a food establishment and order without looking at the menu - that's good food.

author: Vijay Kabaria
review_text: This might be my first review ever. I seriously hate this place. My whole heart hates it. I think it’s a cancer to new york city and williamsburg. it’s soulsess. it’s private equity for food. my biggest qualm, apart from the bad food is that their branding is wonder. hopeful. magical. and yet they’re so lifeless. they pretend to be serving all these bespoke restaurants— this is literally a ghost kitchen. they market so hard. i hate them so much. god this place sucks.

author: Nick Boyd
review_text: This place is really gross and not worth trying even if you get one of the coupons they offer. Nasty reheated meals premade in a commercial kitchen in NJ and heated up in a water bath or microwave for you. Completely cynical corporate restaurant concept that’s essentially a ghost kitchen masquerading behind marketing budgets and false claims of being a “food hall.” Terrible for small business, terrible for your taste buds. Skip it.

author: Faye Zheng
review_text: If you wanna some microwaved food, feel free to order here. Or you can just buy from trader joes and save you 80%

author: Lee Martin
review_text: I’ve yet to have a bad meal here or one I wouldn’t order again. Bobby flay steak NY strip was cooked and seared perfect. Tejas BBQ brisket a thing of beauty. Limesalt like an elevated chipotle, wish there was more guacamole in the side but all in all, the food is always ready for pickup very fast and food is fresh. Have been able to take advantage of the promo codes w friends and take food to the park it’s a life hack.

author: Jiahui Jiang
review_text: I mostly order their briskets which is a five star. Other things I tried there were mediocre. Ordering online then picking up later is super convenient

author: Simon P
review_text: Delicious food that you order online via the app for pickup in store. Service is usually good but can be a miss sometimes.

author: Rob Z.
review_text: Interesting concept, terrible execution. Much is lost in the transition from a restaurant to a central kitchen, with terrible food quality standards as well.

author: Erycka Ortiz
review_text: such a good experience and accesible. the food is fresh and taken care of.

author: Dan Barman
review_text: Beware, I’ve had real Di Fara’s many times, and this is not it. Food is fast and convenient but not good. My wife and I tried 4 different places through Wonder (including Di Fara’s), we had high hopes, but everything was subpar. The people working the counter are very nice

author: Ryan Huber
review_text: Poor quality food served at a premium price. Disrespectful to the consumer.

author: Clement Gomes
review_text: Amazing, amazing, amazing! Such an awesome concept to get a delish variety of food options and can be delivered right to your home!

author: Eric Lamy
review_text: The food was great the service was on point. Will go there again

author: Diego Cejas
