review_text: so nice i went twice. both times same server and guy was super helpful with pairings and food / drink recs for x amount of people in your party. burger was something to talk about along with the calabrian chili bread and verde lasagne. playing bay slaps during early dinner service was a nice touch.

author: Colby Agostinelli
review_text: Incredible food & service. I absolutely loved the Calabrian chili butter polenta bread with the stracciatella cheese as well as the 2 sheet lasagna. The affogato and the green salad were just fine.

author: Anja A.
review_text:
I did enjoy the food at Hellbender, but the service could have been better.
We were among the first guests seated, yet it still took about 5–8 minutes for our server to notice us and bring water.

The portion size of aguachile is quite small, considering the price. The Brussels sprouts lacked flavor.

On the positive side, the empanada was amazing, as were the mushroom tacos and fried cheese.

author: Jordan Napolitano
review_text: Came here for brunch on a Sunday, had a reservation. Sat at the bar for a drink before we went to our table. Drinks were really good we had a few each, service was great. We ordered a few different things, the bloody Maria mignonette with the oysters was tasty and a little spicy. The pork tacos were incredible and of course we got the masa pancakes which were delicious but so filling. The jello of the day was a Concord grape jello with peanut butter drizzle and a homemade whipped cream which was really really good. Would love to come back here. And the bathrooms are huge!

author: Christopher Blair
review_text: Ordered about 9 or 10 dishes here and all were incredibly delicious. Dishes are ordered to share. Also tried a margarita and a bloody maria, very well made cocktails. Highly recommend, worth a trip to Ridgewood just to visit the excellent Mexican restaurant

author: Rob C
review_text: To start off I wanted to love this place. My wife and I love trying Mexican restaurants. Very friendly staff and service was great. Now for the food thats another story. We ordered the fried oaxacan cheese and it was a little greasy but good. We also ordered the pork tacos I have to say the pork itself was bland but what they top the tacos with was delicious. For mains I ordered the chilaquiles which was not good. It was cold and had no flavor like it needed salt or something. My wife ordered the enfrijoladas and again was just bland missing those wonderful Mexican flavors. Overall it was a big disappointment food wise. Something me and my wife were excited about.

author: Stephanie Logan
review_text: Very tasty. The chips and guacamole were crunchy and fresh. The Oaxacan cheese was perfection. I also really enjoyed the specialty drink. It contained a liqueur made by monks. The drink was a great compliment to the meal

author: wallace dos santos
review_text:
Easily five stars, maybe even six 👀🤌 seriously delicious food. Like seriously, this is game changing.

My friend and I started with Chamoy Pear dish, which was absolutely mouth-watering and zesty. Then we got the Baby Gem salad, which was an interesting New Age twist on a Caesar. THEN, omg, we got the lamb shoulder with some tortillas on the side. DAMN! That went crazy…. And the sauce… omfg.  Soo fricking good. No notes, just so delicious.

Service was excellent & we sat outside. Would have loved to have gone inside or tried dessert. There were so many other dishes on the menu that seemed really interesting as well, and unique flavor combos. Apparently there’s a real stuffed cheetah in there (allegedly). Can’t wait to go again!

author: Franco Scardino
review_text: Great food and drinks!  The mushroom tacos and hamachi appetizers were a real standout.  The cheese empanada was reminiscent of a calzone, but more delicate and refined.  The crispy lamb is a must and bursting with flavor.

author: Jim Blair
review_text: We ordered several small plates / appetizers for brunch and shared them.  Literally every one was delicious.  In total we had about 9 or ten different plates, from guac and chips to mega thick cut bacon (pictured) apple pear salad to enfrijoladas and more.  Probably the best meal so far of our visit to Brooklyn.  Don’t miss it!

author: Leandra Edelson
review_text: First off, the churros are INCREDIBLE and I can’t say this enough. The whipped cream is salted a tad, which perfectly balances out the peach compote and sweetness of the churros. I love a salted whipped cream and have never found a restaurant to do it. 10/10. we got a seafood platter special app which was truly fantastic. The steak was also great especially with the charred peppers, we got tortillas on the side which was perfect. Mushroom tacos are a must and so is the fried Oaxaca cheese !!!! Really great experience and super friendly staff

author: Daniel
review_text: Delicious brunch with a Mexican twist. The masa pancake in particular was unreal. The fried crispy edges mixed with the soft and moist center. Perfect blend of sweet and savory with the syrup, butter, and spices on top. 10/10

author: Es Thompson
review_text:
Amazing!! Go there!!

The service was sooo good. The hostess was so nice and friendly. Staff kept checking on us all night and giving us etas on the food which was appreciated but unnecessary because everything came out faster than expected. Waitress was very helpful and gave great feedback on choices.

Food was out of this world. We order so much so we could share and there was not a single thing that missed. My friend had to covertly unbutton her pants lol. Everything was soooo flavorful and well balanced and thoughtful. Im not a huge fan of tacos but I ate these right up. Comes with 2 which are about 2 bites each. You really have to finish them there because they didnt look like they would hold up well going home.

Steak basically melted in my mouth. Ive never had such a well made steak. The waitress suggested medium rare but I asked for medium and it was perfect. I struggled to finish it but again new that it wouldnt reheat well at home. My friend got the lamb shoulder and that was also delicious , has a nice kick and that was even better the next day reheated.

The watermelon....I could eat 100 pieces of it. I had to tell myself not to lick the plate.

The churros with blueberry compote.... oh man! I had no idea that blueberries had so much game. Absolutely delicious, not overly sweet, paired so well with the churros and the cream. I was so sad when I reached the bottom of the bowl....churros, I miss you everyday.

Only complaint is had out of the whole experience was that it was a bit noisy...it got better as people left for the night. This is also a me thing so I won't judge the restaurant for this lol but I hate bathrooms with black toilets.

And just an FYI for anyone with a shellfish allergy, they informed me that they use the same fryer for everything so the lamb shoulder is a caution since it uses the same fryer as the shrimp.

author: Raul Bussot
review_text: I’m a big fan of Rollo’s so it’s no surprise that Hellbender is just as impressive. I would return to enjoy all of the dishes I had and there were several we didn’t get to try. The smashed cucumbers, fish tacos and crispy lamb were outstanding. I look forward to retuning and trying the rest of the menu!

author: Jelvis Ferreira
review_text:
Hellbender just served me the best pancakes I’ve had in NYC—hands down. The heirloom masa pancakes here aren’t just good, they’re game-changers: perfect texture, flavors that complement each other beautifully, and nothing overpowering. Every bite felt balanced and memorable, to the point where Clinton St. is officially dethroned as my previous pancake champion. I’m already counting the days until we come back.

We also shared the skirt steak and the coffee tres leches cake—both phenomenal. The steak was cooked perfectly, paired with flavorful potatoes and a rich butter topping, and the tres leches was indulgent without being too sweet. Between the three dishes, my wife and I left full and completely satisfied.

The staff here deserves a special mention. They were knowledgeable, professional, and had excellent communication with the kitchen, even advising on what to avoid for dietary restrictions. That level of attentiveness made the experience even better.

Hellbender delivers on flavor, balance, and hospitality—absolutely worth a spot at the top of your NYC dining list.

author: Kary Sartan
review_text: Oh my God, what can I say about this place??? too many things.. from the Agua Chile to the tacos to the lamb shank to the mole I am speechless. ALSO THOSE DAMN PANCAKES ::: JEEEEEEEEZ. Food heaven! This place has an epic menu with epic flavors. It’s a great space. I love it for our neighborhood.

author: Alison Pouw
review_text: same owners as radio bakery. went for brunch and got the egg tostada. i would love to go back and try the pancake. the egg tostada was good but needed a bit more flavor/salt - a bit oily. it was good but not incredible. the grapefruit juice was incredible if you’re into that. cute decor inside too.

author: Lauren Smith
review_text: Dinner was a lack luster. The best thing to order are the mushroom tacos, the carrots in the tostadas could be softer and use less sauce. Don’t order the chicken Milanese or the steak. Both came out burnT. Brussels sprouts also very burnt. You really shouldn’t be eating burnt food, that causes cancer. bill was close to 200$ which is underwhelming for a sub par experience

author: Thomas Lo
review_text: The gulf prawns were delicious, perfectly cooked and seasoned. A gem of a restaurant in Queens.

author: Dolma Yankey
review_text:
Quick (not rushed) service, delicious food, chill atmosphere!
The fried Oaxaca cheese was scrumptious, the lamb taco was so good (didn’t even realize I was eating lamb- nice and crispy, and not gamey at all), scrambled egg tostada delish-  seemed like Chinese dish inspired due to the chili-oil, and the masa pancakes 😋 - top notch. The pancakes were super moist, hot, with a good amount of butter and maple syrup, just the perfect dish to end our brunch!
The portions are on the smaller side.
But super happy with our first-time experience. Will definitely come back ;)

author: Ryan Wenzel
review_text: Hellbender is a standout spot with fantastic food and a great vibe. We tried the fried cheese, aguachile, mushroom tacos, and pork ribs al pastor—every dish was memorable, and I only wish we had room to explore more of the menu. As someone who loves meat and takes tacos seriously, I was especially blown away by the mushroom tacos—absolutely a must-try. Can’t wait to come back!

author: Sangeeta Joshi
review_text:
Some restaurants leave a lasting impression with their food and service. Hellbender is definitely one for me. Fried oaxacan cheese and crushed cucumbers set the bar high and the dishes that followed got better and even better. Pork carnitas tacos, chilaquiles very satisfying but the highlight of this brunch was soft scrambled egg tostada and heirloom masa pancake.
The tostadas with the chilli oil and sesame had a Chinese dish vibe, so flavourful!
The pancakes with a generous slice of butter…something very special, unique taste for a pancake. First bite tasted almost like gulab jamun, an Indian dessert.
Service was excellent! Hope to visit soon.

author: Марта Пляцок
review_text: at first glance a nice clean new facility. but it was a deep disappointment. the food is not tasty, very salty. the pizza was not pizza but pita bread and cheese and leftover chicken. the chicken was heavily seasoned with vinegar and salt. everything was terrible, except for the cashier who served me. it was my first and last visit. all the food had to be thrown into the trash. the food does not match the photos on the poster. as terrible as possible, and not cheap. the food stinks of fat and vinegar. I spent $56 on it and threw it in the trash. Thank you.

author: Bavdun Umar
review_text: I love this place! That’s so hard to find good Halal food in United States and I am so happy that in 5 min from me I have this beautiful place. The fries are so starry and crispy ! Chicken delicious 🤤 thank you so much for good service and asking How Is my day today! I live Muslim Culture and Ethics that’s how people on Earth should treat each other! Mash Allah Halal Tamaq yehmen dégenler razi bolidu. I made a Combo for $ 13 and get so good substantial food. They work late. Deliver is also available.

author: Tiffany Love
review_text: I ordered food from here via Uber Eats. I got an order of fried Oreos, Small waffle fries and 10piece honey bbq wings (5flats & 5 drum). The fried Oreos 10/10. The fries 10/10, the wings 7.5/10. The drums tasted amazing but the flats tasted a bit old. Their ranch is also 10/10, it tasted like wing stop ranch. I will definitely order again though but maybe earlier in the day. (Forgot to take a pic of the fried Oreos)

author: Madison
review_text: I was super excited to get some good wings. So I ordered a 10 piece, honey barbecue wings, a 5 piece, lemon pepper, and a pineapple mango smoothie. I opened my wings, and they looked delicious.But then I realized a wing was missing in my 10 piece honey barbecue. I was very heartbroken since they were pretty pricey, but they were still delicious. I also had to wait 25 minutes for my order.

author: Yolanda Jones
review_text: I try to like this place because it's halal but WOW oh mighty never again. I tried this place several times & can't recall as it was some time ago but I won't forget my experience this time. Almost everything on the menu is fried, which is no problem as we know it's not healthy but for every bite I take, it literally is going to give me hypernatremia. Not a pinch or a dash of salt but a literal handful. I feel my blood pressure rising. I could not finish after 4 bites of the garlic flatbread.  I shouldn't be dying for water after each bite of food from whatever im eating. What a waste of money as I threw the food out. What's even sadder is that I decided to break my fast by eating from here. Service was good though. I just don't recommend as almost every review is in agreeance that the food is SALTY

author: Sergio Morales
review_text: Chicken sandwiches were really good. Idc about the “quality of service” so it gets a 5/5.

author: Carlos Morales
review_text: so i tried these before and my order was sent via ubereats wrong when they just opened. today i went in person the guy at the register was nice, great service and they got my order right(still wasnt too familar with the menu might i add) but out of all places ive ordered lemon pepper wings this seemed to be the worst. usually in other spots the u can taste the lemon pepper in each bite. it just tasted bland and i threw out half my order. the fries were good tho but for a wing spot i would expect better wings. kinda regret giving this place a second chance. i did however love the drink. tasted different in a good way and not too sugary. but unfortunately im not returning for wings ever again.

author: Stephen Lewis
review_text: Not gonna lie, this is more a 4.1/5 and it’s also weighted for the neighborhood, but this place is a solid go to for me, especially when I’m feeling really lazy.  Low expectations are key here , but I honestly can’t complain much. The one time I ordered celery and carrots they were a bit out of date, but that’s more on me than anything. The 10 boneless wing and French fries combo all day baby

author: Sander Hicks
review_text: Hey, this is a really great place positive place to eat! Wow the $8.99 five boneless wings and waffle fries combo special is a great value. The chicken is solid breast meat, not composite nugget meat. Inside, friendly atmosphere with music videos. Julio always remembers me and remembers I don’t like to use plastic bags. Nice guy, great food!

author: Renee Davis
review_text: okay so this place has really good boneless wings. crispy. but they literally get the order wrong every time. they handed me bone in wing and this is a COMMON occurrence i saw the reviews and they do this so often i thought it was just a fluke but literally happened to me. i would be so annoyed if i got home and didn’t notice. but luckily i did before i left. also they take like 20 mins to cook 5 boneless wings not normal. also they charged me for the boneless wings and it’s basically the same price to add fries as a combo but they won’t tell you that… bc they want you to spend money. kinda shitty would give service one star but it’s not like they cussed me out they were nice just kinda slow at everything

author: Jeremy
review_text: Stop by here from time to time to grab buffalo wings and fries, which taste great. A lot of reviews are bombing the place, but if you get the tossed medium buffalo wings with regular fries, im telling you, you can't go wrong. It's more so up to you whether the price is right. It could go for being a dollar or two less but still would buy as is.

author: Ray Dalto
review_text:
I must say I'm very impressed with this place,
It's very clean , owner is very welcoming, and service is fast , wings were great they have a variety of different flavors, my favorite was the Chile, you guys they even have  rice on the menu.
First time I ever purchased food from here but I must say I'm returning. For my brothers in Blue
Highly recommend.

author: Sophia Rivera
review_text:
I’m horrified with the customer service here.
The French fries for one are plain they don’t even carry salt and pepper which would be nice since Dipping sauce isn’t Free…I’ve never heard of a food business that doesn’t offer at least one or two dipping sauce complimentary.I’m talking 10 DRY LEMON PEPPER WINGS and nothing but ketchup to dip it in…gross.I’ll also add that it costs $1.00 for sauce a size of a dollar coin.ridiculous.Then we have the front desk worker who looks like he rather be laying back chilling at his house than to
Be doing his job.This guy for one BARELY spoke English.For two Got my smoothie Order wrong three times even though we pointed out the image of which drink we Wanted.THREE he was eating a meal like he was on his lunch break when we walked in and FOUR took OVER 30 minutes to make our SMOOTHIE in the first place! This man took his sweet time with EVERYTHING and Had to be reminded that we ordered a drink and never received it.THE GAG Was when he finally did make it after the 30mins went by IT TOOK UNDER 5 minutes to make!!!! So why were we waiting a HALF AN HOUR?THE AMOUNT OF CUSTOMERS IN THE SHOP IS NOT AN EXCUSE BECAUSE THEY DIDNT START COMING IN UNTIL A FEW MINS AFTER WE ORDERED AND THE GUY LITERALLY DIDNT HAVE TO DO ANYTHING BUT TAKE THE ORDERS.Horrible Horrible Horrible! will not be coming back.

author: Linh Nguyen
review_text: I've only ordered for pick-up, and it's been good so far. Their spicy chicken sandos always hit the spot.

author: Dangst 55
review_text: They have a varieties of sauces for the wings, which actually taste pretty great but the fries weren’t good at all they were hard. I recommend strictly for the wings only.

author: SINCLAIR SINCLAIR -
review_text:
They burnt my wings
I tried them before
Too much obay seasoning i had throw some away .
Today my wings are burnt .
Great service
But the food i had i could've went to wendys .
Good day 🥴

author: James Sailor
review_text: Not a bad place. Food is decent wings had a good taste. They followed instructions if im in the area again will deff come again

author: Rafael Rivera
review_text: Stole my money after showing receipt. They sent order to different location. When they said they remake food had me sitting there 30 minutes waiting and did nothing. Never again. Stole my money with no refund direct through website.

author: web master
review_text: The lady behind the counter is very, very rude. After a very long wait time, the food did not make up for the rud3 attitude. Very bad experience and a waste of money. I don't recommend this place.

author: Ramon Alomar
review_text: Food  was  very  good  not Greasy   and  not  salty  they  had  napkins  and  forks  the  service  was good

author: Kevin Ajemian
review_text: The food is absolutely stellar. One of my favorite German restaurants. From the authentic layout to the service. All of it is top notch. I recommend this German restaurant to anyone. One of the last bastions of an old German establishment. My favorite is the pork shank or beef rib with horseradish sauce on the Friday specials. 👏👏

author: Peter Gruber
review_text: Great German food. With an old world atmosphere. The workers are wonderful and explain anything on the menu including what type of beer they serve. The food is excellent. Try the Jaeger schnitzel. And for desert the apple strudel is a good choice.

author: Jonathan O'Buckley
review_text: There are so many different dishes, you gotta come here multiple visits to try it all. Can't go wrong with getting Snitzel and a nice cold beer. Tried Käsespätzle for the first time, and that was a great appetizer. If anything, be ready to take a doggie bag home because of their big portions. Always leaving full and happy.

author: Don Miller
review_text: I haven’t been there in years but stopped in recently for a late lunch to satisfy a craving for a taste of the old country, and a good German beer. Food, service and atmosphere was very good. Das jaegerschnitzle ist  Wunderbar 😋🍺🇩🇪

author: Jonathan Harris
review_text: Solid, although not outstanding German food. Quite busy on a Saturday afternoon. Cozy restaurant with an Oktoberfest feel. The Jägerschnitzel was excellent. I've eaten better Sauerbraten. Kids menu was sufficient. Was nice to have a Hofbrau beer to wash everything down. Good service considering how busy the restaurant was.

author: Mary Naughton
review_text:
I was back in the neighborhood and able to stop into Zum Stammtisch. My father used to take us and other family members here as frequently as we could. We often would see Aurora. Tonight, in memory of Dad, Mom and I came in for dinner. The waitress was lovely. I ordered rieslingschnitzel, which is veal schnitzel in a light riesling and mushroom gravy, I had the creamed spinach with it and the schnitzel was served over deliciously crisp home fries.

Mom got the jägerschnitzel with the traditional darker mushroom gravy and also the creamed spinach. I wanted something a little different for a beverage so I got the coffee that has brandy in it. In the past, I’ve also had their goulash soup, which is a favorite for all and their potato pancakes. I’m so sorry the pork store has closed next door, I enjoyed going there as well. A few helpful hints for those who have yet to try this neighborhood icon, they take cash and card, they’re closed on Mondays, parking is hard to come by so get here earlier and prepare accordingly. Also, they close at 10pm however, their kitchen closes at 9pm, so to get a meal, you’ll need to be in before then.

author: Stephen Hatzis
review_text: This is literally better food than in Germany. 🇩🇪 my go to spot in NYC. Great authentic food and beers. Great atmosphere.

author: Zachary Feigman
review_text: One of the best restaurants I've been to in a long time. It reminds me of my grandmother's and mother's cooking so to me it was very authentic. The staff were excellent. Our waitress was very nice and fun. I think the prices are very reasonable. You have to try the steak tartar and the herring in cream sauce.   For entree, I tried all my friends dishes and everything was excellent, especially the jagarschnitzel. Unfortunately the Pork Knuckle was out, or I would have ordered that.  One of my highest ratings in a long time. Go here immediately.

author: Elisabeth Ivanov
review_text:
Zum Stammtisch is a great spot. The food’s hearty and full of flavor — the schnitzel and sausages were excellent. Big portions and cold beer make it even better.

The place has a warm, old-school vibe and friendly service. Feels like a classic neighborhood spot. I’ll definitely be back.

author: Łukasz Kuźniar
review_text: Good food, atmospheric decor. One star for the totally hopeless service. Ordering dessert while ordering soup is clearly a problem and the service does not understand that someone may want something sweet earlier than two hours later and does not know what they are doing in a restaurant. If someone comes across a mature blonde waitress I recommend changing this lady to someone else. Only if not this problem, dinner with a group of friends could be a pleasant experience and not having to deal with an unpleasant lady when ordering food, blocking the passage and not being interested in customers for at least an hour on every occasion. Maybe next time with different services it will be better.

author: Yiyi Zhang
review_text:
A Glorious Journey to Old-World Germany!!!

Walking into Zum Stammtisch in Brooklyn feels like stepping through a time portal straight into a warm, wood-paneled tavern nestled deep in Bavaria or something. The ambiance is MAGICAL!!! Every detail, from the carved dark wood to the vintage beer steins lining the shelves, feels designed to transport you far from modern-day NYC and into a cozier, more charming world. It’s not themed, it’s immersive and authentic, like a love letter to another place and time.

The wait staff are great: attentive and genuinely friendly.

Foodwise, every dish we tried was satisfying and hearty. The standout was, suprisingly, the potato salad. I never thought I’d write the words “life-changing potato salad,” and yet here we are. It was tangy, creamy, perfectly textured...I'm still thinking about it days later.

It also feels old world in pricing! Definitely a great deal for all the food, and ambiance.

It’s the kind of place you tell your friends about and bring out-of-towners to to flex on them a little bit. Can’t wait to go back!

author: Austen Groff
review_text: Visited New York City for a graduation, and we decided on Zum Stammtisch for one of our meals. Arriving there we found street parking near the restaurant, and we entered a cool wooden open German looking building. The light was low (maybe a little too low,) the tables well spaced, and the decor was very intriguing (like a hunting lodge.) Our server was quick to arrive and she was friendly and informative. We were well attended to the entire meal. For an appetizer we started with käsespätzle which is one of my favorite dishes. It came with carmelized onions and it was tasty, but not the best I've had. It was a bit too oily, and it was shaped in a way I hadn't seen before (longer strands instead of smaller oblong pieces,) but I did love the amount of cheese (which may have contributed to the oil) and the carmelized onions were perfect.  I saved some for the meal and it was a nice pair to my dinner. For which I ordered the Schweinshaxe mit Semmelknödel which is a pork shank special with bread dumplings which I remember I used to have when I lived in Germany as a teenager. This was enormous! I'll include a picture. I ended up eating it for 3 or 4 more meals, it was a formidable meal. I will say the outer layer was quite fatty, though you don't have to eat it, there's no way you would be hungry if you are the type of person that can finish this. I thought it added a nice flavor as German food is not known for its seasoning. The Semmelknödel gave a nice break from the  pork shank and the sauerkraut that came with it contrasted the dish with taste and texture. Overall I really enjoyed it but I think I would only order it again if I was feeling gluttonous. The my girlfriend and her sister shared the chicken schnitzel with the Riesling and mushroom sauce. The schnitzel was good, though not the best we've had before, the crust could be a bit more buttery in flavor maybe by using a different breading, but the mushrooms in the Riesling sauce were delicious. The dish came with potatoes which does not really brighten up the plate, but it was a welcome addition. The meal ended with dessert where we all shared linzer torte and vanilla ice cream and a NY cheesecake. This was the star of the meal. I have never had linzer torte (a raspberry torte) and it was amazing the crust was perfectly soft and the tartness of the raspberry against the creaminess of the ice cream was such a perfect balance my mouth waters just thinking of it, and the New York cheesecake was also very soft in texture and the cake was creamy and the base was crumbly and not too dry. Such a nice ending to quite the feast. The price was very fair, around 100 dollars and I would say if you're in the area it's worth checking out but where it shines is in the value and the service.

author: Brian Dinan
review_text:
Glendale is a pretty barren area when it comes to good eats, but Zum Stammtisch is definitely a diamond in the rough.

A neighborhood staple for over 50 years; I have been here over 20 times in my 15 years of living in Glendale and never had a bad meal or bad service.

Known for their traditional German fare, I opted for the prime rib - which at $52, seemed a bit heavy handed, but was worth every penny. I got a very generous portion of meat that was cooked to perfection, with two sides.

The waitresses are always very pleasant and the service is top notch all around.

author: Denise A.
review_text:
Another fabulous meal and wonderful dining experience at Zum Stamtisch!
We arrived on a Saturday afternoon and the place was filled, but within a half hour we were seated.
Cold Hofbrau beers to start, followed by my 2 favorites, the Deutscher Salat and the kaiserspatzle. You can not go wrong with either.
The special on this day was bone in goose with homemade stuffing and we had to try it! Amazing!! As this was our first time having goose, we do did not know what to expect. It tasted similar to turkey but not exactly. We did not find it gamey at all, it was moist and flavorful. The stuffing was the perfect pairing and it tasted phenomenal. The red cabbage was sooo darned good.
Apple strudel for dessert.
Service was quick, friendly and on point. Really such a lovely place to gather, relax and enjoy some German cuisine.
Very clean restrooms downstairs.
On street parking.

author: Edyta Drozdzal
review_text: Zum Stammtisch is a true gem that has earned its place as our top choice for family dinner. Every other week, we eagerly return to savor their delectable and fresh cuisine, soak up the warm atmosphere, and enjoy their impressive selection of beers. The kids menu is a thoughtful touch, offering a range of wholesome options reminiscent of European traditions. With its seamless service, this restaurant consistently exceeds our expectations, leaving us feeling inspired and already looking forward to our next visit.

author: Marco Marcheggiani
review_text: Wow a real German restaurant in Brooklyn. Their food looks amazing and delectable! Beer, beer, beer…so gut!

author: Sun Lee
review_text: This place I got recommended by my co-worker and my friend celebrate with me for my birthday. Good atmosphere as soon as I walked in. Surprisingly during the lunch there are two other tables having a birthday lunch too. The food are so comforting and the waitress are so nice, we’re having difficulty ordering and she’s nice enough to let us have the sampling the sauce so we know what to get. They got a good selection of beers. There’s a shop next to them and sell sausage, beer, snacks. Will come back another day

author: Nancy Ta
review_text: My go-to spot when I'm in the mood for a good burger or steak. Wonderful atmosphere and service.

author: Geoffrey Holtsclaw
review_text: You know it's legit when it smells like my grandma's basement (in a good way)! Though it's a little out of the way (it took 2 trains and 2 buses to get here from Manhattan), it's well worth the trek. You're far enough away from the city that the prices aren't egregious and the portions are healthy. Just walking in, you're surrounded by authentic German decor and it feels as if you've been transported directly to a restaurant in Germany. In 1880. The staff is so genial and happy to help with menu questions. We were pleased with all the German options, though my date had to order a collection of sides because that was nearly the only vegetarian choice. But the waitress was very willing to let us make the necessary substitutions and alterations to the menu to make it work, which was very sweet. I got the chicken schnitzel a la Holstein (fried egg on top) and got a little anchovy on top of the egg as a happy surprise! Everything came out and we immediately realized our eyes were larger than our stomachs because the portions are huge! I stuffed myself silly because everything was so tasty, but alas I couldn't finish it. And that's high praise. Sadly, we were so full that we couldn't order dessert, but the options looked great! We'll for sure try to make the pilgrimage back if we have a free evening in the future. And you should too! Guten Appetit!

author: BusyB
review_text: Blast from the passed!  Last time I was here was when I lived in the neighborhood…30 years ago! I was looking forward to a fantastic meal. It was ok, but not as good as I remember it. The prices were very high. Our service was great and the ambiance was exactly how I remembered it. My favorite part was the store full of German treats.

author: Sledge Williams
review_text:
I've always been curious about trying out Chili's but never had an opportunity or much interest to head to one until I've seen a commercial for their 3 for me special and that was enough motivation for me to go out of my way to head to the spot.

Outside the area may look small because it's part of a mini mall but it is vast inside, even with a couple of people in there, the area still looks spacious. It didn't take long for one of the waiters (Freddie) to sense my presence and take my order. Props to Fred, he was very attentive and on point so no issues with service whatsoever. Back to the review, I ordered the 3 for me which was the Quarter Pounder Cheeseburger w/ Fries as the entree, chips and salsa as the appetizer and Coke Zero as my beverage.

As my starter arrived I was overwhelmed by the size of it. It was damn near as big as the entree, I didn't wanna fill up on the chips and salsa, no matter how good they were and focused my attention on my burger and fries after taking in half of the appetizer. That commercial wasn't lying when it threw shade at McD's quarter pounder because what I got from Chili's, THAT WAS A QUARTER POUNDER! Not that half-baked garbage that McD's doles out as an excuse of a premium burger. Fries were precise in texture and good in taste. I would say that I could got more in Fries but I've really no need for it since the larger than usual starter definitely made up for it.

All that for $11.97 plus a well deserved tip bringing it close to $15, it was absolutely solid. I enjoyed that trip here.

author: shannon
review_text: I came on a Saturday around 4pm. It was a lot busier than I expected but luckily we got seats pretty quickly. The food was really good! I understand they were probably short staffed but we were there close to 2 hours when we didn’t want to stay that long. We had to ask for multiple items more than once. It got to a point where other customers came up to us asking if we were almost done and I was like yeah but we’re waiting for our food lol.

author: Orchid S.
review_text: Had an amazing time with friends and family here. Our server India was so kind and sweet the whole time and checked in on us often. She was busy but did not hesitate to get us everything we needed! India deserves everything and more. The food was also really great!

author: saif khan
review_text: Average food at average price. There are items on the menu that priced on the lower end. But also some that's not. Like $13 plus tax and tip of course for a chocolate dessert isnt worth it. But there 3 for me for $11-$13 is.

author: Isamari Burgos
review_text: I love Chilis and I always go to them but this one is always pretty packed & loud. The service was good, server took our orders quick & got everything out in a timely fashion. The only thing is they sat us in a really noisy area with kids and it was really loud. Though in this chilis it’s to be expected since it’s the only one in the “city”. That being said I’ve gone here a few times before because I love chilis and it’s the closest to me.

author: Michele Hallahan
review_text: The place is very spacious, so the wait is never too long. If at all. The food is always good. I've never been dissatisfied with anything. And they are very accommodating if you want to change something. Our server was extremely nice and efficient. Quick, friendly service done right. I hate that I forgot her name, but she was great.

author: Jeffrey Gomez
review_text:
I thought New York didn’t have a chilis for a long time. We definitely need more. I came
here to celebrate Mothers Day with my family and this was the perfect spot. Our server was the best. I think his name was Ben. He showed us hospitality and even though he was juggling with multiple tables he still made sure our table was taken care of. Service was good. Food came out pretty fast. I love how the tortilla chips for the chips and salsa came out warm. I had to try the viral fried mozzarella and it was really good. I also had the triple dipper. It’s a great deal. The restaurant was spacious and perfect for families and smaller groups.

author: José Guevara
review_text: I’ve been here a couple times in the bar area because the 2 times that I went you have to wait for a table, otherwise the service is great, I always like came to chilis very good food, excellent margaritas and compare to other restaurants is relatively cheap for that you can get. The 3 for me is one of the best deals, appetizer, main dish, drink for up to $18.

author: Aye Tine
review_text: The Mozzarella Stick & The Mini Burgers Were They Best. I Wasn’t Feeling The Steak & Shrimp Fajita.

author: Mah R
review_text: I had the shrimp pasta and a strawberry lemonade. When I tell you that it was $36 well spent. It sure was and the wait time was 0mins. As soon as I entered I was seated and given a menu. 2 mins later chips and dip with water. I love it there.

author: Huntyr Escobar
review_text: Janae was the dopest server ever. Food came out hot, fresh and delicious. She refilled drinks without even having to ask her and she checked on us several times throughout the meal. Great service awesome food. We will be back.

author: Zoey Gocking
review_text: Chili’s on Cooper Ave is always a great experience! The food is consistently fresh, hot, and full of flavor — especially the fajitas and burgers. The staff is friendly, attentive, and makes you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. Service is quick without feeling rushed, and the restaurant is always clean and comfortable. Whether you’re stopping by for lunch, dinner, or just drinks, this location never disappoints. Definitely one of the best Chili’s spots around!

author: ESTELLE MERISIER
review_text: Went today and got served by Freddy and all i can say is there was AMAZING service. On time for everything and was very attentive to our needs. Next time you go to Chili’s, ask for Freddy!

author: Stephanie Soto
review_text: Packed on a Saturday evening. Party of 4 , wait time was 45min-1hr but felt like we got called for our table in 25 mins. Was super surprised… took a few moments for the waiter to arrive since it was so busy but he was great. Ribeye could’ve used more salt

author: Melissa Santos
review_text: Shout out to Ben! He was our server & we absolutely loved him! He was so sweet. Took our order fast & kept making sure we were good.

author: Michelle Quichimbo
review_text:
STILL THINKING ABOUT THIS FOOD SPREAD
me and my husband went to 🌶️ s to eat some FLAVORFULL and DELICIOUS food, so much so that just by looking at these pictures, the 3 for me deal is so GOATED and u get so much food for less than 20 bucks, it was DEFINITELY an experience for me and my love and we SHALL be coming back 😋

author: Melany Bernard
review_text: Loved the service here , I came with my friends after work, we also had a few drinks , and ofc the triple dipper !

author: marina dee
review_text: I'm one that normally goes to chain restaurants but it's an easy go to when at Atlas Park with the kiddos. I was expecting to hate it but actually really enjoyed it. The kids ate no problem and I ended up lovingggg the Nashville Hot mozz sticks. The service was excellent. Would definitely go back.

author: Kayla Ward
review_text: Service is very slow here! It is a very popular place so it is understandable. Food is great as well.

author: Alex Canizare
review_text: It was my first time at this restaurant.   When we went there it was full.  We have to wait for 30 minutes.  Once seated, our waiter was good, I think his name was Bubba.  He was very helpful and professional.   The food was great.  Loved the Fajita Trio.  Highly recommended.

author: Jaime
review_text:
I liked the atmosphere at this restaurant. It is a little upscale but yet you can dress casually with no problem.
I ordered the pizza and thought it was good. I didn't have a hard time finding parking.
The waiters were friendly and attentive.

author: Arlene Patel
review_text: This is a Queens, New York hidden gem! Literally hidden in a shopping plaza is this oasis of Italian food. I could have eaten 3 to 4 plates of the baked clams. Don't let them take the plate! Dip your fresh crusty table bread in it, you can thank me later. From the fried calamari to shrimp Rockefeller you will not be disappointed. Service was impeccable. The staff was friendly. The restaurant has a beautiful outdoor area.

author: Sapna Rajpoot
review_text: Fresh, flavorful, and perfectly baked! The crispy crust, juicy toppings, and bright tomato bites made this pizza an instant favorite. 🍕✨ Paired it with a refreshing sangria — perfection! 🍷👌

author: Tony Russo
review_text: Good food cant go wrong with anything on the menu. I had the pizza, skirt steak platter & a cold peroni. Amazing food and good service. Always a hit!! Boss man was cool behind the counter.

author: K VC
review_text:
Returned for a large group gathering again (our 3rd here so far). This time we were seated indoors.
Complimentary bread and butter to start. Calamari was good. Stuffed mushrooms were on the salty side.
Had the Pasta Pescatore - seafood in a spicy marinara sauce. Liked the seafood but the linguini was not al dente anymore. I much preferred the side of capellini with strong garlicky-flavored oil, which went well with the Chicken Sorrentino (with eggplant, prosciutto and brown sauce). Delicious. We no longer saw the sandwich options on the menu.
Service was great. Restrooms available. Wheelchair accessible. Lots of parking.

author: Sharon Meade
review_text: I almost passed this place. Not their fault that there is construction all around the area. Hard to find parking, even though there’s a lot. The restaurant is in a strip plaza. The burger was cooked to my specifications. The cannolo was filled with fresh ricotta and my party enjoyed their cappuccinos. Our waitstaff was attentive and on point. Before revisiting I will check to see if construction is complete.

author: Jamilah Ringo
review_text:
Pizza Classica missed its mark competely ! | went here for a take out order and the young lady behind the counter seemed completely uninterested. I ordered a carbonara pasta, pasta with salmon, a side of meatballs and an order of fried calamari.
The total of the order was roughly 75 dollars and for that amount I could've went to an actual authentic Italian restaurant and had way better food.
Since when does carbonara have peas, onions, UNDERCOOKED bacon and cream sauce ? The pasta was swimming in oil and again pork bacon pieces were undercooked. That was money down the drain because I refused to risk getting food poisoning. The meatballs were edible and so was the calamari but everything else was subpar at best. That was my first and last time visiting that establishment.

author: Mr Vee
review_text:
Excellent family style restaurant, generous appetizer and pasta portions. Plenty to share so bring your appetite!

Our hostess seated us promptly, Christian and Marco are both awesome and attentive despite the busy hour. They deserve the kudos.

We love the calamari and seafood pasta dishes. Freshly prepared and perfect with a dash of parmesan and fresh ground pepper.

Highly recommended!

author: Mark LoGiurato
review_text: Large Italian restaurant with very good service.  However when you have pizza in your name, you should make great pizza.  This is not the place to go for pizza.  Toppings were good but the actual dough was not very good.  Just flat and in need of olive oil and salt.  The cannolis were prefilled, but tasted ok.  I did not have any entrees so my review is based on the pizza only.

author: Armand Urb
review_text: I read reviews from Italian restaurants in the Forest Hill area and found the most consistent positive here. I showed up asked Manuel my server his favorites and I must say I agree with the taste from each one of these dishes. Step out your comfort zone and trust works at these restaurants, I will be back for more dishes another day

author: Gene Soares
review_text: The atmosphere is very nice, super friendly staff and very nice. I felt bad for the waiter as it seem he was the only one working but he nice . Now the food smh … I had the lobster ravioli with grilled shrimp now the ravioli was flavorless and I don’t know what type of lobster that filling was but yeah no it was nasty , the shrimp was over cooked and no seasoning. The wing let’s talk about frozen wings that you can buy from the store to much breading just yuck. My sister got crab cakes and said they were obviously frozen crab cakes and nasty. The calamari was decent could have been seasoned some more. My son enjoyed his chicken bacon ranch pizza and my brother in law liked his chicken parm. Oh my sister didn’t like her minestrone soup . But like I said the staff was nice.

author: Jasmine Nguyen
review_text: This place is my go to for mozzarella sticks!! Most of the time, if u order the mozzarella sticks, they are crispy to perfection alongside of a perfect opportunity for a long cheese pull!! I love their mozzarella sticks that it’s become an addition to just order takeout for 6 pieces of them . Birthdays are welcome!! The waiter will sing you happy birthday and the overall experience is chill . Once you sit down , you get bread, and if you’re lucky enough ,they will give u very delicious garlic bread!! (I even asked if they could give me some more to take home one time cus I loved it so much😅😅)  The calamari comes with a very crispy crust also, it comes with marinara sauce if I recall, but it’s not that very flavorful, the crunch is all (no shade) . I suppose they don’t have their own pink lemonade, I asked, and they gave me a bottle of Snapple pink lemonade (and a cup w/ice to pour in) which is fine because it still tasted like pink lemonade!! I ordered many since I arrived in a big party, we ordered pizza and it came it a large portion! Eat it fast because it taste very good when the pizza is hot . I personally love the mozzarella sticks but everything else is great, the service is average and not too bad, I haven’t had any issues.

author: Pink Montana
review_text: I love eating here. My favorite is their balsamic chicken! It is so flavorful. I’ve never had chicken from anywhere else with that taste. They also have great pasta dishes.

author: Susan Poon Chung
review_text:
We were a party of 14, and they did not rush us to make our order or to leave. Recommend making a reservation as it can get packed. Delicious good and generous portions!

Went again, same group. Same deliciousness and generous portions. The service was superb. Very attentive to everything we need. Excellent wait staff!
The bathrooms were also very nice and clean.

author: Jordan Cooper
review_text: I love Pizza Classica, but the dish I’ve been having there for like two decades was baked ziti, and it’s suddenly been taken off the menu. They have ziti, they have sauce and cheese, why is this off the menu? It’s an Italian restaurant staple. I’m just confused and disappointed. It was my favorite baked ziti in the area.

author: Patricia Owen
review_text: My parents frequent here often and they love it, all the dishes they have had they rave about. I've been here a few times with them and have enjoyed as well.  Very nice staff and service and nice environment. I personally dont like the parking lot but we've always found a spot.

author: Kitty Kat
review_text: My Googlers, when I say this is the best CHICKEN CAESAR PIZZA I ever had In NYC. Forget about Gabby's Pizza in Queen's. If you don't mind the drive then come here. I mean now. You won't regret it. You're my Favorite Pizza Place So Far. So to give an update, I stopped going here. Which I'm very sad about because I loved that Chicken Caesar Pizza, but you know I'm big on customer service. So they don't get my business anymore. Every time I ordered a pie, I would open it and the pizza would never be cut. This happened 3 times and every time I said something about it I would get a major attitude. Especially from the cashier girl. I asked for an additional sauce, which they put on this type of pizza, it's like a sweet sauce. She threw it in the bag. When I got home it was a tomato sauce. This Chicken Caesar Pizza doesn't have tomato sauce on it at all. That was my last and final experience with this place. Just because your Pizza is good doesn't give you the right to give a side of attitude. Treat your customers the way you want to be treated.

author: Foodtastic Critic
review_text: Went around 7pm with friends for a bite to eat. Our waiter was funny and on point. Appetizers came out, and the portion of the salads was huge and beautiful with fresh lettuce. Entrées came out right after the skirt steak was mouth-watering as it cut like butter. Chicken parm had way ti much sauce n cheese as you couldn't find the cutlet under all that cheese as for the baked ziti was dry not enough sauce or meat way to much cheese that overwhelmed the sauce to a lite pale orange sauce which was not appealing n very lil mozzarella cheese on top. I would not order the baked ziti again. Bathrooms were cleaned n plenty of free parking

author: Alvin Shin (CYCLOP852)
review_text: A very tasty American Italian restaurant in a casual setting. It was great as I visited on the night when it was stormy and cold and the food was piping hot and hit the spot. Parking is always free and indoors!

author: Allieaya
review_text: Very disappointed with an experience with a waiter. Upon reaching the restaurant to voice my concerns, I wasn’t upset that the waiter wasn’t attentive, however, I was perturbed the waiter stated I lied about ordering the soda. This I found bothersome. Apparently, manager Edward had no problem cutting me off and brushing my concerns off. Good customer service begins with accountability.! After 15!years of frequenting I am saddened to say I will never go back.

author: Richard Ondreicka
review_text:
My wife Shirley and I have come to Il Poeta for years, before heading into the city to go to theatre. It's a romantic, intimate place to eat where the food is always made to the highest Northern Italian standards with homemade pasta and gnocchi. Chef Mario hails from both Cipriani Restaurant in Venice Italy as well as NYC where he worked alongside his Papa Luigi who taught him everything. We've had their calamari, mussels and clams, Caprese, croquette di eggplant, and Linguini with clam sauce with zucchini. Chicken breast parmesan crust white wine and lemon sauce, veal scallopine with mushroom and bacon (to die for) and Salmon in a mustard pistachio crust and spinach. I do want to try the pork tenderloins with wild mushrooms next.
Put it this way, after reviewing and eating at multiple restaurants up and down Metropolitan ave we chose to celebrate our 17th wedding anniversary here with a party of 25 people. Everybody loved the food, and the service was excellent. Mario provided me a choice party menu at a price we were happy with. I wouldn't change  a thing. The family raved about the menu and we all plan to come back again. Thanks Il Poeta

author: PhilYouIn
review_text:
Small restaurant with nice decor, seating inside and on the sidewalk. Service is professional but not particularly friendly. Prices are steep, and the food is good, but you do not get what you pay for. Zucchini flower is served in a drab plate, all alone. We had to ask for a side of marinara sauce. And although my chicken and mashed potatoes were also delicious, would it have really hurt their bottom line to throw in a vegetable? One broccoli floret? A single asparagus stalk, perhaps? (Check out my photos)
What really irked me was the cocktails. If you’re gonna charge $17 for a drink, you had better make it right. Taste and presentation. They failed horribly. Moscow Mule did not taste like a Mule, and was served in a gin & tonic glass. Old Fashioned was served with half a dozen ice cubes and the incorrect garnish.
One visit was enough.

author: Shirley Goicochea
review_text:
From the moment you step into Il Poeta, you’re transported to a world where Italian hospitality and culinary artistry reign supreme. The ambiance is warm and intimate, perfect for a romantic evening or a soulful family gathering. Chef Mario Di Chiara’s creations are nothing short of poetic — each dish is a masterpiece, blending tradition with innovation.
We started with the eggplant croquettes and grilled vegetables drizzled with truffle oil — divine. The gnocchi melted in our mouths, and the seafood specials were fresh, flavorful, and beautifully plated. The wine list was thoughtfully curated, and the staff made excellent pairing suggestions.
Service was impeccable: attentive, gracious, and genuinely welcoming. You can feel the love and pride in every detail, from the decor to the dessert. Il Poeta isn’t just a restaurant — it’s an experience that nourishes both body and spirit.
Highly recommend for anyone seeking authentic Northern Italian cuisine with heart. Forest Hills is lucky to have this treasure!

author: Kristen Stewart
review_text: I love this restaurant so much, the food is always phenomenal but the service today was so bad I don’t ever want to come back. When I asked for more bread and lentils my waiter told me flat out “NO”. When I asked why he said “because it’s an extra charge (as if we didn’t already know that). Then when we asked for our food to be packed to go, instead of taking the plate to the back and properly packing it… he brings an aluminum pan to the table for me to pack it myself as if this were Applebee’s. I’ve been here maybe 10-15 times and never spend less than roughly $80 so to treat a good customer like that was so disappointing😕 Great food, great atmosphere, waiters attitude sucks.

author: Laura Demarco (Laura & Irene)
review_text:
Dining at Il Poeta is never just about the food — it’s an experience that feels like coming home.

As a family with deep Venetian roots, we feel incredibly lucky to have this gem right here in Forest Hills. From the moment you step in, you’re welcomed not just with warmth, but with the familiar sounds of the Venetian dialect from Chef Mario and the unmistakable aroma of true Italian cooking.

It’s the only restaurant that brings my husband & me right back to our parents’ and grandparents’ kitchens — where meals were made from scratch, with love, and always shared.

Chef Mario, a friend and true Venetian, has created something really special. Every dish is rooted in tradition and executed with care.

Our daughter Irene loves the baccalà mantecato and the fegato alla veneziana, something she wouldn’t be able to experience elsewhere. The entire menu celebrates the lesser-known treasures of Italian cuisine, always healthy, authentic, and handmade.

The ingredients are fresh, the flavors are authentic, and there’s never any rush — just like if you were at home for Sunday dinner.

Our Golden Retriever Red loves coming here for alfresco dining and to try some of Chef Mario’s specialties.

We come back again and again, and every time it feels like a reunion — with the food, with the culture, and with great friends.

If you're looking for real Italian food, Il Poeta is the place.

author: Phan Alvarado
review_text:
Terrible service. Never fails. We have been to this restaurant numerous times in the last 9 years since we moved to the area.

Food is not bad. Drinks are not bad. But the service is slow as molasses. And if you are not a regular don't expect a warm welcome.

My husband, two sons and I have been going for NYE dinner here for the last 4 years. We made a reservation for this year 4 days in advance, and it was later than we wanted, but we made it anyway. I was then called and told to come in even later because someone else changed the number in their party. I said that was too late and they basically told me "oh well then cancel". Thanks. Two days before NYE.

We have brought friends from out of town and always recommend this place despite the terrible service because it's a cute neighborhood Italian restaurant. The wait staff needs training ASAP, including whoever takes reservations.

WILL NEVER BE BACK !

author: rochelle Berliner
review_text: My new favorite restaurant in Forest Hills. The new decor is cozy and warm, the food is amazing, the service is top notch, and the chef/owner is friendly and grateful. I always get the Tagliatelle Bolognese which is lick-ypur-plate delicious. And you must try the strawberry napoleon for dessert.  It's divine.

author: Chris Benvegna
review_text: NOT THE SAME!  My wife and I have been coming here for her birthday for the last 3 years and we loved it.  Not any more!   They renovated the place this past year and it ruined the experience.  The ONLY good thing about the place is the food (my wife's fish, however, was lukewarm).  The servers are incredibly rude and rush you to order.  They won't let you put in an appetizer order unless you order everything at once, again, feeling rushed.  We were 1 of only 2 tables in the place but I was told the chef is too busy to make any kind of change to my order.  The music was terrible, sounded like club music, and the entire atmosphere feels like you are eating at a restaurant in Las Vegas, it's extremely bright and sterile.  The tables are crowded together on one side with couch seating!  You used to get such a warm vibe from this place but all that is gone.    Sadly, we will not be celebrating her birthday here any longer.

author: Dumitrita Paladi Contes
review_text: We stopped by for lunch on Easter Day and the atmosphere was perfect for the occasion, as well as the food we shared. The staff was very friendly and accommodating even though we didn't have a reservation.

author: Logan Pagan
review_text: So me and my family which were a party of 10 went to this restaurant for my grandma 91 year birthday. We weren't welcomed, the waiter rush us to order EVERYTHING AT ONCE because they had so many parties that were coming. The food was HORRIBLE! The grilled rib eye steak which was 43 dollars came to the table not the way I asked them to make it. It still looked frozen in the inside while the outside was cooked crispy. Service overall sucked and was very disappointed at this place. But, the atmosphere was tradition and old style which I liked at least. If the food is going to be pricy, it should be cooked and served better! On another note, this place charged me a 20 percent gratuity that the waiter did not deserved. I would of tipped more of the service was better. The portion of the food was very small for the price and everyone left out of this place hungry.

author: Doany Will
review_text:
Il Poeta hits a sweet spot of offering elevated Italian fare in a neighborhood setting — perfect for a date night, a dinner with friends when you want something better than casual chain fare, or for celebrating something special without going ultra‐formal. The dishes, service, and ambiance all lean toward the positive. Just be aware that if you’re after a super quiet, spacious setting, this might feel more intimate than you expect.

If I were rating it, I’d give it something like 4.5 out of 5 — strong recommendation, with small caveats around space and noise.

author: José Torres
review_text: Il Poeta is a lovely establishment serving tastebud tantalizing northern Italian cuisine. The food is delicious and the ambience is perfect. Add to that excellent service and you have a recipe for an outstanding dining experience. 💯 recommend!

author: Bob G
review_text:
Sadly, no longer a place that I would go out of my for.

DECOR:  Once upon a time, Il Poeta had unique decor... Santa Fe meets New Orleans is the way I would describe it. The walls were Southwest in Color and decorated with unique artifacts. It was very "artsy" and very Forest Hills. Now, with a recent re-do of the decor, I can best describe it as "Generic Long Island Restaurant".  Gone is the uniqueness and in its place are generic white tablecloths and a conservative color scheme.

SERVICE;  i recognize that finding servers is difficult these days, but the service here didn't even reach diner standards. First, the wrong mixed drink was brought to the table. Then, the mixed drink that was brought as a replacement, which at least looked correct, didn't taste correct. Other reviewers have noted this issue as well, and for $17.00 it should have been exemplary!  The server seemed to be limited to a dialogue of "cheese or pepper?".

DISHES:  We had the tuna tartar and Tagliatelli specials as well as the Apple Salad and the Penne with Asparagus "a la vodka".  The tuna tartar had an "off taste". The Tagliatelli was OK. The two pasta dishes were served in round plates that looked unique but weren't appropriate for the pasta. The Apple Salad was way overly dressed and the dressing overpowered any flavor that the ingredients may have had. There were very few Apple Slices as well. Dessert was the Cream Brulee which was OK but, again served in a plate that was more appropriate for  Flan.

Overall, Il Poeta is worth visiting if you plan to be in area but I would no longer go out of my way to dine there.

author: JUAN BONILLA
review_text:
**Il Poeta: A Masterpiece of Italian Culinary Art**

Il Poeta is a hidden gem that transports you straight to Italy with its authentic flavors and welcoming atmosphere. The moment you step in, you're greeted by the warm, attentive service that makes you feel like family. The star of the kitchen, Chef Mario di Chiara, is a true artist, crafting dishes that are as visually stunning as they are delicious. Every bite reflects his passion and mastery of Italian cuisine.

From homemade pasta to perfectly cooked seafood, each dish is a testament to his skill and creativity. Whether you're indulging in a classic carbonara or savoring a more contemporary creation, the flavors are nothing short of extraordinary.

The experience doesn’t stop at the food. Julio, the restaurant’s talented bartender, elevates the meal with his exceptional drink pairings. His extensive knowledge and passion for mixology are evident in every cocktail he crafts, adding the perfect touch to an unforgettable dining experience.

For anyone seeking an authentic Italian meal coupled with outstanding service, Il Poeta is 100 percent recommended. It’s more than just a meal—it’s an experience that delights all the senses.

author: Teresa M
review_text: Il Poeta is an extraordinary dining experience. Superior Italian cuisine and a newly redecorated, romantic dining room make Il Poeta extra special.

author: Brandon Will
review_text: Came here to celebrate getting engaged to my fiance with my family. Great drinks (especially the margaritas), the grilled octopus was delicious, and they had very pleasant service. I would recommend this place

author: Rose Wolner
review_text:
Celebrated my birthday tonight at IL Poeta. I don't order calves liver often, but tonight's dish was cooked to my liking...tender and moist. Service and ambiance was terrific!
Bravo Mario for making my birthday a memorable one!

author: Diana L.
review_text: What a gem! Can't believe I live here all the years and just visited them. It was a beautiful breeze night and we definitely enjoyed seating outside. Order Octopus capacio, house salad, papadelle with lamb meatballs, tagliatelle. All pretty good. Good service too. They are super busy on a Thursday evening. I can see why.

author: Leilla I.
review_text:
Food was great, service was excellent.
Place is small but cozy and very family oriented. Had a great time w my friend

author: MEWilke MEWilke
review_text: This place is tightly packed with tables and quite popular even during weeknights, so we wish we had a reservation for our group of 5. They have a kids menu, which is rare in NYC, and the portions were substantial for both kid and adult plates. I thought the two fish dishes we got (salmon encrusted with mustard and pistachios and a whole halibut) were both prepared excellently though the sides of broccoli and spinach were overcooked and not flavorful. My favorite part of the meal was their outstanding, homemade Napoleon. Service was great.  Definitely will return!

author: Maggie Li
review_text: Delicious food, good service, comfortable, and modern atmosphere with seating spaced out and high ceiling.  Fresh salad. Music a bit too loud. The combo special deal during the weekday is a great value. And they are accommodating, switching our fries to yuca fries for our stir fry filet mignon dish.

author: Melissa
review_text: Terrific terrific Chicken. I love a good rotisserie chicken and PioPio does not disappoint! And the green hot sauce is outstanding. The restaurant was clean with a lively atmosphere. All the staff was friendly and kind.

author: Michael Tarachand
review_text:
I rarely feel the need to leave a negative review, but the service here was genuinely offensive. To be clear: I wasn't upset that the food was late. Delays happen. What was unacceptable was how the hostess handled it.
I arrived at 5:00 PM for a 4:30 PM pickup. When I checked in, the hostess was completely unapproachable and inconsiderate. She made no effort to check on the order or offer a timeline. When I asked for a simple estimate (5 minutes vs. 30 minutes) so I could manage my restless young children, she snapped at me with a terrible attitude.
Being treated like an inconvenience for asking a basic question is where I draw the line. It’s a shame because the food is usually good, but the blatant lack of customer service and the rude energy from the front desk makes it not worth the visit.

author: Pat P
review_text:
We came to this new location for a late Monday lunch. Inside was very spacious and new looking, with nice heavy marble looking tables. This location has a great weekday all day special that was a better deal compared to our usual Matador order (which has gotten exponentially pricier over the years). Chicken was flavorful, and the accompanied sides were well made. Added avocado to our salads for an extra $1 which wasn’t really worth it for the small slices we got.

Music at this location was better than the Jackson Heights location - more pop music and at a lower volume that still let you hear the conversations at the table. This is a great addition to the Pio Pio chain.

author: Jessica M
review_text: I love Pio Pio and have eaten at several of their locations — Long Island, Manhattan, and Jackson Heights. The food was delicious, the chicken super fresh, and that green hot sauce 👌🏽. My only complaint is about the host or manager (not sure of his exact position) — he was extremely rude. The restaurant was mostly empty when we arrived around 8:30 p.m., maybe 10% full, yet he made us wait because he didn’t want to combine a few tables. Thankfully, the waiters were amazing — very attentive and super nice, which made up for the bad first impression.

author: Alex Fuentes
review_text: I had to wait an hour to just get water... but the food was great. They let me bring my personal cake for my bday. The staff was left with most of it. Not a crumb left!

author: Eli Briggs
review_text:
Food was good, prices relatively high but you get a lot.
Most of our party had the chicken and sides and enjoyed it. Limited options if you don't want chicken. The seafood pasta was good.
It is one of the loudest restaurants I've been in. Had to yell to converse with my 80 year old mother in law.

author: Don Sien
review_text:
New place in neighborhood so we finally decided to try it. Ordered takeout...arrived early so needed to wait about 6mins. At 5pm, place was not full but, as others mentioned, quite noisy!
Ordered their whole chicken & signature fried rice. Chicken well seasoned & tasty but breast meat very dry! Fried rice was good but had these "fried" pieces of chicken(?) on top which were hard & dried.

author: Luis “Louie” Montalvo
review_text: Had the lunch special, quarter chicken and fried yucca and a salad. It was delicious. The fried yucca comes with a garlic dipping sauce. The chicken was cooked just right   I'll definitely be back again.

author: Sayra Palacios
review_text: We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! Even though our server was busy, the hostess Fabiola stepped right in to take care of us, and she was beyond attentive and genuinely grateful. The drinks were spot on, the food was absolutely delicious, and the service overall made the night feel special. Everything from start to finish was amazing—I’ll definitely be coming back!

author: T F
review_text: I ordered an overpriced whole chicken for 27 dollars plus tax around 30 dollars for take out . This place is mad expensive.

author: JP O
review_text: some of the best rotisserie chicken you’ll ever have. everything on the menu is great however. Fresh Salads. Amazing Sangria.

author: Mark Krug
review_text: We had heard about a weekday dinner special and decided to give it a try. We had a great experience with the Pio Pio on Northern Blvd some time ago. This was closer. We arrived and were greated by the bartender who was extremely nice. We were seated nearly immediately, with only a short delay while they cleaned a recently vacated table. The interior was spacious and well done. It had a nice atmosphere. Our server came over and immediately began speaking in Spanish.  I am clearly not Hispanic and gave no indication of understanding anything he was saying nor was my wife. Once we got through that, he spoke English and got our order. We both ordered the special with the upgraded water (which turned out to be Smart water in a bottle. We had a ask for glasses). Service was sporadic after that. I felt like because we didn't order the high dollar foods, we were ignored. The food was good and well priced for the special. No complaints there. However, it was not a nice experience, and I don't think we would return to this Pio Pio.

author: Vea Cayaba
review_text: Came for a quick dinner on a Monday night, no wait and service was quick. Chicken is on point, but sides are a little pricey starting at $9.

author: Fernando P
review_text:
Its just OK...

Got half a chicken and a green sauce for $18.
Not worth it for the price to be honest .

Staff was nice , but thats about it.

author: Roberto C. Michue
review_text: As peruvian you are expected to eat delicious, but unfortunately this Pio Pio location is serving americanized food, it means no salt, no pepper, no tartara (for the jalea)  and even the chili has no flavor at all. I am really disappointed, i have been fan of Pio Pio locations around NYC and this one is not recommendable at all. The only good thing about this location are the drinks, the bartender was very kind and helpful. God bless you my friend from Uruguay! NOT EVEN THE WAITERS WERE HELPFUL. If you really want to try real peruvian food,  DO NOT COME HERE, YOU ARE WARNED! you will thank me later.

author: Ralph Torres
review_text: Had a great time eating and drinking Pisco sour. The Lomo Saltado has the best steak cuts.

author: SCOTT CONTRERAS
review_text: It's gotta be one of my favorite restaurants around my area! The service is pretty good. All the waiters and waitresses are always ready to assist you with anything, and the atmosphere is pretty good because the place itself looks clean and not that full. Now the food is pretty decent. I personally tried the chaulafan with shrimps it was really good, and I also loved the fried calamari!!

author: Ben Katof
review_text: Good food.  I get the lunch special which is fairly priced.  A couple of correctable issues.  Take away soda cans are always warm.  The overall quantity of food is really large - the side dish portion in particular. It would be good if you could get 2 half portions of different sides.  When you order maduros as a side, the amount you get is insane. Who eats a whole large plate of maduros?   Still, I’ll definitely go back.

author: Juan Liz
review_text: The food is very tasteful and fresh. The staff is very friendly and attentive. Pio Pio is a hit in Forest Hills, NY VIVA PIO PIO

author: C E
review_text:
Yes - Joe's Pizza is great and a must try. But..if you want comparable good Pepporoni and Bbq Chicken New York Style Pizza with half the line up - definitely worth a try! Staff were friendly and service was quick.
The pizzas in the photos are heated up and comes out toasty!

author: new York bangla
review_text: Prices are amazing for this authentic NY Style pizza! They have so many amazing toppings. Nice place, nice staff, nice atmosphere. Good prices.  I would recommend buying a whole pie for cost effectiveness and eating in the restaurant so your food stays at the right level of heat. Can't recommend enough!

author: Ahmed Reza
review_text:
Hands down, some of the best pizza I’ve had in NYC

Stopped in kind of randomly while walking near Bryant Park, and I’m so glad I did. The pizza here is just ridiculously good 😍 — perfect crust, loads of flavor, and super fresh toppings. I got the veggie pizza and every bite hit just right🤌.

It’s a simple, no-frills spot, but that’s part of the charm. Quick service, good vibes, and the prices are super reasonable for Midtown. Also…… they’re open 24/7?! That’s dangerous (in the best way).

Definitely one of those hidden gems you want to keep coming back to. If you’re nearby, do yourself a favor and grab a slice. Trust me you won’t regret 🙌.

author: The DDP
review_text:
Was in Bryant park and took the short block walk to grab a snack around 3 pm.

The restaurant has a small eat in area but the surfaces were still dirty from the lunch rush. Service was friendly and efficient. Ordered a slice of pepperoni which they tossed in the oven and came out piping hot a minute or two later.

$3.50 for a slice with a topping which is a good price for Manhattan, but this wasn’t a very big slice.

Problem with this is that the pizza itself wasn’t particularly good. Light on the sauce and cheese with no great flavor. Tasted kinda like a large slice of a Red Baron frozen pizza.

Went here based on the reviews but they were not indicative of the pizza I tasted. No reason to revisit.

author: Steve Bintley
review_text: Popped in here for a Saturday evening snack and left impressed. It’s fairly small and it was rather chaotic but the pizza was great. Decent sized slices and a delicious crispy base, with both thin and deep pan options available. Spicy chilli flakes are available and there’s a small amount of seating available against the wall. For a good value pizza fix I’d certainly recommend!

author: palash Sikder
review_text: It was amazing experience to having a slice of pizza with fantastic staff. I made a friend shams. Wont hesitate to cone again😁

author: Walid Alam
review_text:
Stopped by Napoli Pizza on a busy afternoon and was blown away by the quality! Got a classic cheese slice – the crust was perfectly crisp yet foldable, the sauce had that tangy-sweet balance you crave, and the cheese was generously layered and deliciously gooey – absolutely stellar! 🍕

*Flavor:10/10 – Authentic, fresh, and satisfying.
*Value: Huge slices at very fair prices for NYC. Great bang for your buck!
* Service: Quick and no-nonsense – perfect for a grab-and-go slice. Staff was friendly despite the lunch rush.
* Vibe:Exactly what you want: a bustling, no-frills, quintessential New York slice joint. Clean and efficient.

Whether you're a local needing a reliable fix or a visitor craving a real NYC slice experience, Napoli delivers. This place holds its own against the big names. Highly recommend! Will definitely be back soon.

author: Nathália Rizzo
review_text: The best pizza in town! The pie is really big. We’re coming back. Tanvir was really nice and friendly

author: Sadat Irtisum
review_text: Tried the pepperoni pizza at Napoli Pizza, and it was absolutely delicious! From the crispy crust to the flavorful toppings, everything was just right. The cheese was perfectly balanced, and it was served hot and fresh with a cold Coke Zero. Highly recommend if you're in the area!

author: Shriya Thakkar
review_text: Loved this place for its awesome pizzas! We loved their cheese pizza! Tanvir was especially sweet and went out of their way to make us feel comfortable. Such great hospitality and we will return again! Thank you so much for the great experience Tanvir! We really appreciate it 😊

author: Chintia Ahmed Niha
review_text: Great Pizza, Great Staff! As a first timer I am very pleased with this pizza spot. The line was outside when I arrived, but it moved very quickly. A variety of pizzas were displayed for your viewing pleasure, but I liked their Gluten free pizza with pepperoni. You can dine in get it boxed up to do. You can also dine in, and I enjoyed it. Great Location and very close to Bryant Park.

author: Rajib Hossain
review_text: Amazing experience with Napoli pizza. Delicious every bite. Do not hesitate to come again with family. And stuff are friendly and helpful. Special Shams. Keep it up guys

author: Camila Olivo
review_text: just went here and we tried to order 2 large pizzas for 8 people. the cashier convinced us to order 2 XL (which was not on the menu btw) since there was 8 of us and claimed it was bigger. so we also ordered 7 soda cans. my dad ordered it and paid $100 he tapped his card and was confused about tho when he came back to the table and showed us the receipt we were confused cause one L is 14.99 all cheese and 19.99 for L pepperoni. so how did an 2 XL come out to $100?? when we asked they told us that ONE XL PIE IS $40 and that all the drinks were $21. then on top of that they got it wrong and gave us 2 pepperonis instead of one cheese one pepperoni… just unclear prices and when we tried to tell them about the error they tried to tell us that the XL 2 inches bigger so for two inches the price goes from $20 to $40 DOUBLE THE PRICE. another  customer sitting there showed us his L pizza and it looked like the same size as our “XL”  btw and XL has 8 slices just like a large. very unprofessional and unclear prices. and the pizza wasnt even that good when you picked up the slices they were not crispy and were floppy

author: mahabub ahmed
review_text: Came here on the recommendation of many local friends. We got the mozzarella sticks appetizer and a pizza with pepperoni.  Everything was absolutely fresh and delicious. Definitely one the best whole halal pizza shop I’ve had in the city! The space is small but welcoming.Looking forward to returning!

author: Jasmin Ahmed
